With God are abundant spoils. Such hath been your wont in times past; but god hath been gracious to you. Be discerning, then, for God well knoweth what ye do.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: Those believers who sit at home free from trouble, and those who do valiantly in the cause of God with their substance and their persons, shall not be treated alike. God hath assigned to those who contend earnestly with their persons and with their substance, a rank above those who sit at home. Goodly promises hath He made to all. But God hath assigned to the strenuous a rich recompense, above those who sit still at home,

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: Rank of his own bestowal, and forgiveness, and mercy; for God is Indulgent, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 100
records.text: The angels,19 when they took the souls of those who had been unjust to their own weal, demanded, "What hath been your state?"20 They said, "We were the weak ones21 of the earth." They replied, "Was not God's earth broad enough for you to flee away in?" These! their home shall be Hell, and evil the passage to it-

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 101
records.text: Except the men and women and children who were not able, through their weakness, to find the means of escape, and were not guided on their way. These haply God will forgive: for God is Forgiving, Gracious.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 102
records.text: Whoever flieth his country for the cause of God, will find in the earth many under like compulsion, and abundant resources; and if any one shall quit his home and fly to God and his apostle, and then death overtake him,-his reward from God is sure: for God is Gracious, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 103
records.text: And when ye go forth to war in the land, it shall be no crime in you to cut short your prayers,22 if ye fear lest the infidels come upon you; Verily, the infidels are your undoubted enemies!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 104
records.text: And when thou, O apostle! shalt be among them, and shalt pray with them, then let a party of them rise up with thee, but let them take their arms; and when they shall have made their prostrations, let them retire to your rear: then let another party that hath not prayed come forward, and let them pray with you; but let them take their precautions and their arms. Pleased would the infidels be for you to neglect your arms and your baggage, that they might turn upon you at once! And it shall be no crime in you to lay down your arms if rain annoy you, or if ye be sick. But take your precautions.23 Verily, God hath made ready a shameful torment for the infidels.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 105
records.text: And when ye shall have ended the prayer, make mention of God, standing, and sitting, and reclining: and as soon as ye are secure, observe prayer; for to the faithful, prayer is a prescribed duty, and for stated hours.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 106
records.text: Slacken not in pursuit of the foe. If ye suffer, assuredly they suffer also as ye suffer; but ye hope from God for what they cannot hope! And God is Knowing, Wise!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 107
records.text: Verily, we have sent down the Book to thee with the truth, thou that mayest judge between men according as God hath given thee insight: But with the deceitful ones dispute not: and implore pardon of God. Verily, God is Forgiving, Merciful.24

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 108
records.text: And plead not with us for those who are self-deceivers; for God loveth not him who is deceitful, criminal.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 109
records.text: From men they hide themselves; but they cannot hide themselves from God: and when they hold nightly discourses which please Him not, He is with them. God is round about their doings!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 110
records.text: Oh! ye are they who plead in their favour in this present life; but who shall plead with God for them on the day of the resurrection? Who will be the guardian over them?

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 111
records.text: Yet he who doth evil, or shall have acted against his own weal, and then shall ask pardon of God, will find God Forgiving, Merciful:

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 112
records.text: And whoever committeth a crime, committeth it to his own hurt. And God is Knowing, Wise!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 113
records.text: And whoever committeth an involuntary fault or a crime, and then layeth it on the innocent, shall surely bear the guilt of calumny and of a manifest crime.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 114
records.text: But for the grace and mercy of God upon thee, a party among them had resolved to mislead thee, but they shall only mislead themselves; nor in aught shall they harm thee. God hath caused the Book and the wisdom to descend upon thee: and what thou knowest not He hath caused thee to know: and the grace of God toward thee hath been great.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 115
records.text: In most of their secret talk is nothing good; but only in his who enjoineth almsgiving, or that which is right, or concord among men. Whoso doth this, out of desire to please God, we will give him at the last a great reward:

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 116
records.text: But whoso shall sever himself from the prophet after that "the guidance" hath been manifested to him, and shall follow any other path than that of the faithful, we will turn our back on him as he hath turned his back on us, and we will cast him into Hell;-an evil journey thither!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 117
records.text: God truly will not forgive the joining other gods with Himself. Other sins He will forgive to whom He will: but he who joineth gods with God, hath erred with far-gone error.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 118
records.text: They call, beside Him, upon mere goddesses! they invoke a rebel Satan!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 119
records.text: On them is the malison of God. For he said, "A portion of thy servants will I surely take, and will lead them astray, and will stir desires within them, and will command them and they shall cut the ears of animals;25 and I will command them, and they shall alter the creation of God."26 He who taketh Satan rather than God for his patron, is ruined with palpable ruin:

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 120
records.text: He hath made them promises, and he hath stirred desires within them; but Satan promiseth, only to beguile!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 121
records.text: These! their dwelling Hell! no escape shall they find from it!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 122
records.text: But they who believe and do the things that are right, we will bring them into gardens beneath which the rivers flow; For ever shall they abide therein. Truly it is the promise of God: And whose word is more sure than God's?

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 123
records.text: Not according to your wishes, or the wishes of the people of the Book, shall these things be. He who doth evil shall be recompensed for it. Patron or helper, beside God, shall he find none.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 124
records.text: But whoso doth the things that are right, whether male or female, and he or she a believer,-these shall enter Paradise, nor shall they be wronged the skin of a date stone.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 125
records.text: And who hath a better religion than he who resigneth himself to God, who doth what is good, and followeth the faith of Abraham in all sincerity? And God took Abraham for his friend.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 126
records.text: All that is in the Heavens and all that is on the Earth is God's: and God encompasseth all things!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 127
records.text: Moreover, they will consult thee in regard to women: SAY: God hath instructed you about them; and His will is rehearsed to you, in the Book, concerning female orphans to whom ye give not their legal due, and whom ye refuse to marry; also with regard to weak children; and that ye deal with fairness towards orphans. Ye cannot do a good action, but verily God knoweth it.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 128
records.text: And if a wife fear ill usage or aversion on the part of her husband, then shall it be no fault in them if they can agree with mutual agreement, for agreement is best. Men's souls are prone to avarice; but if ye act kindly and fear God, then, verily, your actions are not unnoticed by God!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 129
records.text: And ye will not have it at all in your power to treat your wives alike, even though you fain would do so; but yield not wholly to disinclination, so that ye leave one of them as it were in suspense; if ye come to an understanding, and fear God, then, verily, God is Forgiving, Merciful;

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 130
records.text: But if they separate, God can compensate both out of His abundance; for God is Vast, Wise;

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 131
records.text: And whatever is in the Heavens and in the Earth is God's! We have already enjoined those to whom the Scriptures were given before you, and yourselves, to fear God. But if ye become unbelievers, yet know that whatever is in the Heavens and in the Earth is God's: and God is Rich, Praiseworthy.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 132
records.text: All that is in Heaven and all that is in Earth is God's! God is a sufficient protector!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 133
records.text: If he pleased, he could cause you to pass away, O mankind! and create others in your stead: for this hath God power.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 134
records.text: If any one desire the reward of this world, yet with God is the reward of this world and of the next! And God Heareth, Beholdeth.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 135
records.text: O ye who believe! stand fast to justice, when ye bear witness before God, though it be against yourselves, or your parents, or your kindred, whether the party be rich or poor. God is nearer than you to both. Therefore follow not passion, lest ye swerve from truth. And if ye wrest your testimony or stand aloof, God verily is well aware of what ye do.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 136
records.text: O ye who believe! believe in God and his Apostle, and the Book which he hath sent down to his Apostle, and the Book which he hath sent down aforetime. Whoever believeth not on God and his Angels and his Books and his Apostles, and in the last day, he verily hath erred with far-gone error.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 137
records.text: Verily, they who believed, then became unbelievers, then believed, and again became unbelievers, and then increased their unbelief-it is not God who will forgive them or guide them into the way.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 138
records.text: Announce27 to the hypocrites that a dolorous torment doth await them.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 139
records.text: Those who take the unbelievers for friends besides the faithful-do they seek honour at their hands? Verily, all honour belongeth unto God!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 140
records.text: And already hath He sent this down to you in the Book28 "WHEN YE SHALL HEAR THE SIGNS OF GOD THEY SHALL NOT BE BELIEVED BUT SHALL BE MOCKED AT." Sit ye not therefore with such, until they engage in other discourse; otherwise, ye will become like them. Verily God will gather the hypocrites and the infidels all together in Hell.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 141
records.text: They watch you narrowly. Then if God grant you a victory, they say, "Are we not with you?" and if the infidels meet with a success, they say to them, "Were we not superior to you: and did we not defend you from those believers?" God shall judge betwixt ye on the day of the resurrection, and God will by no means make a way for the infidels over the believers.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 142
records.text: The hypocrites would deceive God, but He will deceive them! When they stand up for prayer, they stand carelessly, to be seen of men, and they remember God but little:

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 143
records.text: Wavering between the one and the other-belonging neither to these nor those! and by no means shalt thou find a path for him whom God misleadeth.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 144
records.text: O believers! take not infidels for friends rather than believers. Would ye furnish God with clear right to punish you?

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 145
records.text: Verily the hypocrites shall be in the lowest abyss of the fire: and, by no means shalt thou find a helper for them;

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 146
records.text: Save for those who turn and amend, and lay fast hold on God, and approve the sincerity of their religion to God; these shall be numbered with the faithful, and God will at last bestow on the faithful a great reward.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 147
records.text: Why should God inflict a chastisement upon you, if ye are grateful, and believe? God is Grateful, Wise!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 148
records.text: God loveth not that evil be matter of public talk, unless any one hath been wronged: God it is who Heareth, Knoweth!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 149
records.text: Whether ye publish what is good, or conceal it, or pardon evil, verily God is Pardoning, Powerful!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 150
records.text: Of a truth they who believe not on God and his Apostles, and seek to separate God from his Apostles, and say, "Some we believe, and some we believe not," and desire to take a middle way;

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 151
records.text: These! they are veritable infidels! and for the infidels have we prepared a shameful punishment.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 152
records.text: And they who believe on God and his Apostles, and make no difference between them these! we will bestow on them their reward at last. God is Gracious, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 153
records.text: The people of the Book will ask of thee to cause a Book to come down unto them out of Heaven. But a greater thing than this did they ask of Moses! for they said, "Shew us God plainly!" and for this their wickedness did the fire- storm lay hold on them. Then took they the calf as the object of their worship, after that our clear tokens had come to them; but we forgave them this, and conferred on Moses undoubted power.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 154
records.text: And we uplifted the mountain 29 over them when we made a covenant with them, and we said to them, "Enter the gate adoring:"and we said to them, "Transgress not on the Sabbath," and we received from them a strict covenant.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 155
records.text: So, for that they have broken their covenant, and have rejected the signs of God, and have put the prophets to death unjustly, saying the while, "Our hearts are uncircumcised,"-Nay, but God hath sealed them up for their unbelief, so that but few believe.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 156
records.text: And for their unbelief,-and for their having spoken against Mary a grievous calumny,-

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 157
records.text: And for their saying, "Verily we have slain the Messiah, Jesus the son of Mary, an Apostle of God." Yet they slew him not, and they crucified him not, but they had only his likeness.30 And they who differed about him were in doubt concerning him: No sure knowledge had they about him, but followed only an opinion, and they did not really slay him, but God took him up to Himself. And God is Mighty, Wise!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 158
records.text: There shall not be one of the people of the Book but shall believe in Him before his death, and in the day of resurrection, He will be a witness against them.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 159
records.text: For the wickedness of certain Jews, and because they turn many from the way of God, we have forbidden them goodly viands which had been before allowed them.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 160
records.text: And because they have taken usury, though they were forbidden it, and have devoured men's substance in frivolity, we have got ready for the infidels among them a grievous torment.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 161
records.text: But their men of solid knowledge, and the believers who believe in that which hath been sent down to thee, and in what hath been sent down before thee, and who observe prayer, and pay the alms of obligation, and believe in God and the latter day,-these! we will give them a great reward.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 162
records.text: Verily we have revealed to thee as we revealed to Noah and the Prophets after him, and as we revealed to Abraham, and Ismaël, and Isaac, and Jacob, and the tribes, and Jesus, and Job, and Jonah, and Aaron, and Solomon; and to David gave we Psalms.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 163
records.text: Of some apostles we have told thee before: of other apostles we have not told thee-And discoursing did God discourse with Moses-

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 164
records.text: Apostles charged to announce and to warn, that men, after those apostles, might have no plea against God. And God is Mighty, Wise!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 165
records.text: But God is himself witness of what He hath sent down to thee: In His knowledge hath He sent it down to thee. The angels are also its witnesses: but God is a sufficient witness!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 166
records.text: Verily, they who believe not and pervert from the way of God, have indeed erred with error wide of truth.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 167
records.text: Verily, those who believe not, and act wrongfully, God will never pardon, and never will he guide them on path,

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 168
records.text: Than the path to Hell, in which they shall abide for ever! And this is easy for God.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 169
records.text: O men! now hath an apostle come to you with truth from your Lord. Believe then, it will be better for you. But if ye believe not, then, all that is in the Heavens and the Earth is God's; and God is Knowing, Wise!

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 170
records.text: O ye people of the Book! overstep not bounds in your religion;31 and of God, speak only truth. The Messiah, Jesus, son of Mary, is only an apostle of God, and his Word which he conveyed into Mary, and a Spirit32 proceeding from himself. Believe therefore in God and his apostles, and say not, "Three:" (there is a Trinity)-Forbear-it will be better for you. God is only one God! Far be it from His glory that He should have a son! His, whatever is in the Heavens, and whatever is in the Earth! And God is a sufficient Guardian.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 171
records.text: The Messiah disdaineth not to be a servant of God, nor do the angels who are nigh unto Him.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 172
records.text: And whoso disdaineth His service, and is filled with pride, God will gather them all to Himself.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 173
records.text: And to those who believe and do the things that are right, will He pay them their due recompense, and out of His bounty will He increase them: but as for those who are disdainful and proud, with a grievous chastisement will He chastise them;

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 174
records.text: And none beside God shall they find to protect or to help them.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 175
records.text: O men! now hath a proof come to you from your Lord, and we have sent down to you a clear light. As to those who believe in God and lay fast hold on Him, these will He cause to enter into his mercy and grace, and along the straight way unto Himself will He guide them.

records.label: Surah 4 · edition paragraph 176
records.text: They will consult thee. SAY: God instructeth you as to distant kindred. If a man die childless, but have a sister, half what he shall have shall be her's; and if she die childless he shall be her heir. But if there be two sisters, two-third parts of what he shall have shall be theirs; and if there be both brothers and sisters, the male shall have the portion of two females. God teacheth you plainly, that ye err not! God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O BELIEVERS! be faithful to your engagements. You are allowed the flesh of cattle other than what is hereinafter recited, except game, which is not allowed you while ye are on pilgrimage. Verily, God ordaineth what he pleaseth.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: O Believers! violate neither the rites of God, nor the sacred month Muharram, nor the offering, nor its ornaments1, nor those who press on to the sacred house seeking favour from their Lord and his good pleasure in them.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: But when all is over2, then take to the chase: and let not ill will at those3 who would have kept you from the sacred mosque lead you to transgress4, but rather be helpful to one another according to goodness and piety, but be not helpful for evil and malice: and fear ye God. Verily, God is severe in punishing!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: That which dieth of itself, and blood, and swine's flesh, and all that hath been sacrificed under the invocation of any other name than that of God, and the strangled, and the killed by a blow, or by a fall, or by goring5, and that which hath been eaten by beasts of prey, unless ye make it clean by giving the death-stroke yourselves, and that which hath been sacrificed on the blocks of stone6, is forbidden you: and to make division of the slain by consulting the arrows,7 is impiety in you. Woe this day on those who forsake your religion! And fear them not, but fear Me.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: This day have I perfected your religion for you, and have filled up the measure of my favours upon you: and it is my pleasure that Islam be your religion; but whoso without wilful leanings to wrong shall be forced by hunger to transgress, to him,verily, will God be Indulgent, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: They will ask thee what is made lawful for them. Say: Those things which are good8 are legalised to you, and the prey of beasts of chase which ye have trained like dogs, teaching them as God hath taught you. Eat, therefore, of what they shall catch for you, and make mention of the name of God over it, and fear God: Verily, Swift is God to reckon:

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: This day, things healthful are legalised to you, and the meats of those who have received the Scriptures are allowed to you, as your meats are to them. And you are permitted to marry virtuous women who are believers, and virtuous women of those who have received the Scriptures before you, when you shall have provided them their portions, living chastely with them without fornication, and without taking concubines. Vain the works of him who shall renounce the faith! and in the next world he shall be of the lost.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: O Believers! when ye address yourselves to prayer, wash your faces, and your hands up to the elbow, and wipe your heads, and your feet to the ankles.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And if ye have become unclean, then purify yourselves. But if ye are sick, or on a journey, or if one of you come from the place of retirement, or if ye have touched women, and ye find no water, then take clean sand and rub your faces and your hands with it.9 God desireth not to lay a burden upon you, but he desireth to purify you, and He would fill up the measure of His favour upon you, that ye may be grateful.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And remember the favour of God upon you, and His covenant which He hath covenanted with you, when ye said, "We have heard and will obey;"10 and fear God; verily, God knoweth the very secrets of the breast.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: O Believers! stand up as witnesses for God by righteousness: and let not ill- will at any, induce you not to act uprightly. Act uprightly. Next will this be to the fear of God. And fear ye God: verily, God is apprised of what ye do.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: God hath promised to those who believe, and do the things that are right, that for them is pardon and a great reward.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: But they who are Infidels and treat our signs as lies-these shall be mated with Hell fire.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: O Believers! recollect God's favour upon you, when11 certain folk were minded to stretch forth their hands against you, but He kept their hands from you. Fear God then: and on God let the faithful trust.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Of old did God accept the covenant of the children of Israel,12 and out of them we raised up twelve leaders, and God said, "Verily, I will be with you. If ye observe prayer and pay the obligatory alms, and believe in my Apostles and help them, and lend God a liberal loan, I will surely put away from you your evil deeds, and I will bring you into gardens 'neath which the rivers flow! But whoso of you after this believeth not, hath gone astray from the even path."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But for their breaking their covenant we have cursed them, and have hardened their hearts. They shift the words of Scripture from their places, and have forgotten part of what they were taught. Thou wilt not cease to discover deceit on their part, except in a few of them. But forgive them, and pass it over: verily, God loveth those who act generously!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And of those who say, "We are Christians," have we accepted the covenant. But they too have forgotten a part of what they were taught; wherefore we have stirred up enmity and hatred among them that shall last till the day of the Resurrection; and in the end will God tell them of their doings.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: O people of the Scriptures! now is our Apostle come to you to clear up to you much that ye concealed of those Scriptures, and to pass over many things. Now hath a light and a clear Book come to you from God, by which God will guide him who shall follow after his good pleasure, to paths of peace, and will bring them out of the darkness to the light, by his will: and to the straight path will he guide them.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Infidels now are they who say, "Verily God is the Messiah Ibn Maryam (son of Mary)! SAY: And who could aught obtain from God, if he chose to destroy the Messiah Ibn Maryam, and his mother, and all who are on the earth together?

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: For with God is the sovereignty of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that is between them! He createth what He will; and over all things is God potent.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Say the Jews and Christians, "Sons are we of God and his beloved." SAY: Why then doth he chastise you for your sins? Nay! ye are but a part of the men whom he hath created! He will pardon whom he pleaseth, and chastise whom he pleaseth, and with God is the sovereignty of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that is between them, and unto Him shall all things return.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: O people of the Book! now hath our Apostle come to you to clear up to you the cessation13 of Apostles, lest you should say, "There hath come to us no bearer of good tidings, nor any warner." But now hath a bearer of good tidings and a warner reached you. And God is Almighty.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And remember when Moses said to his people, "O my people! call to mind the goodness of God towards you when he appointed Prophets among you, and appointed you kings, and gave you what never had been given before to any human beings:

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Enter, O my people! the holy land which God hath destined for you. Turn not back, lest ye be overthrown to your ruin."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: They said, "O Moses! Therein are men of might. And verily, we can by no means enter it till they be gone forth. But if they go forth from it, then verily will we enter in."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Then said two men of those who feared their Lord and to whom God had been gracious, "Enter in upon them by the gate: and when ye enter it, ye overcome! If ye be believers, put ye your trust in God."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: They said, "O Moses! never can we enter while they remain therein. Go thou and thy Lord and fight; for here will we sit us down."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: He said, "O my Lord, Verily of none am I master but of myself and my brother: put thou therefore a difference between us and this ungodly people."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: He said, "Verily the land shall be forbidden them forty years: they shall wander in the earth perplexed. Fret not thyself therefore for the ungodly people."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Relate to them exactly the story of the sons of Adam14 when they each offered an offering; accepted from the one of them, and not accepted from the other. The one said, "I will surely slay thee." Said the other, "God only accepted from those that fear Him.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: "Even if thou stretch forth thine hand against me to slay me, I will not stretch forth my hand against thee to slay thee. Truly I fear God the Lord of the Worlds.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: "Yea, rather would I that thou shouldest bear my sin15 and thine own sin, and that thou become an inmate of the Fire: for that is the recompense of the unjust doers."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And his passion led him to slay his brother: and he slew him; and he became one of those who perish.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And God sent a raven which scratched upon the ground, to shew him16 how he might hide his brother's wrong.17 He said: "O woe is me! am I too weak to become like this raven, and to hide away my brother's wrong?" And he became one of the repentant.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: For this cause have we ordained to the children of Israel that he who slayeth any one, unless it be a person guilty of manslaughter, or of spreading disorders in the land, shall be as though he had slain all mankind; but that he who saveth a life, shall be as though he had saved all mankind alive.18

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Of old our Apostles came to them with the proofs of their mission; then verily after this most of them committed excesses in the land.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Only, the recompense of those who war against God and his Apostle, and go about to commit disorders on the earth, shall be that they shall be slain or crucified, or have their alternate hands and feet cut off, or be banished the land: This their disgrace in this world, and in the next a great torment shall be theirs-

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Except those who, ere you have them in your power, shall repent; for know that God is Forgiving, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: O ye who believe! fear God. Desire union with Him. Contend earnestly on his path, that you may attain to happiness.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: As to the infidels-if that they had twice the riches of the earth to be their ransom from torment on the day of resurrection, it should not be accepted from them! And a dolorous torment shall be their's.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Fain would they come forth from the Fire; but forth from it they shall not come: and a lasting torment shall be their's.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: As to the thief, whether man or woman, cut ye off their hands in recompense for their doings.19 This is a penalty by way of warning from God himself. And God is Mighty, Wise.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: But whoever shall turn him to God after this his wickedness, and amend, God truly will be turned to him: for God is Forgiving, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Knowest thou not that the sovereignty of the Heavens and of the Earth is God's? He chastiseth whom He will, and whom He will He forgiveth. And God hath power over all things.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: O Apostle! let not those who vie with one another in speeding to infidelity vex thee;-of those who say with their mouths, "We believe," but whose hearts believe not;-or of the Jews listeners to a lie-listeners to others-but who come not to thee. They shift the words of the law from their places, and say, "If this be brought to you, receive it; but if this be not brought to you, then beware of it." For him whom God would mislead, thou canst in no wise prevail with God! They whose hearts God shall not please to cleanse, shall suffer disgrace in this world, and in the next a grievous punishment;

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Listeners to a falsehood and greedy devourers of the forbidden!20 If, therefore, they have recourse to thee, then judge between them, or withdraw from them. If thou withdraw from them, then can they have no power to injure thee. But if thou judge, then judge between them with equity. Verily, God loveth those who deal equitably.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: But how shall they make thee their judge, since they possess already the Law, in which are the behests of God, and have not obeyed it? After this, they will turn their backs; but such are not believers.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Verily, we have sent down the law (Towrat) wherein are guidance and light. By it did the prophets who professed Islam judge the Jews; and the doctors and the teachers judged by that portion of the Book of God, of which they were the keepers and the witnesses. Therefore, O Jews! fear not men but fear Me; and barter not away my signs for a mean price! And whoso will not judge by what God hath sent down-such are the Infidels.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: And therein21 have we enacted for them, "Life for life, and eye for eye, and nose for nose, and ear for ear, and tooth for tooth, and for wounds retaliation:"-Whoso shall compromise it as alms shall have therein the expiation of his sin; and whoso will not judge by what God hath sent down- such are the transgressors.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And in the footsteps of the prophets caused we Jesus, the son of Mary, to follow, confirming the law which was before him: and we gave him the Evangel with its guidance and light, confirmatory of the preceding Law; a guidance and warning to those who fear God;-

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And that the people of the Evangel may judge according to what God hath sent down therein. And whoso will not judge by what God hath sent down-such are the perverse.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And to thee we have sent down the Book of the Koran with truth, confirmatory of previous Scriptures, and their safeguard. Judge therefore between them by what God hath sent down, and follow not their desires by deserting the truth which hath come unto thee. To every one of you have we given a rule and a beaten track.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And if God had pleased He had surely made you all one people; but He would test you by what He hath given to each. Be emulous, then, in good deeds. To God shall ye all return, and He will tell you concerning the subjects of your disputes.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Wherefore do thou judge between them, by what God hath sent down, and follow not their wishes! but be on thy guard against them lest they beguile thee from any of those precepts which God hath sent down to thee; and if they turn back, then know thou that for some of their crimes doth God choose to punish them: for truly most men are perverse.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: Desire they, therefore, the judgments of the times of(pagan) ignorance? But what better judge can there be than God for those who believe firmly?

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: O Believers! take not the Jews or Christians22 as friends. They are but one another's friends. If any one of you taketh them for his friends, he surely is one of them! God will not guide the evil doers.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: So shalt thou see the diseased at heart speed away to them, and say, "We fear lest a change of fortune befall us." But haply God will of himself bring about some victory or event of His own ordering: then soon will they repent them of their secret imaginings.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: Then will the faithful say, "What! are these they who swore, by their most solemn oath, that they were surely with you?" Vain their works; and themselves shall come to ruin.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: O ye who believe! should any of you desert His religion, God will then raise up a people loved by Him, and loving Him, lowly towards the faithful, haughty towards the Infidels. For the cause of God will they contend, and not fear the blame of the blamer. This is the Grace of God! On whom He will He bestoweth it! God is Vast, Omniscient!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Verily, your protector is God and His Apostle, and those who believe, who observe prayer, and pay the alms of obligation, and who bow in worship.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: And whoso take God and His Apostle, and those who believe for friends, they truly are the people of God; they shall have the upper hand.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: O ye who believe! take not such of those who have received the Scriptures before you, as scoff and jest at your religion, or the Infidels, for your friends, but fear God if ye are believers:

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Nor those who when ye call to prayer, make it an object of raillery and derision. This they do because they are a people who understand not.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: SAY:23 O people of the Book! do ye not disavow us only because we believe in God, and in what He hath sent down to us, and in what He hath sent down aforetime, and because most of you are doers of ill?

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: SAY: Can I announce to you any retribution worse than that which awaiteth them with God? They whom God hath cursed and with whom He hath been angry- some of them hath He changed into apes and swine; and they who worship Thagout are in evil plight, and have gone far astray from the right path!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: When they presented themselves to you they said, "We believe;" but Infidels they came in unto you, and Infidels they went forth! God well knew what they concealed.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: Many of them shalt thou see hastening together to wickedness and malice, and to eat unlawful things. Shame on them for what they have done!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Had not their doctors and teachers forbidden their uttering wickedness, and their eating unlawful food, bad indeed would have been their doings!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: "The hand of God," say the Jews, "is chained up."24 Their own hands shall be chained up-and for that which they have said shall they be cursed. Nay! outstretched are both His hands! At His own pleasure does He bestow gifts. That which hath been sent down to thee from thy Lord will surely increase the rebellion and unbelief of many of them; and we have put enmity and hatred between them that shall last till the day of the Resurrection. Oft as they kindle a beacon fire for war shall God quench it! and their aim will be to abet disorder on the earth: but God loveth not the abettors of disorder.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: But if the people of the Book believe and have the fear of God, we will surely put away their sins from them, and will bring them into gardens of delight: and if that they observe the law and the Evangel, and what hath been sent down to them from their Lord, they shall surely have their fill of good things from above them and from beneath their feet. Some there are among them who act aright; but many of them-how evil are their doings!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: O Apostle! proclaim all that hath been sent down to thee from thy Lord: for if thou do it not, thou hast not proclaimed His message at all. And God will protect thee from evil men: verily, God guideth not the unbelievers.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: SAY: O people of the Book! ye have no ground to stand on, until ye observe the Law and the Evangel, and that which hath been sent down to you from your Lord.25 The Book which hath been sent down to thee from thy Lord will certainly increase the rebellion and unbelief of many of them; but, be not thou troubled for the unbelievers.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: Verily, they who believe, and the Jews, and the Sabeites,26 and the Christians-whoever of them believeth in God and in the last day, and doth what is right, on them shall come no fear, neither shall they be put to grief.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: Of old we accepted the covenant of the children of Israel, and sent Apostles to them. Oft as an Apostle came to them with that for which they had no desire, some they treated as liars, and some they slew;27

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And they reckoned that no harm would come of it:-but they became blind and deaf! Then was God turned unto them: then many of them again became blind and deaf! but God beheld what they did.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Infidels now are they who say, "God is the Messiah, Son of Mary;" for the Messiah said, "O children of Israel! worship God, my Lord and your Lord." Whoever shall join other gods with God, God shall forbid him the Garden, and his abode shall be the Fire; and the wicked shall have no helpers.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: They surely are Infidels who say, "God is the third of three:" for there is no God but one God: and if they refrain not from what they say, a grievous chastisement shall light on such of them as are Infidels.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: Will they not, therefore, be turned unto God, and ask pardon of Him? since God is Forgiving, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: The Messiah, Son of Mary, is but an Apostle; other Apostles have flourished before him; and his mother was a just28 person: they both ate food.29 Behold! how we make clear to them the signs! then behold how they turn aside!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: SAY: Will ye worship, beside God, that which can neither hurt nor help? But God! He only Heareth, Knoweth.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: SAY: O people of the Book! outstep not bounds of truth in your religion; neither follow the desires of those who have already gone astray, and who have caused many to go astray, and have themselves gone astray from the evenness of the way.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: Those among the children of Israel who believed not were cursed by the tongue of David,30 and of Jesus, Son of Mary. This, because they were rebellious, and became transgressors: they forbade not one another the iniquity which they wrought! detestable are their actions!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: Thou shalt see many of them make friends of the infidels. Evil the actions which their own passions have sent on beforehand; for God is angry with them, and in torment shall they abide for ever:

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: But, if they had believed in God, and the Prophet, and the Koran which hath been sent down to him, they had not taken them for their friends; but perverse are most of them.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: Of all men thou wilt certainly find the Jews, and those who join other gods with God, to be the most intense in hatred of those who believe; and thou shalt certainly find those to be nearest in affection to them who say, "We are Christians." This, because some of them are priests and monks,31 and because they are free from pride.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: And when they hear that which hath been sent down to the Apostle, thou seest their eyes overflow with tears at the truth they recognise therein, saying, "O our Lord! we believe; write us down therefore with those who bear witness to it.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: And why should we not believe in God, and in the truth which hath come down to us, and crave that our Lord would bring us into Paradise with the Just?"

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: Therefore hath God rewarded them for these their words, with gardens 'neath which the rivers flow; they shall abide therein for ever: this the reward of the righteous! But they who believe not and treat our signs as lies shall be the inmates of Hell-fire.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: O ye who believe! interdict not the healthful viands which God hath allowed you; go not beyond this limit. God loveth not those who outstep it.32

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: And eat of what God hath given you for food, that which is lawful and wholesome: and fear God, in whom ye believe.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: God will not punish you for a mistaken word in your oaths: but he will punish you in regard to an oath taken seriously.33 Its expiation shall be to feed ten poor persons with such middling food as ye feed your own families with, or to clothe them; or to set free a captive. But he who cannot find means, shall fast three days. This is the expiation of your oaths when ye shall have sworn. Keep then your oaths. Thus God maketh his signs clear to you, that ye may give thanks.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: O believers! surely wine and games of chance,34 and statues, and the divining arrows, are an abomination of Satan's work! Avoid them, that ye may prosper.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: Only would Satan sow hatred and strife among you, by wine and games of chance, and turn you aside from the remembrance of God, and from prayer: will ye not, therefore, abstain from them? Obey God and obey the Apostle, and be on your guard: but if ye turn back, know that our Apostle is only bound to deliver a plain announcement.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: No blame shall attach to those who believe and do good works, in regard to any food they have taken, in case they fear God and believe, and do the things that are right, and shall still fear God and believe, and shall still fear him, and do good; for God loveth those who do good.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: O ye who believe! God will surely make trial of you with such game as ye may take with your hands, or your lances, that God may know who feareth him in secret: and whoever after this transgresseth, shall suffer a grievous chastisement.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: O believers!35 kill no game while ye are on pilgrimage. Whosoever among you shall purposely kill it, shall comsent pensate for it in domestic animals of equal value (according to the judgment of two just persons among you), to be brought as an offering to the Caaba; or in expiation thereof shall feed the poor; or as the equivalent of this shall fast, that he may taste the ill consequence of his deed. God forgiveth what is past; but whoever doth it again, God will take vengeance on him; for God is mighty and vengeance is His.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: It is lawful for you to fish in the sea, and to eat fish, as provision for you and for those who travel; but it is unlawful for you to hunt by land while ye are still on pilgrimage: fear ye God, therefore, before whom ye shall be assembled.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: God hath appointed the Caaba,36 the sacred house, to be a station for mankind, and the sacred month, and the offering, and its ornaments. This, that ye may know that God knoweth all that is in the heavens and on the earth, and that God hath knowledge of everything. Know that God is severe in punishing, and that God is Forgiving, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 100
records.text: The Apostle is only bound to preach: and God knoweth what ye bring to light, and what ye conceal.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 101
records.text: SAY: The evil and the good shall not be valued alike, even though the abundance of evil please thee; therefore fear God, O ye of understanding! that it may be well with you.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 102
records.text: O believers! ask us not of things which if they were told might only pain you; but if ye ask of such things when the entire Koran shall have been sent down, they will be declared to you: God will pardon you for this, for God is Forgiving, Gracious. They who were before you, asked concerning such things, and afterwards quickly disbelieved therein

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 103
records.text: God hath not ordained anything on the subject. of Bahira, or Saïba, or Wasila, or Hami;37 but the unbelievers have invented this lie against God: and most of them had no understanding.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 104
records.text: And when it was said to them, "Accede to that which God hath sent down, and to the Apostle:" they said, "Sufficient for us is the faith in which we found our fathers." What! though their fathers knew nothing, and had no guidance?

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 105
records.text: O believers! take heed to yourselves.38 He who erreth shall not hurt you when ye have the "guidance:" to God shall ye all return, and He will tell you that which ye have done.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 106
records.text: O believers! let there be witnesses between you, when death draweth nigh to any of you, at the time of making the testament; two witnesses-just men from among yourselves, or two others of a different tribe from yourselves-if ye be journeying in the earth, and the calamity of death surprise you. Ye shall shut them both up, after the prayer; and if ye doubt them, they shall swear by God, "We will not take a bribe though the party be of kin to us, neither will we conceal the testimony of God, for then we should be among the wicked."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 107
records.text: But if it shall be made clear that both have been guilty of a falsehood, two others of those who have convicted them thereof, the two nearest in blood shall stand up in their place, and they shall swear by God, "Verily our witness is more true than the witness of these two; neither have we advanced anything untrue, for then should we be of the unjust."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 108
records.text: Thus will it be easier for men to bear a true39 witness, or fear lest after their oath another oath be given. Therefore fear God and hearken; for God guideth not the perverse.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 109
records.text: One day will God assemble the Apostles, and say, "What reply was made to you?" They shall say, "We have no knowledge, but Thou art the Knower of Secrets."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 110
records.text: When He shall say: O Jesus! Son of Mary! call to mind my favour upon thee and upon thy mother, when I strengthened thee with the Holy Spirit, that thou shouldest speak40 to men alike in the cradle, and when grown up;-

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 111
records.text: And when I taught thee the Scripture, and Wisdom, and the Law, and the Evangel: and thou didst create of clay, as it were, the figure of a bird, by my leave, and didst breathe into it, and by my leave it became a bird; and thou didst heal the blind and the leper, by my leave; and when, by my leave, thou didst bring forth the dead; and when I withheld the children of Israel from thee, when thou hadst come to them with clear tokens: and such of them as believed not said, "This is nought but plain sorcery;"41

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 112
records.text: And when I revealed unto the Apostles, "Believe on me and on my Sent One," they said, "We believe; and bear thou witness that we are Muslims."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 113
records.text: Remember when the Apostles42 said-"O Jesus, Son of Mary! is thy Lord able to send down a furnished TABLE to us out of Heaven?" He said-"Fear God if ye be believers."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 114
records.text: They said-"We desire to eat therefrom, and to have our hearts assured; and to know that thou hast indeed spoken truth to us, and to be witnesses thereof."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 115
records.text: Jesus, Son of Mary, said-"O God, our Lord! send down a table to us out of Heaven, that it may become a recurring festival to us, to the first of us and to the last of us, and a sign from thee; and do thou nourish us, for thou art the best of nourishers."

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 116
records.text: And God said-Verily, I will cause it to descend unto you; but whoever among you after that shall disbelieve, I will surely chastise him with a chastisement, wherewith I will not chastise any other creature.43

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 117
records.text: And when God shall say-"O Jesus, Son of Mary: hast thou said unto mankind- 'Take me and my mother as two Gods, beside God?"' He shall say-"Glory be unto Thee! it is not for me to say that which I know to be not the truth; had I said that, verily thou wouldest have known it: Thou knowest what is in me, but I know not what is in Thee; for Thou well knowest things unseen!

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 118
records.text: "I spake not to them aught but that which thou didst bid me-'Worship God, my Lord and your Lord;' and I was a witness of their actions while I stayed among them; but since thou hast taken me to Thyself, Thou hast Thyself watched them, and Thou art witness of all things:

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 119
records.text: "If Thou punish them, they are Thy servants, and if Thou forgive them. . . .44 Thou, verily, art the Mighty, the Wise!"

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 120
records.text: God will say-This day shall their truth advantage the truthful. Gardens shall they have 'neath which the rivers flow, and remain therein for ever: God is well pleased with them and they with Him. This shall be the great bliss.

records.label: Surah 5 · edition paragraph 121
records.text: Unto God belongeth the sovereignty of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that they contain; and He hath power over all things.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: PRAISE be to God, who hath created the Heavens and the Earth, and ordained the darkness and the light! Yet unto their Lord do the infidels give peers!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: He it is who created you of clay then decreed the term of your life: and with Him is another prefixed term for the resurrection. Yet have ye doubts thereof!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And He is God in the Heavens and on the Earth! He knoweth your secrets and your disclosures! and He knoweth what ye deserve.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Never did one single sign from among the signs of their Lord come to them, but they turned away from it;

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And now, after it hath reached them, have they treated the truth itself as a lie. But in the end, a message as to that which they have mocked, shall reach them.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: See they not how many generations we have destroyed before them? We had settled them on the earth as we have not settled you, and we sent down the very heavens upon them in copious rains, and we made the rivers to flow beneath their feet: yet we destroyed them in their sins, and raised up other generations to succeed them.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And had we sent down to thee a Book written on parchment, and they had touched it with their hands, the infidels had surely said, "This is nought but plain sorcery."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: They say, too, "Unless an angel be sent down to him. . . ." But if we had sent down an angel, their judgment would have come on them at once,1 and they would have had no respite:

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And if we had appointed an angel, we should certainly have appointed one in the form of a man, and we should have clothed him before them in garments like their own.2

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Moreover, apostles before thee have been laughed to scorn: but that which they laughed to scorn encompassed the mockers among them!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: SAY: Go through the land: then see what hath been the end of those who treated them as liars.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: SAY: Whose is all that is in the Heavens and the Earth?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: SAY: God's. He had imposed mercy on Himself as a law. He will surely assemble you on the Resurrection day; there is no doubt of it. They who are the authors of their own ruin, are they who will not believe.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: His, whatsoever hath its dwelling in the night and in the day! and He, the Hearing, the Knowing!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: SAY: Other than God shall I take as Lord, maker of the Heavens and of the Earth, who nourisheth all, and of none is nourished? SAY: Verily, I am bidden to be the first of those who surrender them to God (profess Islam): and, be not thou of those who join gods with God.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: SAY: Verily, I fear, should I rebel against my Lord, the punishment of the great day.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: From whomsoever it shall be averted on that day, He will have had mercy on him: and this will be the manifest bliss.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: If God touch thee with trouble, none can take it off but He: and if He visit thee with good-it is He whose power is over all things;

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And He is the Supreme over his servants; and He is the Wise, the Cognisant!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: SAY: What thing is weightiest in bearing witness? SAY: God is witness between me and you; and this Koran hath been revealed to me that I should warn you by it, and all whom it shall reach. What! will ye really bear witness that there are other gods with God? SAY: I bear no such witness. SAY: Verily, He is one God, and truly am guiltless of what ye join with Him.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: They to whom we have given the Book, recognise him (Muhammad) as they do their own children:3 but they who are the authors of their own perdition are they who will not believe.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And who more wicked than he who inventeth a lie concerning God, or who treateth our signs as lies? Verily those wicked ones shall not prosper.4

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And on "the Day" we will gather them all together: then will we say to those who joined gods with God, "Where are those companion-gods of yours, as ye supposed them?"

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Then shall they find no other excuse than to say, "By God our Lord! we joined not companions with Him."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Behold! how they lie against themselves-and the gods of their own inventing desert them!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Some among them hearken unto thee: but we have cast veils over their hearts that they should not understand the Koran, and a weight into their ears: and though they should see all kinds of signs, they will refuse all faith in them, until when they come to thee, to dispute with thee, the infidels say, "Verily, this is nothing but fables of the ancients."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And they will forbid it, and depart from it:-but they are only the authors of their own perdition, and know it not.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: If thou couldst see when they shall be set over the fire, and shall say, "Oh! would we might be sent back! we would not treat the signs of our Lord as lies! we would be of the believers."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Aye! that hath become clear5 to them which they before concealed; but though they should return, they would surely go back to that which was forbidden them; for they are surely liars!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And they say, "There is no other than our life in this world, neither shall we be raised again."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: But if thou couldest see when they shall be set before their Lord! He shall say to them, "Is not this it6 in truth?" They shall say, "Yea, by our Lord!" "Taste then," saith He, "the torment, for that ye believed not!"

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Lost are they who deny the meeting with God until "the Hour" cometh suddenly upon them! Then will they say, "Oh, our sighs for past negligence of this hour!" and they shall bear their burdens on their back! Will not that be evil with which they shall be burdened?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: The life in this world is but a play and pastime; and better surely for men of godly fear will be the future mansion! Will ye not then comprehend?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Now know we that what they speak vexeth thee:7 But it is not merely thee whom they charge with falsehood, but the ungodly gainsay the signs of God.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Before thee have apostles already been charged with falsehood: but they bore the charge and the wrong with constancy, till our help came to them;-for none can change the words of God. But this history of His Sent Ones hath already reached thee.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: But if their estrangement be grievous to thee, and if thou art able to seek out an opening into the earth or a ladder into Heaven,8 that thou mightest bring them a sign. . . . Yes! But if God pleased, He would surely bring them, one and all, to the guidance! therefore be not thou one of the ignorant.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: To those only who shall lend an ear will He make answer: as for the dead, God will raise them up; then unto Him shall they return.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: They say, "Unless a sign be sent down to him from his Lord. . . ." SAY: Verily, God is able to send down a sign; but the greater part of them know it not.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: No kind of beast is there on earth nor fowl that flieth with its wings, but is a folk9 like you: nothing have we passed over in the Book:10 then unto their Lord shall they be gathered.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: They who gainsay our signs are deaf, and dumb, in darkness: God will mislead whom He pleaseth, and whom He pleaseth He will place upon the straight path.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If the punishment of God were to come upon you, or "the Hour" were to come upon you, will ye cry to any other than God? Tell me, if ye speak the truth?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Yes! to Him will ye cry: and if He please He will deliver you from that ye shall cry to Him to avert, and ye shall forget the partners ye joined with Him.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Already have we sent apostles to nations that were before thee, and we laid hold on them with troubles and with straits in order that they might humble themselves:

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Yet, when our trouble came upon them, they did not humble themselves; but their hearts were hardened, and Satan pre-arranged for them11 their course of conduct.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And when they had forgotten their warnings, we set open to them the gates of all things, until, as they were rejoicing in our gifts, we suddenly laid hold upon them, and lo! they were plunged into despair,

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And the uttermost part of that impious people was cut off. All praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If God should take away your hearing and your sight and set a seal upon your hearts, what god beside God would restore them to you? See! how we vary our wondrous verses (signs)! yet they turn away from them!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If the punishment of God come on you suddenly or foreseen,12 shall any perish except the impious?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: We send not our Sent Ones but as heralds of good news and warners; and whoso shall believe and amend, on them shall come no fear, neither shall they be sorrowful:

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: But whoso shall charge our signs with falsehood, on them shall fall a punishment for their wicked doings.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: SAY: I say not to you, "In my possession are the treasures of God;" neither say I, "I know things secret;" neither do I say to you, "Verily, I am an angel:" Only what is revealed to me do I follow. SAY: Shall the blind and the seeing be esteemed alike? Will ye not then reflect?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And warn those who dread their being gathered to their Lord, that patron or intercessor they shall have none but Him,-to the intent that they may fear Him!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And thrust not thou away those who cry to their Lord at morn and even, craving to behold his face. It is not for thee in anything to judge of their motives, nor for them in anything to judge of thee. If thou thrust them away thou wilt be of the doers of wrong.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Thus have we made proof of some of them by others, that they may say, "Are these they among us to whom God hath been gracious?" Doth not God best know the thankful?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And when they who believe in our signs come to thee, SAY: Peace be upon you! Your Lord hath laid down for himself a law of mercy; so that if any one of you commit a fault through ignorance, and afterwards turn and amend, He surely will be Gracious, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Thus have we distinctly set forth our signs, that the way of the wicked might be made known.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: SAY: Forbidden am I to worship those whom ye call on beside God. SAY: I will not follow your wishes; for then should I have gone astray, and should not be of the guided.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: SAY: I act upon proofs from my Lord, but ye treat them as falsehoods. That punishment which ye desire to be hastened is not in my power; judgment is with God only: He will declare the truth; and He is the best settler of disputes.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: SAY: If what ye would hasten on, were in my power, the matter between me and you had been decided: but God best knoweth the impious.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: And with Him are the keys13 of the secret things; none knoweth them but He: He knoweth whatever is on the land and in the sea; and no leaf falleth but He knoweth it; neither is there a grain in the darknesses of the earth, nor a thing green or sere, but it is noted in a distinct writing.14

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: It is He who taketh your souls at night,15 and knoweth what ye have merited in the day: then he awaketh you therein, that the set life-term may be fulfilled: then unto Him shall ye return; and then shall be declare to you that which ye have wrought.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Supreme over his servants, He sendeth forth guardians who watch over you, until, when death overtaketh any one of you, our messengers take his soul, and fail not:

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Then are they returned to God their Lord, the True. Is not judgment His? Swiftest He, of those who take account!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: SAY: Who rescueth you from the darkness of the land and of the sea, when humbly and secretly ye cry to Him-"If thou rescue us from this, we will surely be of the thankful?"

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: SAY: God rescueth you from them, and from every strait: yet afterwards ye give Him companions!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: SAY: It is He who hath power to send on you a punishment from above you, or from beneath your feet, or to clothe you with discord,16 and to make some of you to taste the violence of others. See how variously we handle the wondrous verses, that haply they may become wise!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: But thy people hath accused the Koran of falsehood, though it be the truth: SAY: I am not in charge of you: To every prophecy is its set time, and bye- and-bye ye shall know it!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: And when thou seest those who busy themselves with cavilling at our signs, withdraw from them till they busy themselves in some other subject: and if Satan cause thee to forget this, sit not, after recollection, with the ungodly people:17

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: Not that they who fear God are to pass any judgment upon them, but the object of recollection is that they may continue to fear Him.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: And quit those who make their religion a sport and a pastime, and whom this present life hath deceived: warn them hereby that every soul will be consigned to doom for its own works: patron or intercessor, beside God, shall it have none: and could it compensate with fullest compensation, it would not be accepted from it. They who for their deeds shall be consigned to doom-for them are draughts of boiling water, and a grievous torment; for that they believed not!

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: SAY: Shall we, beside God, call upon those who can neither help nor hurt us? Shall we turn upon our heel after that God hath guided us? Like some bewildered man whom the Satans have spell-bound in the desert, though his companions call him to the true guidance, with, "Come to us!" SAY: Verily, guidance from God, that is the true guidance; and we are commanded to surrender ourselves to the Lord of the Worlds.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: And observe ye the times of prayer, and fear ye God: for it is He to whom ye shall be gathered.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: And it is He who hath created the Heavens and the Earth, in truth, and when He saith to a thing, "Be," it is.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: His word is the truth: and His the kingdom, on the day when there shall be a blast on the trumpet: He knoweth alike the unseen and the seen: and He is the Wise, the Cognisant.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And remember when Abraham said to his father Azar,18 Takest thou images as gods? Verily, I see that thou and thy people are in manifest error.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: And thus did we shew Abraham the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth,19 that he might be stablished in knowledge.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: And when the night overshadowed him, he beheld a star. "This," said he, "is my Lord:" but when it set, he said, "I love not gods which set."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: And when he beheld the moon uprising, "This," said he, "is my Lord:" but when it set, he said, "Surely, if my Lord guide me not, I shall surely be of those who go astray."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And when he beheld the sun uprise, he said, "This is my Lord; this is greatest." But when it set, he said, "O my people! I share not with you the guilt of joining gods with God;

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: I turn my face to him who hath created the Heavens and the Earth, following the right religion:20 I am not one of those who add gods to God."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: And his people disputed with him.-He said: "Dispute ye with me about God, when He hath guided me? And I fear not the deities whom ye join with Him, for only by the will of my Lord have they any power:21 My Lord embraceth all things in His knowledge. Will ye not then consider?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: And how should I fear what ye have joined with God, since ye fear not for having joined with Him that for which He hath sent you down no warranty? Which, therefore, of the two parties is more worthy of safety? Know ye that?

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: They who believe, and who clothe not their faith with error.22 theirs is safety, and they are guided aright."

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: This is our reasoning with which we furnished Abraham against his people: We uplift to grades of wisdom whom we will; Verily thy Lord is Wise, Knowing.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: And we gave him Isaac and Jacob, and guided both aright; and we had before guided Noah; and among the descendants of Abraham, David and Solomon, and Job and Joseph, and Moses and Aaron: Thus do we recompense the righteous:

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: And Zachariah, John, Jesus, and Elias: all were just persons:

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: And Ismael and Elisha and Jonas and Lot: all these have we favoured above mankind:

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: And some of their fathers, and of their offspring, and of their brethren: and we chose them, and guided them into the straight way.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: This is God's guidance: He guideth by it such of his servants as he will: But if they join others god with Him, vain assuredly shall be all their works.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: These are they to whom we gave the Scripture and Wisdom and Prophecy: but if these their posterity believe not therein, we will entrust these gifts to a people who will not disbelieve therein.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: These are they whom God hath guided: follow therefore their guidance. SAY: No pay do I ask of you for this:23 Verily it is no other than the teaching for all creatures.

records.label: Surah 6 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: No just estimate do they form of God when they say, "Nothing hath God sent down to man." SAY: Who sent down the Book which Moses brought, a light and guidance to man, which ye set down on paper, publishing part, but concealing most: though ye have now been taught that which neither ye nor your fathers knew? SAY: It is God: then leave them in their pastime of cavillings.24
