records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: When he said to his Father, "O my Father! why dost thou worship that which neither seeth nor heareth, nor profiteth thee aught?

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: O my Father! verily now hath knowledge come to me which hath not come to thee. Follow me therefore-I will guide thee into an even path.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: O my Father! worship not Satan, for Satan is a rebel against the God of Mercy.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: O my Father! indeed I fear lest a chastisement from the God of Mercy light upon thee, and thou become Satan's vassal."

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: He said, "Castest thou off my Gods, O Abraham? If thou forbear not, I will surely stone thee. Begone from me for a length of time."

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: He said, "Peace be on thee! I will pray my Lord for thy forgiveness, for he is gracious to me:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: But I will separate myself from you, and the gods ye call on beside God, and on my Lord will I call. Haply, my prayers to my Lord will not be with ill success."

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And when he had separated himself from them and that which they worshipped beside God, we bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob, and each of them we made a prophet:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And we bestowed gifts on them in our mercy, and gave them the lofty tongue of truth."19

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And commemorate Moses in "the Book;" for he was a man of purity: moreover he was an Apostle, a Prophet:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: From the right side of the mountain we called to him, and caused him to draw nigh to us for secret converse:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: And we bestowed on him in our mercy his brother Aaron, a Prophet.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And commemorate Ismael in "the Book;" for he was true to his promise, and was an Apostle, a Prophet;

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: And he enjoined prayer and almsgiving on his people, and was well pleasing to his Lord.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: And commemorate Edris20 in "the Book;" for he was a man of truth, a Prophet:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: And we uplifted him to a place on high.21

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: These are they among the prophets of the posterity of Adam, and among those whom we bare with Noah, and among the posterity of Abraham and Israel, and among those whom we have guided and chosen, to whom God hath shewed favour. When the signs of the God of Mercy were rehearsed to them, they bowed them down worshipping and weeping.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: But others have come in their place after them: they have made an end of prayer, and have gone after their own lusts; and in the end they shall meet with evil:-

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Save those who turn and believe and do that which is right, these shall enter the Garden, and in nought shall they be wronged:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: The Garden of Eden, which the God of Mercy hath promised to his servants, though yet unseen:22 for his promise shall come to pass:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: No vain discourse shall they hear therein, but only "Peace;" and their food shall be given them at morn and even:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: This is the Paradise which we will make the heritage of those our servants who fear us.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: We23 come not down from Heaven but by thy Lord's command. His, whatever is before us and whatever is behind us, and whatever is between the two! And thy Lord is not forgetful,-

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that is between them! Worship Him, then, and abide thou steadfast in his worship. Knowest thou any other of the same name?24

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: Man saith: "What! after I am dead, shall I in the end be brought forth alive?"

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Doth not man bear in mind that we made him at first, when he was nought?

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: And I swear by thy Lord, we will surely gather together them and the Satans: then will we set them on their knees round Hell:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: Then will we take forth from each band those of them who have been stoutest in rebellion against the God of Mercy:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: Then shall we know right well to whom its burning is most due:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: No one is there of you who shall not go down unto it25-This is a settled decree with thy Lord-

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: Then will we deliver those who had the fear of God, and the wicked will we leave in it on their knees.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: And when our clear signs are rehearsed to them, the infidels say to those who believe: "Which of the two parties26 is in the best plight? and which is the most goodly company?"

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: But how many generations have we brought to ruin before them, who surpassed them in riches and in splendour!

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: SAY: As to those who are in error, the God of Mercy will lengthen out to them a length of days

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: Until they see that with which they are threatened, whether it be some present chastisement, or whether it be "the Hour," and they shall then know which is in the worse state, and which the more weak in forces:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: But God will increase the guidance of the already guided.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And good works which abide, are in thy Lord's sight better in respect of guerdon, and better in the issue than all worldly good.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: Hast thou marked him who believeth not in our signs, and saith, "I shall surely have riches and children bestowed upon me?"

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: Hath he mounted up into the secrets of God? Hath he made a compact with the God of Mercy?

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: No! we will certainly write down what he saith, and will lengthen the length of his chastisement:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: And we will inherit what he spake of, and he shall come before us all alone.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: They have taken other gods beside God to be their help.27

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: But it shall not be. Those gods will disavow their worship and will become their enemies.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: Seest thou not that we send the Satans against the Infidels to urge them into sin?

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: Wherefore be not thou in haste with them;28 for a small number of days do we number to them.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: One day we will gather the God-fearing before the God of Mercy with honours due:29

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: But the sinners will we drive unto Hell, like flocks driven to the watering.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: None shall have power to intercede, save he who hath received permission at the hands of the God of Mercy.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: They say: "The God of Mercy hath gotten offspring." Now have ye done a monstrous thing!

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: Almost might the very Heavens be rent thereat, and the Earth cleave asunder, and the mountains fall down in fragments,

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: That they ascribe a son to the God of Mercy, when it beseemeth not the God of Mercy to beget a son!

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: Verily there is none in the Heavens and in the Earth but shall approach the God of Mercy as a servant. He hath taken note of them, and numbered them with exact numbering:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: And each of them shall come to Him, on the day of Resurrection, singly:

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: But love will the God of Mercy vouchsafe to those who believe and do the things that be right.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: Verily we have made this Koran easy and in thine own tongue, that thou mayest announce glad tidings by it to the God-fearing, and that thou mayest warn the contentious by it.

records.label: Surah 19 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: How many generations have we destroyed before them! Canst thou search out one of them? or canst thou hear a whisper from them?

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: TA. HA.2 Not to sadden thee have we sent down this Koran to thee,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: But as a warning for him who feareth;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: It is a missive from Him who hath made the earth and the lofty heavens!

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: The God of Mercy sitteth on his throne:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: His, whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and whatsoever is between them both, and whatsoever is beneath the humid soil!

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Thou needest not raise thy voice:3 for He knoweth the secret whisper, and the yet more hidden.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: God! There is no God but He! Most excellent His titles!

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Hath the history of Moses reached thee?

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: When he saw a fire, and said to his family, "Tarry ye here, for I perceive a fire:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Haply I may bring you a brand from it, or find at the fire a guide."4

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And when he came to it, he was called to, "O Moses!

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Verily, I am thy Lord:. therefore pull off thy shoes: for thou art in the holy valley of Towa.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And I have chosen thee: hearken then to what shall be revealed.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Verily, I am God: there is no God but me: therefore worship me, and observe prayer for a remembrance of me.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Verily the hour is coming:-I all but manifest it-

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: That every soul may be recompensed for its labours.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Nor let him who believeth not therein and followeth his lust, turn thee aside from this truth, and thou perish.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Now, what is that in thy right hand, O Moses?"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Said he, "It is my staff on which I lean, and with which I beast down leaves for my sheep, and I have other uses for it."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: He said, "Cast it down, O Moses!"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: So he cast it down, and lo! it became a serpent that ran along.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: He said, "Lay hold on it, and fear not: to its former state will we restore it."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: "Now place thy right hand to thy arm-pit: it shall come forth white, but unhurt:-another sign!-

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: That We may shew thee the greatest of our signs.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Go to Pharaoh, for he hath burst all bounds."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: He said, "O my Lord! enlarge my breast for me,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And make my work easy for me,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And loose the knot of my tongue,5

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: That they may understand my speech.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And give me a counsellor6 from among my family,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Aaron my brother;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: By him gird up my loins,7

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And make him a colleague in my work,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: That we may praise thee oft and oft remember thee,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: For thou regardest us."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: He said, "O Moses, thou hast obtained thy suit:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Already, at another time, have we showed thee favour,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: When we spake unto thy mother what was spoken:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: 'Cast him into the ark:8 then cast him on the sea [the river], and the sea shall throw him on the shore: and an enemy to me and an enemy to him shall take him up.' And I myself have made thee an object of love,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: That thou mightest be reared in mine eye.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: When thy sister went and said, 'Shall I shew you one who will nurse him?'9 Then We returned thee to thy mother that her eye might be cheered, and that she might not grieve. And when thou slewest a person, We delivered thee from trouble, and We tried thee with other trial.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: For years didst thou stay among the people of Midian; then camest thou hither by my decree, O Moses:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: And I have chosen thee for Myself.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Go thou and thy brother with my signs and be not slack to remember me.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Go ye to Pharaoh, for he hath burst all bounds:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: But speak ye to him with gentle speech; haply he will reflect or fear."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: They said, "O our Lord! truly we fear lest he break forth against us, or act with exceeding injustice."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: He said, "Fear ye not, for I am with you both. I will hearken and I will behold.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: Go ye then to him and say, 'Verily we are Sent ones of thy Lord; send therefore the children of Israel with us and vex them not: now are we come to thee with signs from thy Lord, and, Peace shall be on him who followeth the right guidance.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: For now hath it been revealed to us, that chastisement shall be on him who chargeth with falsehood, and turneth him away."'

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And he said, "Who is your Lord, O Moses?"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: He said, "Our Lord is He who hath given to everything its form and then guideth it aright."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: "But what," said he, "was the state of generations past?"10

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: He said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in the Book of his decrees. My Lord erreth not, nor forgetteth.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: He hath spread the earth as a bed, and hath traced out paths for you therein, and hath sent down rain from Heaven, and by it we bring forth the kinds11 of various herbs:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: -'Eat ye, and feed your cattle.' Of a truth in this are signs unto men endued with understanding.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: From it have we created you, and into it will we return you, and out of it will we bring you forth a second time."12

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: And we shewed him all our signs: but he treated them as falsehoods, and refused to believe.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: He said, "Hast thou come, O Moses, to drive us from our land by thine enchantments?

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Therefore will we assuredly confront thee with like enchantments: so appoint a meeting between us and you-we will not fail it, we, and do not thou-in a place alike for both."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: He said, "On the feast day13 be your meeting, and in broad daylight let the people be assembled."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And Pharaoh turned away, and collected his craftsmen and came.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Said Moses to them, "Woe to you! devise not a lie against God:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: For then will he destroy you by a punishment. They who have lied have ever perished."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: And the magicians discussed their plan, and spake apart in secret:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: They said, "These two are surely sorcerers: fain would they drive you from your land by their sorceries, and lead away in their paths your chiefest men:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: So muster your craft: then come in order: well this day shall it be for him, who shall gain the upper hand."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: They said, "O Moses, wilt thou first cast down thy rod, or shall we be the first who cast?"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: He said, "Yes, cast ye down first." And lo! by their enchantment their cords and rods seemed to him as if they ran.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: And Moses conceived a secret fear within him.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: We said, "Fear not, for thou shalt be the uppermost:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: Cast forth then what is in thy right hand: it shall swallow up what they have produced: they have only produced the deceit of an enchanter: and come where he may, ill shall an enchanter fare."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: And the magicians fell down and worshipped. They said,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: "We believe in the Lord of Aaron and of Moses."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: Said Pharaoh, "Believe ye on him ere I give you leave? He, in sooth, is your Master who hath taught you magic. I will therefore cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on trunks of the palm, and assuredly shall ye learn which of us is severest in punishing, and who is the more abiding."14

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: They said, "We will not have more regard to thee than to the clear tokens which have come to us, or than to Him who hath made us: doom the doom thou wilt: Thou canst only doom as to this present life: of a truth we have believed on our Lord that he may pardon us our sins and the sorcery to which thou hast forced us, for God is better, and more abiding than thou.15

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: As for him who shall come before his Lord laden with crime-for him verily is Hell: he shall not die in it and he shall not live.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: But he who shall come before Him, a believer, with righteous works,-these! the loftiest grades await them:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: Gardens of Eden, beneath whose trees16 the rivers flow: therein shall they abide for ever. This, the reward of him who hath been pure."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: Then revealed we to Moses, "Go forth by night with my servants and cleave for them a dry path in the sea;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: Fear not thou to be overtaken, neither be thou afraid."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: And Pharaoh followed them with his hosts, and the whelming billows of the sea overwhelmed them,17 for Pharaoh misled his people, and did not guide them.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: O children of Israel! we rescued you from your foes; and We appointed a meeting with you on the right side of the mountain; and We caused the manna and the quail to descend upon you:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: "Eat," said We, "of the good things with which we have supplied you; but without excess, lest my wrath fall upon you; for on whom my wrath doth fall, he perisheth outright.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: Surely however will I forgive him who turneth to God and believeth, and worketh righteousness, and then yieldeth to guidance.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: But what hath hastened thee on apart from thy people,18 O Moses?"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: He said, "They are hard on my footsteps: but to thee, O Lord, have I hastened, that thou mightest be well pleased with me."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: He said, "Of a truth now have we proved thy people since thou didst leave them, and Samiri19 had led them astray."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: And Moses returned to his people, angered, sorrowful.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: He said, "O my people! did not your Lord promise you a good promise? Was the time of my absence long to you? or desired ye that wrath from your Lord should light upon you, that ye failed in your promise to me?"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: They said, "Not of our own accord have we failed in the promise to thee, but we were made to bring loads of the people's trinkets, and we threw them into the fire and Samiri likewise cast them in, and brought forth to them a corporeal lowing20 calf: and they said, "This is your God and the God of Moses, whom he hath forgotten."'

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: What! saw they not that it returned them no answer, and could neither hurt nor help them?

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: And Aaron had before said to them, "O my people! by this calf are ye only proved: surely your Lord is the God of Mercy: follow me therefore and obey my bidding."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: They said, "We will not cease devotion to it, till Moses come back to us."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: He said, "O Aaron! when thou sawest that they had gone astray, what hindered thee from following me? Hast thou then disobeyed my command?"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: He said, "O Son of my mother! seize me not by my beard, nor by my head: indeed I feared lest thou shouldst say,

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: Thou hast rent the children of Isreal asunder, and hast not observed my orders."'

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: He said, "And what was thy motive, O Samiri?" He said, "I saw what they saw not: so I took a handful of dust from the track21 of the messenger of God, and flung it into the calf, for so my soul prompted me."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 100
records.text: He said, "Begone then: verily thy doom even in this life shall be to say, 'Touch me not.'22 And there is a threat against thee, which thou shalt not escape hereafter. Now look at thy god to which thou hast continued so devoted: we will surely burn it and reduce it to ashes, which we will cast into the sea.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 101
records.text: Your God is God, beside whom there is no God: In his knowledge he embraceth all things."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 102
records.text: Thus do We recite to thee histories of what passed of old; and from ourself have we given thee admonition.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 103
records.text: Whoso shall turn aside from it shall verily carry a burden on the day of Resurrection:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 104
records.text: Under it shall they remain: and grievous, in the day of Resurrection, shall it be to them to bear.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 105
records.text: On that day there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and We will gather the wicked together on that day with leaden23 eyes:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 106
records.text: They shall say in a low voice, one to another,-"Ye tarried but ten days on earth."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 107
records.text: We are most knowing with respect to that which they will say when the most veracious24 of them will say. "Ye have not tarried above a day."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 108
records.text: And they will ask thee of the mountains: SAY: scattering my Lord will scatter them in dust;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 109
records.text: And he will leave them a level plain: thou shalt see in it no hollows or jutting hills.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 110
records.text: On that day shall men follow their summoner25-he marcheth straight on: and low shall be their voices before the God of Mercy, nor shalt thou hear aught but the light footfall.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 111
records.text: No intercession shall avail on that day, save his whom the God of Mercy shall allow to intercede, and whose words he shall approve.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 112
records.text: He knoweth their future and their past; but in their own knowledge they comprehend it not:-

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 113
records.text: And humble shall be their faces before Him that Liveth, the Self-subsisting: and undone he, who shall bear the burden of iniquity;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 114
records.text: But he who shall have done the things that are right and is a believer, shall fear neither wrong nor loss.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 115
records.text: Thus have We sent down to thee an Arabic Koran, and have set forth menaces therein diversely, that haply they may fear God, or that it may give birth to reflection in them.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 116
records.text: Exalted then be God, the King, the Truth! Be not hasty in its recital26 while the revelation of it to thee is incomplete. Say rather, "O my Lord, increase knowledge unto me."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 117
records.text: And of old We made a covenant with Adam; but he forgat it; and we found no firmness of purpose in him.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 118
records.text: And when We said to the angels, "Fall down and worship Adam," they worshipped all, save Eblis, who refused: and We said, "O Adam! this truly is a foe to thee and to thy wife. Let him not therefore drive you out of the garden, and ye become wretched;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 119
records.text: For to thee is it granted that thou shalt not hunger therein, neither shalt thou be naked;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 120
records.text: But Satan whispered him: said he, "O Adam! shall I shew thee the tree of Eternity,27 and the Kingdom that faileth not?"

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 121
records.text: And they both ate thereof, and their nakedness appeared to them, and they began to sew of the leaves of the Garden to cover them, and Adam disobeyed his Lord and went astray.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 122
records.text: Afterwards his Lord chose him for himself, and was turned towards him, and guided him.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 123
records.text: And God said, "Get ye all down hence, the one of you a foe unto the other. Hereafter shall guidance come unto you from me;

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 124
records.text: And whoso followeth my guidance shall not err, and shall not be wretched:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 125
records.text: But whoso turneth away from my monition, his truly shall be a life of misery:

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 126
records.text: And We will assemble him with others on the day of Resurrection, blind."28

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 127
records.text: He will say, "O my Lord! why hast thou assembled me with others, blind? whereas I was endowed with sight."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 128
records.text: He will answer, "Thus is it, because our signs came unto thee and thou didst forget them, and thus shalt thou be forgotten this day."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 129
records.text: Even thus will We recompense him who hath transgressed and hath not believed in the signs of his Lord; and assuredly the chastisement of the next world will be more severe and more lasting.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 130
records.text: Are not they, who walk the very places where they dwelt, aware how many generations we have destroyed before them? Verily in this are signs to men of insight.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 131
records.text: And had not a decree of respite from thy Lord first gone forth, their chastisement had at once ensued. Yet the time is fixed.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 132
records.text: Put up then with what they say; and celebrate the praise of thy Lord before the sunrise, and before its setting; and some time in the night do thou praise him, and in the extremes29 of the day, that thou haply mayest please Him.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 133
records.text: And strain not thine eye after what We have bestowed on divers of them-the braveries of this world-that we may thereby prove them. The portion which thy Lord will give, is better and more lasting.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 134
records.text: Enjoin prayer on thy family, and persevere therein. We ask not of thee to find thine own provision-we will provide for thee, and a happy issue shall there be to piety.

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 135
records.text: But they say, "If he come not to us with a sign from his Lord . . .!"30 But have not clear proofs for the Koran come to them, in what is in the Books of old?

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 136
records.text: And had We destroyed them by a chastisement before its time, they would surely have said, "O our Lord! How could we believe if thou didst not send unto us an Apostle that we might follow thy signs ere that we were humbled and disgraced."

records.label: Surah 20 · edition paragraph 137
records.text: SAY: Each one of us awaiteth the end. Wait ye then, and ye shall know which of us have been followers of the even way, and who hath been the rightly guided.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: THIS people's reckoning hath drawn nigh, yet, sunk in carelessness, they turn aside.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Every fresh warning that cometh to them from their Lord they only hear to mock it,-

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Their hearts set on lusts: and they who have done this wrong say in secret discourse, "Is He more than a man like yourselves? What! will ye, with your eyes open,1 accede to sorcery?"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: SAY: "My Lord knoweth what is spoken in the heaven and on the earth: He is the Hearer, the Knower."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: "Nay," say they, "it is the medley of dreams: nay, he hath forged it: nay, he is a poet: let him come to us with a sign as the prophets of old were sent."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Before their time, none of the cities which we have destroyed, believed: will these men, then, believe?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And we sent none, previous to thee, but men to whom we had revealed ourselves. Ask ye the people who are warned by Scriptures,2 if ye know it not.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: We gave them not bodies which could dispense with food: and they were not to live for ever.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Then made we good our promise to them; and we delivered them and whom we pleased, and we destroyed the transgressors.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And now have we sent down to you "the book," in which is your warning: What, will ye not then understand?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And how many a guilty city have we broken down, and raised up after it other peoples:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And when they felt our vengeance, lo! they fled from it.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: "Flee not," said the angels in mockery, "but come back to that wherein ye revelled, and to your abodes! Questions will haply be put to you."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: They said, "Oh, woe to us! Verily we have been evil doers."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And this ceased not to be their cry, until we made them like reaped corn, extinct.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: We created not the heaven and the earth, and what is between them, for sport:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Had it been our wish to find a pastime, we had surely found it in ourselves;- if to do so had been our will.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Nay, we will hurl the truth at falsehood, and it shall smite it, and lo! it shall vanish. But woe be to you for what ye utter of God!

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: All beings in the heaven and on the earth are His: and they who are in his presence disdain not his service, neither are they wearied:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: They praise Him night and day: they rest not.3

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Have they taken gods from the earth who can quicken the dead?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Had there been in either heaven or earth gods besides God, both surely had gone to ruin. But glory be to God, the Lord of the throne, beyond what they utter!

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: He shall not be asked of his doings, but they shall be asked.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Have they taken other gods beside Him? SAY; Bring forth your proofs that they are gods. This is the warning of those who are with me, and the warning of those who were before me: but most of them know not the truth, and turn aside.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: No apostle have we sent before thee to whom we did not reveal that "Verily there is no God beside me: therefore worship me."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Yet they say, "The God of Mercy hath begotten issue from the angels." Glory be to Him! Nay, they are but His honoured servants:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: They speak not till He hath spoken;4 and they do His bidding.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them; and no plea shall they offer

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Save for whom He pleaseth; and they tremble for fear of Him.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And that angel among them who saith "I am a god beside Him," will we recompense with hell: in such sort will we recompense the offenders.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Do not the infidels see that the heavens and the earth were both a solid mass, and that we clave them asunder, and that by means of water we give life to everything? Will they not then believe?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And we set mountains on the earth lest it should move with them, and we made on it broad passages between them as routes for their guidance;

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And we made the heaven a roof strongly upholden; yet turn they away from its signs.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And He it is who hath created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each moving swiftly in its sphere.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: At no time5 have we granted to man a life that shall last for ever: if thou then die, shall they live for ever?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Every soul shall taste of death:6 and for trial will we prove you with evil and with good; and unto Us shall ye be brought back.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And when the infidels see thee they receive thee only with scoffs:-"What! is this he who maketh such mention of your gods?" Yet when mention is made to them of the God of Mercy, they believe not.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: "Man," say they, "is made up of haste."7 But I will shew you my signs:8 desire them not then to be hastened.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: They say, "When will this threat be made good? Tell us, if ye be men of truth?"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Did the infidels but know the time when they shall not be able to keep the fire of hell from their faces or from their backs, neither shall they be helped!

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: But it shall come on them suddenly and shall confound them; and they shall not be able to put it back, neither shall they be respited.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Other apostles have been scoffed at before thee: but that doom at which they mocked encompassed the scoffers.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: SAY: Who shall protect you by night and by day from the God of Mercy? Yet turn they away from the warning of their Lord.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Have they gods beside Us who can defend them? For their own succour have they no power; neither shall the gods they join with God screen them from Us.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Yes! we have given these men and their fathers enjoyments so long as their life lasted. What! see they not that we come to a land and straiten its borders9 Is it they who are the conquerors?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: SAY: I only warn you of what hath been revealed to me: but the deaf will not hear the call, whenever they are warned;

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Yet if a breath of thy Lord's chastisement touch them, they will assuredly say, "Oh! woe to us! we have indeed been offenders."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Just balances will we set up for the day of the resurrection, neither shall any soul be wronged in aught; though, were a work but the weight of a grain of mustard seed, we would bring it forth to be weighed: and our reckoning will suffice.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: We gave of old to Moses and Aaron the illumination,10 and a light and a warning for the God-fearing,

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Who dread their Lord in secret, and who tremble for "the Hour."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And this Koran which we have sent down is a blessed warning: will ye then disown it?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: Of old we gave unto Abraham his direction,11 for we knew him worthy.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: When he said to his Father and to his people, "What are these images to which ye are devoted?"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: They said, "We found our fathers worshipping them."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: He said, "Truly ye and your fathers have been in a plain mistake."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: They said, "Hast thou come unto us in earnest? or art thou of those who jest?"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: He said, "Nay, your Lord is Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, who hath created them both; and to this am I one of those who witness:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: -And, by God, I will certainly lay a plot against your idols, after ye shall have retired and turned your backs."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: So, he broke them all in pieces, except the chief of them, that to it they might return, inquiring.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: They said, "Who hath done this to our gods? Verily he is one of the unjust."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: They said, "We heard a youth make mention of them: they call him Abraham."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: They said, "Then bring him before the people's eyes, that they may witness against him."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: They said, "Hast thou done this to our gods, O Abraham?"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: He said, "Nay, that their chief hath done it: but ask ye them, if they can speak."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: So they turned their thoughts upon themselves, and said, "Ye truly are the impious persons:"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: Then became headstrong in their former error12 and exclaimed,"Thou knowest that these speak not."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: He said, "What! do ye then worship, instead of God, that which doth not profit you at all, nor injure you? Fie on you and on that ye worship instead of God! What! do ye not then understand?"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: They said:13 "Burn him, and come to the succour of your gods: if ye will do anything at all."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: We said, "O fire! be thou cold, and to Abraham a safety!"14

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: And they sought to lay a plot against him, but we made them the sufferers.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: And we brought him and Lot in safety to the land which we have blessed for all human beings:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: And we gave him Isaac and Jacob as a farther gift, and we made all of them righteous:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: We also made them models who should guide others by our command, and we inspired them with good deeds and constancy in prayer and almsgiving, and they worshipped us.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: And unto Lot we gave wisdom, and knowledge; and we rescued him from the city which wrought filthiness; for they were a people, evil, perverse:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And we caused him to enter into our mercy, for he was of the righteous.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: And remember Noah when aforetime he cried to us and we heard him, and delivered him and his family from the great calamity;

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: And we helped him against the people who treated our signs as impostures. An evil people verily were they, and we drowned them all.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: And David and Solomon; when they gave judgment concerning a field when some people's sheep had caused a waste therein; and we were witnesses of their judgment.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And we gave Solomon insight into the affair; and on both of them we bestowed wisdom and knowledge. And we constrained the mountains and the birds to join with David in our praise: Our doing was it!

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: And we taught David the art of making mail15 for you, to defend you from each other's violence: will ye therefore be thankful?

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: And to Solomon we subjected we subjected the strongly blowing wind; it sped at his bidding to the land we had blessed; for we know all things:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: And sundry Satans16 who should dive for him and perform other work beside: and we kept watch over them.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: And remember Job: When he cried to his Lord, "Truly evil hath touched me: but thou art the most merciful of those who shew mercy."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: So we heard him, and lightened the burden of his woe; and we gave him back his family, and as many more with them,-a mercy from us, and a memorial for those who serve us:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: And Ismael, and Edris17 and Dhoulkefl18-all steadfast in patience.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: And we caused them to enter into our mercy; for they were of the righteous:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: And Dhoulnoun;19 when he went on his way in anger, and thought that we had no power over him. But in the darkness he cried "There is no God but thou: Glory be unto Thee! Verily, I have been one of the evil doers:"

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: So we heard him and rescued him from misery: for thus rescue we the faithful:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: And Zacharias; when he called upon his Lord saying, "O my Lord, leave me not childless: but there is no better heir than Thyself."20

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: So we heard him, and gave him John, and we made his wife fit for child- bearing. Verily, these vied in goodness, and called upon us with love and fear, and humbled themselves before us:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: And her who kept her maidenhood, and into whom21 we breathed of our spirit, and made her and her son a sign to all creatures.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: Of a truth, this, your religion, is the one22 Religion, and I your Lord; therefore serve me:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: But they have rent asunder this their great concern among themselves into sects. All of them shall return to us.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: And whoso shall do the things that are right, and be a believer, his efforts shall not be disowned: and surely will we write them down for him.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: There is a ban on every city which we shall have destroyed, that they shall not rise again,

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: Until a way is opened for Gog and Magog,23 and they shall hasten from every high land,

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: And this sure promise shall draw on. And lo! the eyes of the infidels shall stare amazedly; and they shall say, "Oh, our misery! of this were we careless! yea, we were impious persons."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: Verily, ye, and what ye worship beside God,24 shall be fuel for hell: ye shall go down into it.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 100
records.text: Were these gods, they would not go down into it; but they shall all abide in it for ever.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 101
records.text: Therein shall they groan; but nought therein shall they hear to comfort them.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 102
records.text: But they for whom we have before ordained good things, shall be far away from it:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 103
records.text: Its slightest sound they shall not hear: in what their souls longed for, they shall abide for ever:

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 104
records.text: The great terror shall not trouble them; and the angel shall meet them with, "This is your day which ye were promised."

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 105
records.text: On that day we will roll up the heaven as one rolleth up25 written scrolls. As we made the first creation, so will we bring it forth again. This promise bindeth us; verily, we will perform it.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 106
records.text: And now, since the Law was given, have we written in the Psalms that "my servants, the righteous, shall inherit the earth."26

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 107
records.text: Verily, in this Koran is teaching for those who serve God.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 108
records.text: We have not sent thee otherwise than as mercy unto all creatures.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 109
records.text: SAY: Verily it hath been revealed to me that your God is one God; are ye then resigned to Him? (Muslims.)

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 110
records.text: But if they turn their backs, then SAY: I have warned you all alike; but I know not whether that with which ye are threatened be nigh or distant.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 111
records.text: God truly knoweth what is spoken aloud, and He also knoweth that which ye hide.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 112
records.text: And I know not whether haply this delay be not for your trial, and that ye may enjoy yourselves for a time.

records.label: Surah 21 · edition paragraph 113
records.text: My Lord saith: Judge ye with truth; for our Lord is the God of Mercy-whose help is to be sought against what ye utter.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O MEN of Mecca, fear your Lord. Verily, the earthquake of the last Hour will be a tremendous thing!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: On the day when ye shall behold it, every suckling woman shall forsake her sucking babe; and every woman that hath a burden in her womb shall cast her burden; and thou shalt see men drunken, yet are they not drunken: but it is the mighty chastisement of God!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: There is a man2 who, without knowledge, wrangleth about God, and followeth every rebellious Satan;

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Concerning whom it is decreed, that he shall surely beguile and guide into the torment of the Flame, whoever shall take him for his Lord.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: O men! if ye doubt as to the resurrection, yet, of a truth, have We created you of dust, then of the moist germs of life, then of clots of blood, then of pieces of flesh shapen and unshapen, that We might give you proofs of our power! And We cause one sex or the other, at our pleasure, to abide in the womb until the appointed time; then We bring you forth infants; then permit you to reach your age of strength; and one of you dieth, and another of you liveth on to an age so abject that all his former knowledge is clean forgotten!3 And thou hast seen the earth dried up and barren: but when We send down the rain upon it, it stirreth and swelleth, and groweth every kind of luxuriant herb.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: This, for that God is the Truth, and that it is He who quickeneth the dead,- and that He hath power over everything:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And that "the Hour" will indeed come-there is no doubt of it-and that God will wake up to life those who are in the tombs.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: A man there is who disputeth about God without knowledge or guidance or enlightening Book,

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Turning aside in scorn to mislead others from the way of God! Disgrace shall be his in this world; and on the day of the resurrection, We will make him taste the torment of the burning:-

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: "This, for thy handywork of old! for God is not unjust to His servants."

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: There are some who serve God in a single point. If good come upon one of them, he resteth in it; but if trial come upon him, he turneth him round (to infidelity) with the loss both of this world and of the next! This same is the clear ruin!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: He calleth upon that beside God which can neither hurt him nor profit him. This same is the far-gone error!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: He calleth on him who would sooner hurt than profit him. Surely, bad the lord, and, surely, bad the vassal!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: But God will bring in those who shall believe and do the things that are right, into gardens 'neath which the rivers flow: for God doth that which He pleaseth.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Let him who thinketh that God will not help His Apostle in this world and in the next, stretch a cord aloft as if to destroy himself; then let him cut it, and see whether his devices can bring that4 to nought at which he was angry!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Thus send we down the Koran with its clear signs (verses): and because God guideth whom He pleaseth.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: As to those who believe, and the Jews, and the Sabeites,5 and the Christians, and the Magians, and those who join other gods with God, of a truth, God shall decide between them on the day of resurrection: for God is witness of all things.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Seest thou not that all in the Heavens and all on the Earth adoreth God? the sun and the moon and the stars, and the mountains, and the trees, and the beasts, and many men? But of many is chastisement the due:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And whom God shall disgrace there shall be none to honour: God doth that which pleaseth Him.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: These, the Faithful and the Infidels, are the two disputants who dispute concerning their Lord: but for those who have disbelieved, garments of fire shall be cut out; the boiling water shall be poured down upon their heads:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: All that is in their bowels, and their skins, shall be dissolved: and there are maces of iron for them!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: So oft as they, for very anguish, would fain come forth thence, back shall they be turned into it: and-"Taste ye the torment of the burning."

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: But God will bring in those who shall have believed, and done the things that are right, into gardens 'neath which the rivers flow. Adorned shall they be therein with golden bracelets and with pearls, and their raiment therein shall be of silk;

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: For they were guided to the best of words; guided to the glorious path!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: But those who believe not, and seduce others from the way of God, and from the Holy Mosque which we have appointed to all men, alike for those who abide therein, and for the stranger;

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And those who seek impiously to profane it, we will cause to taste a grievous punishment.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And call to mind when we assigned the site of the House6 to Abraham and said: "Unite not aught with Me in worship, and cleanse My House for those who go in procession round it, and who stand or bow in worship:"-

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And proclaim to the peoples a PILGRIMAGE: Let them come to thee on foot and on every fleet7 camel, arriving by every deep defile:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: That they may bear witness of its benefits to them, and may make mention of God's name on the appointed days,8 over the brute beasts with which He hath supplied them for sustenance: Therefore eat thereof yourselves, and feed the needy, the poor:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Then let them bring the neglect of their persons to a close,9 and let them pay their vows, and circuit the ancient House.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: This do. And he that respecteth the sacred ordinances of God, this will be best for him with his Lord. The flesh of cattle is allowed you, save of those already specified to you. Shun ye, therefore, the pollutions of idols; and shun ye the word of falsehood;

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Sound in faith Godward, uniting no god with Him; for whoever uniteth gods with God, is like that which falleth from on high, and the birds snatch it away, or the wind wafteth it to a distant place.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: This do. And they who respect the rites of God, perform an action which proceedeth from piety of heart.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Ye may obtain advantages from the cattle up to the set time for slaying them: then, the place for sacrificing them is at the ancient House.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And to every people have we appointed rites, that they may commemorate the name of God over the brute beasts which He hath provided for them. And your God is the one God. To Him, therefore, surrender yourselves: and bear thou good tidings to those who humble them,-

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Whose hearts, when mention is made of God, thrill with awe; and to those who remain steadfast under all that be-falleth them, and observe prayer, and give alms of that with which we have supplied them.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And the camels have we appointed you for the sacrifice to God: much good have ye in them. Make mention, therefore, of the name of God over them when ye slay them, as they stand in a row; and when they are fallen over on their sides, eat of them, and feed him who is content and asketh not, and him who asketh. Thus have We subjected them to you, to the intent ye should be thankful.10

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: By no means can their flesh reach unto God, neither their blood; but piety on your part reacheth Him. Thus hath He subjected them to you, that ye might magnify God for His guidance: moreover, announce to those who do good deeds-

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: That God will ward off mischief from believers: for God loveth not the false, the Infidel.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: A sanction is given to those who, because they have suffered outrages, have taken up arms; and verily, God is well able to succour them:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Those who have been driven forth from their homes wrongfully, only because they say "Our Lord is the God." And if God had not repelled some men by others, cloisters, and churches, and oratories, and mosques, wherein the name of God is ever commemorated, would surely have been destroyed. And him who helpeth God will God surely help:11 for God is right Strong, Mighty:-

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Those who, if we establish them in this land, will observe prayer, and pay the alms of obligation, and enjoin what is right, and forbid what is evil. And the final issue of all things is unto God.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Moreover, if they charge thee with imposture, then already, before them, the people of Noah, and Ad and Themoud, and the people of Abraham, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers in Madian, have charged their prophets with imposture! Moses, too, was charged with imposture! And I bore long with the unbelievers; then seize on them: and how great was the change I wrought!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: And how many cities which had been ungodly, and whose roofs are now laid low in ruin, have We destroyed! And wells have been abandoned and lofty castles!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Have they not journeyed through the land? Have they not hearts to understand with, or ears to hear with? It is not that to these sights their eyes are blind, but the hearts in their breasts are blind!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And they will bid thee to hasten the chastisement. But God cannot fail His threat. And verily, a day with thy Lord is as a thousand years,12 as ye reckon them!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: How many cities have I long borne with, wicked though they were, yet then laid hold on them to chastise them! Unto Me shall all return.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: SAY: O men! I am only your open warner:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: And they who believe and do the things that are right, shall have forgiveness and an honourable provision;

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: But those who strive to invalidate our signs shall be inmates of Hell.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: We have not sent any apostle or prophet before thee, among whose desires Satan injected not some wrong desire, but God shall bring to nought that which Satan had suggested. Thus shall God affirm His revelations13 for God is Knowing, Wise!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: That He may make that which Satan hath injected, a trial to those in whose hearts is a disease, and whose hearts are hardened.-Verily, the wicked are in a far-gone severance from the truth!-

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And that they to whom "the Knowledge" hath been given, may know that the Koran is the truth from thy Lord, and may believe in it, and their hearts may acquiesce in it: for God is surely the guider of those who believe, into the straight path.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: But the Infidels will not cease to doubt concerning it, until "the Hour" come suddenly upon them, or until the chastisement of the day of desolation come upon them.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: On that day the Kingdom shall be God's: He shall judge between them: and they who shall have believed and done the things that are right, shall be in gardens of delight:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: But they who were Infidels and treated our signs as lies-these then-their's a shameful chastisement!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: And as to those who fled their country for the cause of God, and were afterwards slain, or died, surely with goodly provision will God provide for them! for verily, God! He, surely, is the best of providers!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: He will assuredly bring them in with an in-bringing that shall please them well: for verily, God is right Knowing, Gracious.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: So shall it be. And whoever in making exact reprisal for injury done him, shall again be wronged, God will assuredly aid him: for God is most Merciful, Gracious.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: So shall it be; for that God causeth the night to enter in upon the day, and He causeth the day to enter in upon the night: and for that God Heareth, Seeth.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: So shall it be, for that God is the truth; and because what they call on beside Him is vanity: and because God is the Lofty, the Mighty!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Seest thou not that God sendeth down water from Heaven, and that on the morrow the earth is clad with verdure? for God is benignant, cognisant of all.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: His, all in the Heavens and all on Earth: and verily, God! He assuredly is the Rich, the Praiseworthy!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Seest thou not that God hath put under you whatever is in the earth; and the ships which traverse the sea at His bidding? And He holdeth back the heaven that it fall not on the earth, unless He permit it! for God is right Gracious to mankind, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: And He it is who hath given you life, then will cause you to die, then will give you life-of a truth man is all ungrateful.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: To every people have we appointed observances which they observe. Therefore, let them not dispute this matter with thee, but bid them to thy Lord, for thou art on the right way:

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: But if they debate with thee, then Say: God best knoweth what ye do!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: God will judge between you on the day of resurrection, as to the matters wherein ye differ.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: Knowest thou not that God knoweth whatever is in the Heaven and on the Earth? This truly is written in the Book: this truly is easy for God.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: They worship beside God, that for which He hath sent down no warranty, and that of which they have no knowledge: but for those who commit this wrong, no helper!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: And when our clear signs are rehearsed to them, thou mayst perceive disdain in the countenances of the Infidels. Scarce can they refrain from rushing to attack those who rehearse our signs to them! SAY: Shall I tell you of worse than this? The fire which God hath threatened to those who believe not! Wretched the passage thither!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: O men! a parable is set forth to you, wherefore hearken to it. Verily, they on whom ye call beside God, cannot create a fly, though they assemble for it; and if the fly carry off aught from them, they cannot take it away from it! Weak the suppliant and the supplicated!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: Unworthy the estimate they form of God!14 for God is right Powerful, Mighty!

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: God chooseth messengers from among the angels and from among men: verily, God Heareth, Seeth.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them; and unto God shall all things return.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Believers! bow down and prostrate yourselves and worship your Lord, and work righteousness that you may fare well.

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: And do valiantly in the cause of God as it behoveth you to do for Him. He hath elected you, and hath not laid on you any hardship in religion, the Faith of your father Abraham. He hath named you the Muslims

records.label: Surah 22 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: Heretofore and in this Book, that the Apostles may be a witness against you, and that ye may be witnesses against the rest of mankind. Therefore observe prayer, and pay the legal impost, and cleave fast to God. He is your liege Lord-a goodly Lord, and a goodly Helper!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HAPPY now the BELIEVERS,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Who humble them in their prayer,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And who keep aloof from vain words,2

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And who are doers of alms deeds,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And who restrain their appetites,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: (Save with their wives, or the slaves whom their right hands possess: for in that case they shall be free from blame:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But they whose desires reach further than this are transgressors:)

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And who tend well their trusts and their covenants,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And who keep them strictly to their prayers:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: These shall be the heritors,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Who shall inherit the paradise, to abide therein for ever.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Now of fine clay have we created man:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Then we placed him, a moist germ,3 in a safe abode;

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Then made we the moist germ a clot of blood: then made the clotted blood into a piece of flesh; then made the piece of flesh into bones: and we clothed the bones with flesh: then brought forth man of yet another make4-Blessed therefore be God, the most excellent of Makers5-

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Then after this ye shall surely die:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Then shall ye be waked up on the day of resurrection.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And we have created over you seven heavens:6-and we are not careless of the creation.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And we send down water from the Heaven in its due degree, and we cause it to settle on the earth;-and we have power for its withdrawal:-

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And by it we cause gardens of palm trees, and vineyards to spring forth for you, in which ye have plenteous fruits, and whereof ye eat;

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And the tree that groweth up on Mount Sinai; which yieldeth oil and a juice for those who eat.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And there is a lesson for you in the cattle: We give you to drink of what is in their bellies, and many advantages do ye derive from them, and for food they serve you;

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And on them and on ships are ye borne.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: We sent Noah heretofore unto his people, and he said, "O my people! serve God: ye have no other God than He: will ye not therefore fear Him?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: But the chiefs of the people who believed not said, "This is but a man like yourselves: he fain would raise himself above you: but had it pleased God to send, He would have sent angels: We heard not of this with our sires of old;-

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Verily he is but a man possessed; leave him alone therefore for a time."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: He said, "O my Lord! help me against their charge of imposture."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: So we revealed unto him, "Make the ark under our eye, and as we have taught, and when our doom shall come on, and the earth's surface shall boil up,7

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Carry into it of every kind a pair, and thy family, save him on whom sentence hath already passed: and plead not with me for the wicked, for they shall be drowned.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And when thou, and they who shall be with thee, shall go up into the ark; say, 'Praise be unto God, who hath rescued us from the wicked folk.'

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And say, 'O my Lord! disembark me with a blessed disembarking: for thou art the best to disembark."'

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Verily in this were signs, and verily we made proof of man.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: We then raised up other generations after them;

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And we sent among them an apostle from out themselves, with, "Worship ye God! ye have no other God than He: will ye not therefore fear Him?"

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And the chiefs of His people who believed not, and who deemed the meeting with us in the life to come to be a lie, and whom we had richly supplied in this present life, said, "This is but a man like yourselves; he eateth of what ye eat,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And he drinketh of what ye drink:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And if ye obey a man like yourselves, then ye will surely be undone.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: What! doth he foretell you, that after ye shall be dead and become dust and bones, ye shall be brought forth?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Away, away with his predictions!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: There is no life beyond our present life; we die, and we live, and we shall not be quickened again!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: This is merely a man who forgeth a lie about God: and we will not believe him."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: He said, "O my Lord! help me against this charge of imposture."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: He said, "Yet a little, and they will soon repent them!"

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Then did the shout of the destroying angel in justice surprise them, we made them like leaves swept down by a torrent. Away then with the wicked people!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Then raised we up other generations after them-

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Neither too soon, nor too late, shall a people reach its appointed time-

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Then sent we our apostles one after another. Oft as their apostle presented himself to a nation, they treated him as a liar; and we caused one nation to follow another; and we made them the burden of a tale. Away then with the people who believe not!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Then sent we Moses and his brother Aaron, with our signs and manifest power,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: To Pharaoh and his princes; but they behaved them proudly, for they were a haughty people.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: And they said, "Shall we believe on two men like ourselves, whose people are our slaves?"

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And they treated them both as impostors; wherefore they became of the destroyed.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And we gave Moses the Book for Israel's guidance.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And we appointed the Son of Mary, and His mother for a sign; and we prepared an abode for both in a lofty spot,8 quiet, and watered with springs.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: "O ye apostles! eat of things that are good: and do that which is right: of your doings I am cognisant.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: And truly this your religion is the one religion;9 and I am your Lord: therefore fear me."
