records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: But men have rent their great concern, one among another, into sects; every party rejoicing in that which is their own;

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Wherefore leave them till a certain time, in their depths of error.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: What! think they that what we largely, bestow on them of wealth and children,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: We hasten to them for their good? Nay, they have no knowledge.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: But they who are awed with the dread of their Lord,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: And who believe in the signs of their Lord,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: And who join no other gods with their Lord,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And who give that which they give with hearts thrilled with dread because they must return unto their Lord,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: These hasten after good, and are the first to win it.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: We will not burden a soul beyond its power: and with us is a book, which speaketh the truth; and they shall not be wronged:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: But as to this Book, their hearts are plunged in error, and their works are far other than those of Muslims, and they will work those works,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: Until when we lay hold on their affluent ones with punishment; lo! they cry for help:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: -"Cry not for help this day, for by Us ye shall not be succoured:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Long since were my signs rehearsed to you, but ye turned back on your heels,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: Puffed up with pride, discoursing foolishly by night."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: Do they not then heed the things spoken-whether that hath come to them which came not to their fathers of old?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: Or do they not recognise their apostle; and therefore disavow him?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: Or say they, "A Djinn is in him?" Nay! he hath come to them with the truth; but the truth do most of them abhor.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: But if the truth had followed in the train of their desires, the heavens and the earth, and all that therein is, had surely come to ruin! But we have brought them their warning; and from their warning they withdraw.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: Dost thou ask them for remuneration? But, remuneration from thy Lord is best; and He is the best provider.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And thou indeed biddest them to the right path;

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: But verily they who believe not in the life to come, from that path do surely wander!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: And if we had taken compassion on them, and relieved them from their trouble, they would have plunged on in their wickedness, wildly wandering.10

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: We formerly laid hold on them with chastisement, yet they did not humble them to their Lord, nor did they abase them;

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: Until, when we have opened upon them the door of a severe punishment, lo! they are in despair at it.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: It is He who hath implanted in you hearing, and sight, and heart; how few of you give thanks!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: It is He who hath caused you to be born on the earth: and unto Him shall ye be gathered.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: And it is He who maketh alive and killeth, and of Him is the change of the night and of the day: Will ye not understand?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: But they say, as said those of old:-

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: They say,"What! When we shall be dead, and have become dust and bones, shall we, indeed, be waked to life?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: This have we been promised, we and our fathers aforetime: but it is only fables of the ancients."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: SAY: Whose is the earth, and all that is therein;-if ye know?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: They will answer, "God's." SAY: Will ye not, then reflect?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: SAY: Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the glorious throne?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: They will say, "They are God's". SAY: Will ye not, then, fear Him?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: SAY: In whose hand is the empire of all things, who protecteth but is not protected? if ye know:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: They will answer, "In God's." SAY: How, then, can ye be so spell-bound?

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: Yea, we have brought them the truth; but they are surely liars:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: God hath not begotten offspring; neither is there any other God with Him: else had each god assuredly taken away that which he had created,11 and some had assuredly uplifted themselves above others! Far from the glory of God, be what they affirm of Him!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: He knoweth alike the unseen and the seen: far be He uplifted above the gods whom they associate with Him!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: SAY: O my Lord! If thou wilt let me witness the infliction of that with which they have been threatened!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: O my Lord! place me not among the ungodly people.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: Verily, we are well able to make thee see the punishment with which we have threatened them.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: Turn aside evil with that which is better: we best know what they utter against thee.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 100
records.text: And SAY: "O my Lord! I betake me to Thee, against the promptings of the Satans:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 101
records.text: And I betake me to Thee, O my Lord! that they gain no hurtful access to me."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 102
records.text: When death overtaketh one of the wicked, he saith, "Lord, send me back again,

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 103
records.text: That I may do the good which I have left undone."12 "By no means." These are the very words which he shall speak:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 104
records.text: But behind them shall be a barrier, until the day when they shall be raised again.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 105
records.text: And when the trumpet shall be sounded, the ties of kindred between them shall cease on that day; neither shall they ask each other's help.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 106
records.text: They whose balances shall be heavy, shall be the blest.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 107
records.text: But they whose balances shall be light,-these are they who shall lose their souls, abiding in hell for ever:

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 108
records.text: The fire shall scorch their faces, and their lips shall quiver therein:-

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 109
records.text: -"What! Were not my signs rehearsed unto you? and did ye not treat them as lies?"

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 110
records.text: They shall say, "O our Lord! our ill-fortune prevailed against us, and we became an erring people.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 111
records.text: O our Lord! Bring us forth hence: if we go back again to our sins, we shall indeed be evil doers."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 112
records.text: He will say; "Be ye driven down into it; and, address me not."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 113
records.text: A part truly of my servants was there, who said, "O our Lord! we believe: forgive us, then, and be merciful to us, for of the merciful art thou the best."

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 114
records.text: But ye received them with such scoffs that they suffered you to forget my warning, and ye laughed them to scorn.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 115
records.text: Verily this day will I reward then, for their patient endurance: the blissful ones shall they be!

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 116
records.text: He will say, "What number of years tarried ye on earth?"

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 117
records.text: They will say, "We tarried a day, or part of a day;13 but ask the recording angels."14

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 118
records.text: God will say, "Short indeed was the time ye tarried, if that ye knew it.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 119
records.text: What! Did ye then think that we had created you for pastime, and that ye should not be brought back again to us?" Wherefore let God be exalted, the King, the Truth! There is no god but He! Lord of the stately throne! And whoso, together with God, shall call on another god, for whom he hath no proof, shall surely have to give account to his Lord. Aye, it shall fare ill with the infidels.

records.label: Surah 23 · edition paragraph 120
records.text: And SAY: "O my Lord, pardon, and have mercy; for of those who show mercy, art thou the best."

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: A SURA which we have sent down and sanctioned! Clear signs have we sent down therein, that ye may take warning.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: The whore and the whoremonger-scourge each of them with an hundred stripes; and let not compassion keep you from carrying out the sentence of God, if ye believe in God and the last day: And let some of the faithful witness their chastisement.1

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: The whoremonger shall not marry other than a whore or an idolatress; and the whore shall not marry other than a whoremonger or an idolater. Such alliances are forbidden to the faithful.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: They who defame virtuous women,2 and bring not four witnesses, scourge them with fourscore stripes, and receive ye not their testimony for ever, for these are perverse persons-

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Save those who afterwards repent and live virtuously; for truly God is Lenient, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And they who shall accuse their wives, and have no witnesses but themselves, the testimony of each of them shall be a testimony by God four times repeated, that he is indeed of them that speak the truth.3

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And the fifth time that the malison of God be upon him, if he be of them that lie.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: But it shall avert the chastisement from her if she testify a testimony four times repeated, by God, that he is of them that lie;

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And a fifth time to call down the wrath of God on her, if he have spoken the truth.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And but for the goodness and mercy of God towards you, and that God is He who loveth to turn, Wise . . . . !

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Of a truth, they who advanced that lie4 were a large number of you; but regard it not as an evil to you. No, it is an advantage to you.5 To every man among them shall it be done according to the offence he hath committed; and as to that person6 among them who took on himself to aggravate it, a sore punishment doth await him.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Did not the faithful of both sexes, when ye heard of this, form a favourable judgment in their own minds, and say,

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: "This is a manifest lie?"

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Have they brought four witnesses of the fact? If they cannot produce the witnesses, they are the liars in the sight of God.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And but for the goodness of God towards you, and His mercy in this world and in the next, a severe punishment had come upon you for that which ye spread abroad, when ye uttered with your tongues, and spake with your mouths that of which ye had no knowledge. Ye deemed it to be a light matter, but with God it was a grave one.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And did ye say when ye heard it, "It is not for us to talk of this affair! O God! By thy Glory, this is a gross calumny?"

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: God hath warned you that ye go not back to the like of this for ever, if ye be believers:

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And God maketh His signs clear to you: for God is Knowing, Wise.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: But as for those who love that foul calumnies should go forth against those who believe, a grievous chastisement awaits them

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: In this world and in the next. And God hath knowledge, but ye have not.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And but for the goodness of God towards you and His Mercy, and that God is Kind, Merciful . . . !

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: O ye who believe! follow not the steps of Satan, for whosoever shall follow the steps of Satan, he will enjoin on him what is base and blameworthy; and but for the goodness of God towards you,7 and His mercy, no one of you had been cleansed for ever: but God maketh whom He will to be clean, and God Heareth, Knoweth.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And let not persons of wealth and means among you swear that they will not give to their kindred, to the poor, and to those who have fled their homes in the cause of God; let them rather pardon and pass over the offence.8 Desire ye not that God should forgive you? And God is Gracious, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Verily, they who throw out charges against virtuous but careless women, who yet are believers, shall be cursed in this world and in the world to come; and a terrible punishment doth await them.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Their own tongues, and hands, and feet, shall one day bear witness against them of their own doings.9

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: On that day will God pay them their just due, and they shall know that God is the clear Truth itself.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Bad women for bad men, and bad men for bad women; but virtuous women for virtuous men, and virtuous men for virtuous women! These shall be cleared from calumnies; theirs shall be forgiveness and an honourable provision.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: O ye who believe! enter not into other houses10 than your own, until ye have asked leave, and have saluted its inmates. This will be best for you: haply ye will bear this in mind.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And if ye find no one therein, then enter it not till leave be given you; and if it be said to you, "Go ye back," then go ye back. This will be more blameless in you, and God knoweth what ye do.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: There shall be no harm in your entering houses in which no one dwelleth, for the supply of your needs: and God knoweth what ye do openly and what ye hide.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Speak unto the believers that they restrain their eyes and observe continence. Thus will they be more pure. God is well aware of what they do.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And speak to the believing women that they refrain their eyes, and observe continence; and that they display not their ornaments, except those which are external; and that they throw their veils over their bosoms, and display not their ornaments, except to their husbands or their fathers, or their husbands' fathers, or their sons, or their husbands' sons, or their brothers, or their brothers' sons, or their sisters' sons, or their women, or their slaves, or male domestics who have no natural force, or to children who note not women's nakedness. And let them not strike their feet together, so as to discover their hidden ornaments.11 And be ye all turned to God, O ye Believers! that it may be well with you.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And marry those among you who are single, and your good servants, and the handmaidens. If they are poor, God of His bounty will enrich them. God is all-bounteous, Knowing.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And let those who cannot find a match12 live in continence till God of His bounty shall enrich them. And to those of your slaves who desire a deed of manumission, execute it for them, if ye know good in them, and give them a portion of the wealth of God which He hath given you.13 Force not your female slaves into sin, in order that ye may gain the casual fruitions of this world, if they wish to preserve their modesty. Yet if any one compel them, then Verily to them, after their compulsion, will God be Forgiving, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And now have we sent down to you clear signs, and an instance from among those who flourished before you, and a caution for the God-fearing.14

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: God is the LIGHT of the Heavens and of the Earth. His Light is like a niche in which is a lamp-the lamp encased in glass-the glass, as it were, a glistening star. From a blessed tree is it lighted, the olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would well nigh shine out, even though fire touched it not! It is light upon light. God guideth whom He will to His light, and God setteth forth parables to men, for God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: In the temples which God hath allowed to be reared, that His name may therein be remembered, do men praise Him morn and even.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Men whom neither merchandise nor traffic beguile from the remembrance of God, and from the observance of prayer, and the payment of the stated alms, through fear of the day when hearts shall throb and eyes shall roll:

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: That for their most excellent works may God recompense them, and of His bounty increase it to them more and more: for God maketh provision for whom He pleaseth without measure.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: But as to the infidels, their works are like the vapour in a plain which the thirsty dreameth to be water, until when he cometh unto it, he findeth it not aught, but findeth that God is with him; and He fully payeth him his account: for swift to take account is God:

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Or like the darkness on the deep sea when covered by billows riding upon billows, above which are clouds: darkness upon darkness. When a man reacheth forth his hand, he cannot nearly see it! He to whom God shall not give light, no light at all hath he!

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Hast thou not seen how all in the Heavens and in the Earth uttereth the praise of God?-the very birds as they spread their wings? Every creature knoweth its prayer and its praise! and God knoweth what they do.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: God's, the Kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth: and unto God the final return!

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Hast thou not seen that God driveth clouds lightly forward, then gathereth them together, then pileth them in masses? And then thou seest the rain forthcoming from their midst; and He causeth clouds like mountains charged with hail, to descend from the heaven, and He maketh it to fall on whom He will, and from whom He will He turneth it aside.-The brightness of His lightning all but taketh away the sight!

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: God causeth the day and the night to take their turn. Verily in this is teaching for men of insight. And God hath created every animal of water.15 Some go upon the belly; some go upon two feet; some go upon four feet. God hath created what He pleased. Aye, God hath power over all things.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Now have we sent down distinct signs.-And God guideth whom He will into the right path:

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: For there are who say "We believe on God and on the Apostle, and we obey;" yet, after this, a part of them turn back.16 But these are not of the faithful.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And when they are summoned before God and His Apostle that He may judge between them, lo! a part of them withdraw:

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: But had the truth been on their side, they would have come to Him, obedient.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: What! are they diseased of heart? Do they doubt? Are they afraid that God and His Apostles will deal unfairly with them? Nay, themselves are the unjust doers.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: The words of the believers, when called to God and His Apostle that He may judge between them, are only to say, "We have heard, and we obey:" these are they with whom it shall be well.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And whoso shall obey God, and His Apostle, and shall dread God and fear Him, these are they that shall be the blissful.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And they have sworn by God, with a most solemn oath, that if thou give them the word, they will certainly march forth. Say: swear ye not: of more worth is obedience. Verily, God is well aware of what ye do.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: SAY: Obey God and obey the Apostle. Suppose that ye turn back, still the burden of his duty is on him only, and the burden of your duty rests on you. If ye obey Him, ye shall have guidance: but plain preaching is all that devolves upon the Apostle.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: God hath promised to those of you who believe and do the things that are right, that He will cause them to succeed others in the land, as He gave succession to those who were before them, and that He will establish for them that religion which they delight in, and that after their fears He will give them security in exchange. They shall worship Me: nought shall they join with Me: And whoso, after this, believe not, they will be the impious.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: But observe prayer, and pay the stated alms, and obey the Apostle, that haply ye may find mercy.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: Let not the Infidels think that they can weaken God on His own Earth: their dwelling place shall be the Fire! and right wretched the journey!

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: O ye who believe! let your slaves, and those of you who have not come of age, ask leave of you, three times a day, ere they come into your presence;-before the morning prayer, and when ye lay aside your garments at mid-day, and after the evening prayer. These are your three times of privacy. No blame shall attach to you or to them, if after these times, when ye go your rounds of attendance on one another, they come in without permission. Thus doth God make clear to you His signs: and God is Knowing, Wise!

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: And when your children come of age, let them ask leave to come into your presence, as they who were before them asked it. Thus doth God make clear to you his signs: and God is Knowing, Wise.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: As to women who are past childbearing, and have no hope of marriage, no blame shall attach to them if they lay aside their outer garments, but so as not to shew their ornaments. Yet if they abstain from this, it will be better for them: and God Heareth, Knoweth.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: No crime17 shall it be in the blind, or in the lame, or in the sick, to eat at your tables: or in yourselves, if ye eat in your own houses, or in the houses of your fathers, or of your mothers, or of your brothers, or of your sisters, or of your uncles on the father's side, or of your aunts on the father's side, or of your uncles on the mother's side, or of your aunts on the mother's side, or in those of which ye possess the keys, or in the house of your friend. No blame shall attach to you whether ye eat together or apart.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And when ye enter houses, salute one another with a good and blessed greeting as from God. Thus doth God make clear to you His signs, that haply ye may comprehend them.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Verily, they only are believers who believe in God and His Apostle, and who, when they are with him upon any affair of common interest, depart not until they have sought his leave. Yes, they who ask leave of thee, are those who believe in God and His Apostle. And when they ask leave of Thee on account of any affairs of their own, then grant it to those of them whom thou wilt, and ask indulgence for them of God: for God is Indulgent, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Address not the Apostle as ye address one another.18 God knoweth those of you who withdraw quietly from the assemblies, screening themselves behind others. And let those who transgress his command beware, lest some present trouble befall them, or a grievous chastisement befall them, hereafter.

records.label: Surah 24 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: Is not whatever is in the Heavens and the Earth God's? He knoweth your state; and one day shall men be assembled before Him, and He will tell them of what they have done: for God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BLESSED be He who hath sent down AL FURKAN1 (the illumination) on his servant, that to all creatures he may be a warner.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: His the Kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth! No son hath He begotten! No partner hath He in his Empire! All things hath He created, and decreeing hath decreed their destinies.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Yet have they adopted gods beside Him which have created nothing, but were themselves created:

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And no power have they over themselves for evil or for good, nor have they power of death, or of life, or of raising the dead.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And the infidels say, "This Koran is a mere fraud of his own devising, and others have helped him with it,2 who had come hither by outrage and lie."3

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And they say, "Tales of the ancients that he hath put in writing! and they were dictated to him morn and even."

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: SAY: He hath sent it down who knoweth the secrets of the Heavens and of the Earth. He truly is the Gracious, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And they say, "What sort of apostle is this? He eateth food and he walketh the streets! Unless an angel be sent down and take part in his warnings,

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Or a treasure be thrown down to him, or he have a garden that supplieth him with food . . ."4 and those unjust persons say, "Ye follow but a man enchanted."

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: See what likenesses they strike out for thee! But they err, and cannot find their way.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Blessed be He who if he please can give thee better than that of which they speak-Gardens, 'neath which the rivers flow: and pavilions will He assign thee.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Aye, they have treated the coming of "the Hour" as a lie. But a flaming fire have we got ready for those who treat the coming of the Hour as a lie.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: When it shall see them from afar, they shall hear its raging and roaring,-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And when they shall be flung into a narrow space thereof bound together, they shall invoke destruction on the spot:

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: -"Call not this day for one destruction, but call for destructions many."

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: SAY: Is this, or the Paradise of Eternity which was promised to the God- fearing, best? Their recompense shall it be and their retreat;

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Abiding therein for ever, they shall have in it all that they desire! It is a promise to be claimed of thy Lord.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And on the day when he shall gather them together, and those whom they worshipped beside God, he will say, "Was it ye who led these my servants astray, or of themselves strayed they from the path?"

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: They will say, "Glory be to thee! It beseemed not us to take other lords than thee. But thou gavest them and their fathers their fill of good things, till they forgat the remembrance of thee, and became a lost people."

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Then will God say to the Idolaters, "Now have they made you liars in what ye say,5 and they have no power to avert your doom, or to succour you."

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And whosoever of you thus offendeth, we will make him taste a great punishment.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Never have we sent Apostles before thee who ate not common food, and walked not the streets. And we test you by means of each other. Will ye be steadfast? Thy Lord is looking on!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: They who look not forward to meet Us say, "If the angels be not sent down to us, or unless we behold our Lord. . . .” Ah! they are proud of heart, and exceed with great excess!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: On the day when they shall see the angels, no good news shall there be for the guilty ones, and they shall cry out, "A barrier that cannot be passed!"6

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Then will we proceed to the works which they have wrought, and make them as scattered dust.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Happier, on that day, the inmates of the Garden as to abode, and better off as to place of noontide slumber!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: On that day shall the heaven with its clouds be cleft, and the angels shall be sent down, descending:

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: On that day shall all empire be in very deed with the God of Mercy, and a hard day shall it be for the Infidels.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And on that day shall the wicked one7 bite his hands, and say, "Oh! would that I had taken the same path with the Apostle!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: "Oh! woe is me! would that I had not taken such an one8 for my friend!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: It was he who led me astray from the Warning which had reached me! and Satan is man's betrayer."9

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Then said the Apostle, "O my Lord! truly my people have esteemed this Koran to be vain babbling."

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Thus have we given to every Prophet an enemy from among the wicked ones-But thy Lord is a sufficient guide and helper.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And the infidels say, "Unless the Koran be sent down to him all at once. . . ." But in this way would we stablish thy heart by it; in parcels have we parcelled it out to thee;10

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Nor shall they come to thee with puzzling questions,11 but we will come to thee with the truth, and their best solution.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: They who shall be gathered upon their faces into hell, shall have the worst place, and be farthest from the path of happiness.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Heretofore we gave the law to Moses, and appointed his brother Aaron to be his counsellor:12

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And we said, "Go ye to the people who treat our signs as lies." And them destroyed we with utter destruction.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And as to the people of Noah! when they treated their Apostles as impostors, we drowned them; and we made them a sign to mankind:-A grievous chastisement have we prepared for the wicked!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And Ad and Themoud, and the men of Rass,13 and divers generations between them:

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Unto each of them did we set forth parables for warnings, and each of them did we utterly exterminate.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Oft are this have the unbelieving Meccans passed by the city on which was rained a fatal rain. What! Have they not seen it? Yet have they no hope of a resurrection!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: And when they see thee, they do but take thee as the subject of their railleries. "What! Is this he whom God has sent as an Apostle?

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Indeed he had well nigh led us astray from our gods, had we not persevered steadfastly in their service." But in the end they shall know, when they shall see the punishment, who hath most strayed from the path.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: What thinkest thou? He who hath taken his passions as a god-wilt thou be a guardian over him?

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Thinkest thou that the greater part of them hear or understand? They are just like the brutes! Yes! they stray even further from the right way.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord lengtheneth out the shadow?14 Had He pleased he had made it motionless.15 But we made the sun to be its guide;

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Then draw it in unto Us with easy indrawing.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: He it is who ordaineth the night as a garment, and sleep for rest, and ordaineth the day for waking up to life:

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: He it is who sendeth the winds as the forerunner of his mercy (rain); and pure water send we down from Heaven,

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: That we may revive by it a dead land: and we give it for drink to our creation, beasts and men in numbers;

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And we distribute it among them on all sides, that they may reflect: but most men refuse to be aught but thankless.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: Had we pleased, we had raised up a warner in every city.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Give not way therefore to the Infidels, but by means of this Koran strive against them with a mighty strife.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And He it is who hath let loose the two seas,16 the one sweet, fresh; and the other salt, bitter; and hath put an interspace between them, and a barrier that cannot be passed.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: And it is He who hath created man of water,17 and established between them the ties of kindred and affinity: and potent is thy Lord.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: Yet beside God do they worship what can neither help nor hurt them: and the Infidel is Satan's helper against his Lord:

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: Still we have sent thee only as a herald and a warner.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: SAY: I ask of you no recompense for it,18 except from him who is willing to take the way to his Lord.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: And put thou thy trust in Him that liveth and dieth not, and celebrate his praise; (He fully knoweth the faults of his servants) who in six days created the Heavens and the Earth, and whatever is between them, then mounted his Throne: the God of Mercy! Ask now of the Wise concerning Him.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: But when it is said to them, "Bow down before the God of Mercy," they say, "Who is the God of Mercy? Shall we bow down to what thou biddest?" And they fly from thee the more.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Blessed be He who hath placed in the Heaven the sign of the Zodiac!19 who hath placed in it the Lamp of the Sun, and the light-giving Moon!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: And it is He who hath ordained the night and the day to succeed one another for those who desire to think on God or desire to be thankful.

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: And the servants of the God of Mercy are they who walk upon the Earth softly; and when the ignorant20 address them, they reply, "Peace!"

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: They that pass the night in the worship of their lord prostrate and standing:-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: And that say, "O our Lord! turn away from us the torment of Hell, for its torment is endless: it is indeed an ill abode and resting place!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: Those who when they spend are neither lavish nor niggard, but keep the mean:-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Those who call on no other gods with God, nor slay whom God hath forbidden to be slain, except for a just cause, and who commit not fornication (for he who doth this shall meet the reward of his wickedness:

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: Doubled to him shall be the torment on the day of Resurrection; and in it shall he remain, disgraced, for ever:-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: Save those who shall repent and believe and do righteous works-for them God will change their evil things into good things, for God is Gracious, Merciful-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: And whose turneth to God and doeth what is right, he verily will convert with a true conversion):

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: And they who bear not witness to that which is false, and when they pass by frivolous sport, pass on with dignity:-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: And they who, when monished by the signs of their Lord, fall not down thereat, as if deaf and blind:-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: And who say, "O our Lord! give us in our wives and offspring the joy of our eyes, and make us examples to those who fear thee:"

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: These shall be rewarded with the High Places of Paradise for their steadfast endurance, and they shall meet therein with-Welcome and Salutation:-

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: For ever shall they remain therein: a fair abode and resting-place!

records.label: Surah 25 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: SAY: Not on your account doth my Lord care if ye call not on Him! ye have treated his Apostle as an impostor: but bye and bye a punishment shall cleave to them.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Ta. Sin. Mim.2 These are the signs of the lucid Book.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Haply thou wearest thyself away with grief because they will not believe.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Were it our will we could send down to them a sign from Heaven, before which they would humbly bow.3

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: But from each fresh warning that cometh to them from the God of Mercy they have only turned aside,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And treated it as a lie: But tidings shall reach them which they shall not laugh to scorn.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Have they not beheld the earth-how we have caused every kind of noble plant to spring up therein?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Verily, in this is a sign: but most of them believe not.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And assuredly, thy Lord!-He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And remember when thy Lord called to Moses, "Go to the wicked people,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: The people of Pharaoh. What! will they not fear me?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: He said, "My Lord, in sooth I fear lest they treat me as a liar:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And my breast is straitened, and I am slow of speech:4 send therefore to Aaron to be my helpmate.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: For they have a charge5 against me, and I fear lest they put me to death."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: He said, "Surely not. Go ye therefore with our signs: we will be with you and will hearken.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And go to Pharaoh and say: 'Verily we are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Send forth with us the children of Israel."'

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: He said, "Did we not rear thee among us when a child? And hast thou not passed years of thy life among us?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And yet what a deed is that which thou hast done!6 Thou art one of the ungrateful."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: He said, "I did it indeed, and I was one of those who erred: And I fled from you because I feared you; but my Lord hath given me wisdom and hath made me one of his Apostles.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And is this the favour thou hast conferred on me, that thou hast enslaved the children of Israel?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Said Pharaoh, "Who then is the Lord of the Worlds?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: He said, "The Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth and of all that is between them, if only ye believe it."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Said Pharaoh to those around him, "Hear ye this?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: "Your Lord," said Moses, "and the Lord of your sires of old."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: "In sooth, your Apostle whom He hath sent to you," said Pharaoh, "is certainly possessed."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: He said, "Lord is He of the East and of the West, and of all that is between them, if ye can understand."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: He said, "If ye take any God beside me, I will surely put thee in ward."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Said Moses, "What! if I shew thee that which shall be a proof of my mission?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: He said, "Forth with it then, if thou speakest truth."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Then threw he down his staff, and lo! an undoubted serpent:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And he drew out his hand, and lo! it was white7 to the beholders.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: He said to his nobles around him. "This truly is a right cunning sorcerer:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Fain would he drive you out of your land by his Sorcery. But what do ye suggest?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: They said, "Put him and his brother off awhile, and send summoners to all the cities,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Who shall bring to thee every cunning magician."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: So the magicians were mustered at a set time, on a solemn day:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And it was said to the people, "Are ye all assembled?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: -"Yes! and we will follow the magicians if they gain the day."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And when the magicians were arrived they said to Pharaoh, "Shall we have a reward if we gain the day?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: He said, "Yes. And verily in that case ye shall be of those who are near my person."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Moses said to them, "Throw down what ye have to throw."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: So they cast down their ropes and rods, and said, "By Pharaoh's might we shall surely win."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Then Moses threw down his rod, and lo! it swallowed up their cheating wonders.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Then the magicians threw themselves down in worship:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: They said, "We believe on the Lord of the Worlds,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: The Lord of Moses and of Aaron."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Said Pharaoh, "Have ye then believed on him ere I gave you leave? He truly is your master who hath taught you magic.8 But bye and bye ye shall surely know my power.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: I will cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and I will have you all crucified."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: They said, "It cannot harm us, for to our Lord shall we return:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Assuredly we trust that our Lord will forgive us our sins, since we are of the first who believe."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Then revealed we this order to Moses: "Go forth by night with my servants, for ye will be pursued."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And Pharaoh sent summoners through the cities:-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: "These Israelites," said they, "are a scanty band;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Yet are they enraged against us-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: But we truly are numerous, wary."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Thus we caused them to quit gardens and fountains,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: And treasures and splendid dwellings;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: So was it; and we gave them to the children of Israel for an heritage.9

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Then at sunrise the Egyptians followed them:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: And when the hosts came in view of one another, the comrades of Moses said, "We are surely overtaken."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: He said, "By no means:-for my Lord is with me-He will guide me."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And we revealed this order to Moses, "Strike the sea with thy rod." And it clave asunder, and each part became like a huge mountain.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Then made we the others to draw on;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: And we saved Moses, and those who were with him, all;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: But we drowned the others.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: Truly in this was a sign; but most of them did not believe.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: But verily thy Lord,-He is the Mighty, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: And recite to them the story of Abraham

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: When he said to his Father and to his people, "What worship ye?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: They said, "We worship idols, and constant is our devotion to them."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: He said, "Can they hear you when ye cry to them?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: Or help you or do you harm?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: They said, "But we found our Fathers do the like."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: He said, "How think ye? They whom ye worship,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: Ye and your fathers of early days,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Are my foes: but not so10 the Lord of the Worlds,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: Who hath created me, and guideth me,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: Who giveth me food and drink;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And when I am sick, he healeth me,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: And who will cause me to die and again quicken me,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: And who, I hope, will forgive me my sins in the day of reckoning.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: My Lord! bestow on me wisdom and join me to the just,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: And give me a good name11 among posterity,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: And make me one of the heirs of the garden of delight,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: And forgive my father, for he was one of the erring,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: And put me not to shame on the day when mankind shall be raised up,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: The day when neither wealth nor children shall avail,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: Save to him who shall come to God with a sound heart:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: When Paradise shall be brought near the pious,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: And Hell shall lay open for those who have gone astray.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: And it shall be said to them, 'Where are they whom ye worshipped

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: Beside God? Can they harm you or help themselves?'

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: And they shall be cast into it-the seducers and the seduced,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: And all the host of Eblis.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: They shall say, as they wrangle therein together,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: 'By God, we were in a plain error,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: When we equalled you with the Lord of the Worlds:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: And none misled us but the wicked,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 100
records.text: And we have none to plead for us,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 101
records.text: Nor friend who careth for us.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 102
records.text: Could we but return, we would be of the believers."'

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 103
records.text: Verily, in this was a sign: but most of them believed not.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 104
records.text: And truly thy Lord!-He is the Mighty, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 105
records.text: The people of Noah gainsaid the Apostles,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 106
records.text: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will ye not fear God?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 107
records.text: Of a truth am I your faithful Apostle;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 108
records.text: Fear God then and obey me.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 109
records.text: I ask of you no reward for this, for my reward is of the Lord of the Worlds alone:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 110
records.text: Fear God then and obey me."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 111
records.text: They said, "Shall we believe on thee when the meanest only are thy followers?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 112
records.text: He said, "But I have no knowledge of that they did:12

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 113
records.text: To my Lord only must their account be given: would that ye understood this!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 114
records.text: And I will not thrust away those who believe,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 115
records.text: For I am only one charged with plain warnings."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 116
records.text: They said, "Now unless thou desist, O Noah, one of the stoned shalt thou surely be."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 117
records.text: He said, "Lord! my people treat me as a liar:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 118
records.text: Decide thou therefore a decision between me and them, and rescue me and the faithful who are with me."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 119
records.text: So we saved him and those who were with him in the fully-laden ark,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 120
records.text: And afterwards we drowned the rest.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 121
records.text: Herein truly was a sign, but most of them believed not.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 122
records.text: But thy Lord!-He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 123
records.text: The Adites13 treated their Apostles as liars,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 124
records.text: When their brother Houd said to them, "Will ye not fear God?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 125
records.text: I am your Apostle, worthy of all credit;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 126
records.text: Fear God then and obey me:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 127
records.text: I ask for no reward for this; for my reward is of the Lord of the Worlds alone.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 128
records.text: What! build ye landmarks on all heights in mere pastime?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 129
records.text: And raise ye structures to be your lasting abodes?14

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 130
records.text: And when ye put forth your power do ye put it forth with harshness?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 131
records.text: Fear ye God then and obey me;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 132
records.text: And fear ye Him who hath plenteously betowed on you ye well know what:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 133
records.text: Plenteously bestowed on you flocks and children,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 134
records.text: And gardens and fountains;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 135
records.text: Indeed I fear for you the punishment of a tremendous day."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 136
records.text: They said, "It is the same to us whether thou warn or warn us not.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 137
records.text: This is but a tale of the ancients,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 138
records.text: And we are not they who shall be punished."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 139
records.text: And they charged him with imposture; and we destroyed them. In this was a sign: but most of them believed not.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 140
records.text: But thy Lord!-He is the Mighty, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 141
records.text: The Themoudites also treated their Apostles as liars,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 142
records.text: When their brother Saleh said to them, "Will ye not fear God?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 143
records.text: I am your Apostle worthy of all credit:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 144
records.text: Fear God, then, and obey me.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 145
records.text: I ask of you no reward for this: my reward is of the Lord of the Worlds alone.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 146
records.text: Shall ye be left secure amid these things here?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 147
records.text: Amid gardens and fountains,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 148
records.text: And corn-fields and palm-trees, with flower-sheathing branches?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 149
records.text: And, insolent that ye are, will ye hew out your dwellings in the mountains?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 150
records.text: But fear God and obey me,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 151
records.text: And obey not the bidding of those who commit excess,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 152
records.text: Who act disorderly on the earth and reform it not."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 153
records.text: They said, "Certainly thou art a person bewitched;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 154
records.text: Thou art only a man like us: produce now a sign if thou art a man of truth."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 155
records.text: He said, "This she-camel, then-drink shall there be for her, and drink shall there be for you, on a several day for each.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 156
records.text: But harm her not, lest the punishment of a tremendous day overtake you."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 157
records.text: But they ham-strung her, and repented of it on the morrow;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 158
records.text: For the punishment overtook them. In this truly was a sign, but most of them believed not.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 159
records.text: But thy Lord!-He is the Powerful, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 160
records.text: The people of Lot treated their apostles as liars,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 161
records.text: When their brother Lot said to them, "Will ye not fear God?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 162
records.text: I am your Apostle worthy of all credit:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 163
records.text: Fear God, then, and obey me.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 164
records.text: For this I ask you no reward: my reward is of the Lord of the worlds alone.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 165
records.text: What! with men, of all creatures, will ye have commerce?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 166
records.text: And leave ye your wives whom your Lord hath created for you? Ah! ye are an erring people!"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 167
records.text: They said, "O Lot, if thou desist not, one of the banished shalt thou surely be."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 168
records.text: He said, "I utterly abhor your doings:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 169
records.text: My Lord! deliver me and my family from what they do."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 170
records.text: So we delivered him and his whole family-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 171
records.text: Save an aged one among those who tarried-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 172
records.text: Then we destroyed the rest-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 173
records.text: And we rained a rain upon them, and fatal was the rain to those whom we had warned.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 174
records.text: In this truly was a sign; but most of them did not believe.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 175
records.text: But thy Lord! He is the Powerful, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 176
records.text: The dwellers in the forest of Madian15 treated the Apostles as liars.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 177
records.text: When Shoaib their brother said to them, "Will ye not fear God?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 178
records.text: I truly am your trustworthy Apostle.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 179
records.text: Fear God, then, and obey me:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 180
records.text: No reward ask I of you for this: my reward is of the Lord of the Worlds alone.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 181
records.text: Fill the measure, and be not of those who minish:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 182
records.text: Weigh with exact balance:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 183
records.text: And defraud not men in their substance, and do no wrong on the earth by deeds of licence;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 184
records.text: And fear Him who made you and the races of old."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 185
records.text: They said, "Certainly thou art a person bewitched.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 186
records.text: Thou art but a man like us, and we deem thee liar-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 187
records.text: Make now a part of the heaven to fall down upon us, if thou art a man of truth."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 188
records.text: He said, "My Lord best knoweth your doings."

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 189
records.text: And when they treated him as a liar, the chastisement of the day of cloud overtook them. This truly was the chastisement of a dreadful day!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 190
records.text: In this was a sign, but most of them believed not.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 191
records.text: But thy Lord!-He is the Mighty, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 192
records.text: Verily from the Lord of the Worlds hath this Book come down;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 193
records.text: The faithful spirit16 hath come down with it

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 194
records.text: Upon thy heart, that thou mightest become a warner-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 195
records.text: In the clear Arabic tongue:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 196
records.text: And truly it is foretold in the Scriptures of them of yore.17

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 197
records.text: Was it not a sign to them18 that the learned among the children of Israel recognised it?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 198
records.text: If we had sent it down unto any foreigner,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 199
records.text: And he had recited it to them, they had not believed.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 200
records.text: In such sort have we influenced19 the heart of the wicked ones,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 201
records.text: That they will not believe it till they see the grievous chastisement?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 202
records.text: And it shall come upon them on a sudden when they look not for it:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 203
records.text: And they will say, "Can we be respited?"

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 204
records.text: What! will they seek to hasten on our chastisement?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 205
records.text: How thinkest thou? If after we have given them their fill for years,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 206
records.text: That with which they are menaced come upon them at last,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 207
records.text: Of what avail will their enjoyments be to them?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 208
records.text: We never destroyed a city which had not first its warners

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 209
records.text: With admonition; nor did we deal unjustly.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 210
records.text: The Satans were not sent down with this Koran:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 211
records.text: It beseemed them not, and they had not the power,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 212
records.text: For they are far removed from hearing it.20

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 213
records.text: Call not thou on any other god but God, lest thou be of those consigned to torment:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 214
records.text: But warn thy relatives of nearer kin,21

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 215
records.text: And kindly lower thy wing over the faithful who follow thee.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 216
records.text: And if they disobey thee, then say: "I will not be answerable for your doings;"-

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 217
records.text: And put thy trust in Him that is the Mighty, the Merciful,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 218
records.text: Who seeth thee when thou standest in prayer,

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 219
records.text: And thy demeanour amongst those who worship;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 220
records.text: For He heareth, knoweth all.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 221
records.text: Shall I tell you on whom Satan descend?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 222
records.text: They descend on every lying, wicked person:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 223
records.text: They impart what they have heard;22-but most of them are liars.

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 224
records.text: It is the POETS23 whom the erring follow:

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 225
records.text: Seest thou not how they rove distraught in every valley?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 226
records.text: And that they say that which they do not?

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 227
records.text: Save those who believe and do good works, and oft remember God;

records.label: Surah 26 · edition paragraph 228
records.text: And who defend themselves when unjustly treated. But they who treat them unjustly shall find out what a lot awaiteth them.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: TA. SAD.1 These are the signs (verses) of the Koran and of the lucid Book;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Guidance and glad tidings to the believers who observe prayer and pay the stated alms, and believe firmly-do they-in the life to come.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: As to those who believe not in the life to come, we have made their own doings fair seeming to them, and they are bewildered therein.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: These are they whom the woe of chastisement awaiteth; and in the next life they shall suffer-yes shall they-greatest loss;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But thou hast certainly received the Koran from the Wise, the Knowing.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Bear in mind when Moses said to his family, "I have perceived a fire;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: I will bring you tidings from it, or will bring you a blazing brand, that ye may warm you."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And when he came to it, he was called to, "Blessed, He who is in the fire, and He who is about it; and glory be to God, the Lord of the worlds!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: O Moses! verily, I am God, the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Throw down now thy staff." And when he saw that it moved itself as though it were a serpent, he retreated backward and returned not. "O Moses, fear not; for the Sent Ones fear not in my presence,

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Save he who having done amiss shall afterwards exchange the evil for good; for I am Forgiving, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Put now thy hand into thy bosom: it shall come forth white, yet free from hurt:2 one of nine signs to Pharaoh and his people; for a perverse people are they."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And when our signs were wrought in their very sight,3 they said, "This is plain magic."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And though in their souls they knew them to be true, yet in their wickedness and pride they denied them. But see what was the end of the corrupt doers!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And of old we gave knowledge to David and Solomon: and they said, "Praise be to God, who hath made us to excel many of his believing servants!"

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And in knowledge Solomon was David's heir. And he said, "O men, we have been taught the speech of birds,4 and are endued with everything. This is indeed a clear boon from God."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And to Solomon were gathered his hosts of Djinn5 and men and birds, and they were marched on in bands,

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Till they reached the Valley of Ants. Said AN ANT, "O ye ants, enter your dwellings, lest Solomon and his army crush you and know it not."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Then smiled Solomon, laughing at her words, and he said, "Stir me up, O Lord, to be thankful for thy favour which thou hast shewed upon me and upon my parents, and to do righteousness that shall be well pleasing to thee, and bring me in, by thy mercy, among thy servants the righteous."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And he reviewed the birds, and said, "How is it that I see not the lapwing? Is it one of the absent?

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Surely, with a severe chastisement will I chastise it, or I will certainly slaughter it, unless it bring me a clear excuse."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Nor tarried it long ere it came and said, "I have gained the knowledge that thou knowest not, and with sure tidings have I come to thee from Saba:

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: I found a woman reigning over them, gifted with everything, and she hath a splendid throne;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And I found her and her people worshipping the sun instead of God; and Satan hath made their works fair seeming to them, so that he hath turned them from the Way: wherefore they are not guided,

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: To the worship of God, who bringeth to light the secret things of heaven and earth, and knoweth what men conceal and what they manifest:

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: God! there is no god but He! the lord of the glorious throne!"

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: He said, "We shall see whether thou hast spoken truth, or whether thou art of them that lie.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Go with this my letter and throw it down to them: then turn away from them and await their answer."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: She said, "O my nobles! an honourable letter hath been thrown down to me:

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: It is from Solomon; and it is this: 'In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Set not up yourselves against me, but come to me submitting (Muslims).' "

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: She said, "O my nobles, advise me in mine affair: I decide it not without your concurrence."6

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: They said, "We are endued with strength and are endued with mighty valour.- But to command is thine: See therefore what thou wilt command us."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: She said, "Kings when they enter a city spoil it, and abase the mightiest of its people: and in like manner will these also do.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: But I will send to them with a gift, and await what my envoys bring back."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And when the messenger came to Solomon, he said, "Aid ye me with riches? But what God hath given to me is better than what he hath given you: yet ye glory in your gifts:

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Return to them: for we will surely come to them with forces which they cannot withstand, and we will drive them from their land humbled and contemptible."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Said he, "O nobles, which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me, submitting? (Muslims)."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: An Efreet7 of the Djinn said: "I will bring it thee ere thou risest from thy place: I have power for this and am trusty."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And one who had the knowledge of Scripture said, "I will bring it to thee in the twinkling of an eye."8 And when he saw it set before him, he said, "This is of the favour of my Lord, to try me whether I will be thankful or unthankful. And he who is thankful is thankful to his own behoof; and as for him who is unthankful-truly my Lord is self-sufficient, bounteous!"

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Said he, "Make her throne so that she know it not: we shall see whether she hath or not guidance."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: And when she came he said, "Is thy throne like this?" She said, "As though it were the same." "And we," said he, "have had knowledge given us before her, and have been Muslims."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: But the gods she had worshipped instead of God had led her astray: for she was of a people who believe not.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: It was said to her,"Enter the Palace:" and when she saw it, she thought it a lake of water, and bared her legs. He said, "It is a palace paved with glass."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: She said, "O my Lord! I have sinned against my own soul, and I resign myself, with Solomon, to God the Lord of the Worlds."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And of old we sent to Themoud their brother Saleh, with "Serve ye God:"but lo! they became two sets of disputants wrangling with each other.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: He said, "O my people, why, if ye ask not pardon of God that ye may find mercy, hasten ye on evil rather than good?"

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: They said,"We augur9 ill concerning thee and those who are with thee." He said, "The ills of which ye augur10 depend on God. But ye are a people on your trial."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 50
