records.text: And there were in the city nine persons who committed excesses in the land and did not that which is right.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: They said, "Swear ye to one another by God that we will surely fall on him and on his family by night: then will be say to the avenger of blood, we witnessed not the destruction of his family: and verily we speak the truth."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And they devised a device, and we devised a device, and they were not aware of it-

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And see what was the end of their device! We destroyed them and their whole people:

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And for their sin these their houses are empty ruins: Verily in this is a sign to those who understand;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: And we delivered those who believed and feared.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And Lot, when he said to his people, "What! proceed ye to such filthiness with your eyes open?

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: What! come ye with lust unto men rather than to women? Surely ye are an ignorant people."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: And the answer of his people was but to say, "Cast out the family of Lot from your city: they, forsooth, are men of purity!"

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: So we rescued him and his family: but as for his wife, we decreed her to be of them that lingered:

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: And we rained a rain upon them, and fatal was the rain to those who had had their warning.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: SAY: Praise be to God and peace be on His servants whom He hath chosen! Is God the more worthy or the gods they join with Him?

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Is not He who hath made the Heavens and the Earth, and hath sent down rain to you from Heaven, by which we cause the luxuriant groves to spring up! It is not in your power to cause its trees to spring up! What! A god with God? Yet they find equals for Him!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Is not He, who hath set the earth so firm, and hath made rivers in its midst, and hath placed mountains upon it, and put a barrier between the two seas?11 What! a god with God? Yet the greater part of them have no knowledge!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Is not He the more worthy who answereth the oppressed when they cry to him, and taketh off their ills, and maketh you to succeed your sires on the earth? What! a god with God? How few bear these things in mind!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Is not He, who guideth you in the darkness of the land and of the sea, and who sendeth forth the winds as the forerunners of His mercy? What! a god with God? Far from God be what ye join with Him!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: Is not He, who created a Being, then reneweth it, and who supplieth you out of the Heaven and the Earth? What! a god with God? SAY: Bring forth your proofs if you speak the truth.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: SAY: None either in the Heavens or in the Earth knoweth the unseen but God. And they know not

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: When they shall be raised.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: -Yet they have attained to a knowledge of the life to come:12-yet are they in doubt about it:-yet are they blind about it!

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: And the unbelievers say: "When we and our fathers have been dead shall we be taken forth?

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: Of old have we been promised this, we and our sires of old it is but fables of the ancients."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: SAY: Go ye through the land, and see what hath been the end of the wicked.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: And grieve not thou for them, nor be in distress at their devisings.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: And they say, "When will this promise be made good, if ye speak true?"

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: SAY: Haply a part of what ye desire to be hastened may be close behind you.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And truly thy Lord is full of goodness towards men: But most of them are not thankful.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: And thy Lord knoweth well what their breasts enshroud, and what they bring to light,

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: And there is no secret thing in the Heaven or on the Earth, but it is in the clear Book.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: Truly this Koran declareth to the children of Israel most things wherein they disagree:

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And it is certainly guidance and a mercy to the faithful.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: Verily, by his wisdom will thy Lord decide between them: for He is the Mighty, the Knowing.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: Put thou then thy trust in God: for thou hast clear truth on thy side.13

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: Thou shalt not make the dead to hear; neither shalt thou make the deaf to hear the call, when they turn away backward;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: Neither art thou the guide of the blind out of their errors: none truly shalt thou make to hear but those who believe our signs: and they are Muslims.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: When the doom shall be ready to light upon them, we will cause a monster14 to come forth to them out of the earth, and cry to them "Verily men have not firmly believed our signs."

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: And on that day shall be gathered out of every nation a company of those who have gainsaid our signs, in separate bands;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: Till they come before God, who will say, "Treated ye my signs as impostures, although ye embraced them not in your knowledge? or what is it that ye were doing?

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: And doom shall light upon them for their evil deeds, and nought shall they have to plead.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: See they not that we have ordained the night that they may rest in it, and the day with its gift of light? Of a truth herein are signs to people who believe.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: On that day there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and all that are in the heavens, and all that the on the earth shall be terror-stricken, save him whom God pleaseth to deliver; and all shall come to him in humble guise.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: And thou shalt see the mountains, which thou thinkest so firm, pass away with the passing of a cloud! 'Tis the work of God, who ordereth all things! of all that ye do is He well aware.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: To him who shall present himself with good works, shall be a reward beyond their desert,15 and they shall be secure from the terror on that day;

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: And they who shall present themselves with evil shall be flung downward on their faces into the fire. Shall ye be rewarded but as ye have wrought?

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: SAY: Specially am I commanded to worship the Lord of this land, which He hath sanctified. All things are His: and I am commanded to be one of those who surrender them to God (a Muslim)

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: And to recite the Koran: and whoever is rightly guided, assuredly will be rightly guided to his own behoof.

records.label: Surah 27 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: And as to him who erreth, SAY, I truly am a warner only.And SAY, Praise be to God! He will shew you His signs, and ye shall acknowledge them: and of what ye do, thy Lord is not regardless.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: TA. SIN. MIM.1 These are the signs of the lucid Book.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: We will recite to thee portions of the History of Moses and Pharaoh with truth, for the teaching of the faithful.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Now Pharaoh lifted himself up in the earth, and divided his people into parties: one portion of them he brought low-He slew their male children, and let their females only live; for he was one of those who wrought disorders.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And we were minded to shew favour to those who were brought low in the land, and to make them spiritual chiefs,2 and to make them Pharaoh's heirs,

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And to stablish them in the land;3 and to make Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts, the eye-witnesses of what they dreaded from them.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And we said by revelation to the mother of Moses, "Give him suck; and if thou fearest for him, launch him on the sea; and fear not, neither fret; for we will restore him to thee, and make him one of the apostles."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And Pharaoh's family took him up to be a foe and a sorrow to them, for sinners were Pharaoh and Haman and their hosts!

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And Pharaoh's wife said, "Joy of the eye4 to me and thee! put him not to death: haply he will be useful to us, or we may adopt him as a son." But they knew not what they did.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And the heart of Moses' mother became a blank through fear: and almost had she discovered him, but that we girt up her heart with constancy, in order that she might be one of those who believe.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: She said to his sister, "Follow him." And she watched him from afar: and they perceived it not.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And we caused him to refuse the nurses,5 until his sister came and said, Shall I point out to you the family of a house that will rear him for you, and will be careful of him?

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: So we restored him to his mother, to be the joy of her eyes, and that she might not fret, and that she might know that the promise of God was true. But most men knew it not.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And when he had reached his age of strength, and had become a man, we bestowed on him wisdom and knowledge; for thus do we reward the righteous.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And he entered a city at the time when its inhabitants would not observe him,6 and found therein two men fighting: the one, of his own people; the other, of his enemies. And he who was of his own people asked his help against him who was of his enemies. And Moses smote him with his fist and slew him. Said he, "This is a work of Satan; for he is an enemy, a manifest misleader."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: He said, "O my Lord, I have sinned to mine own hurt:7 forgive me." So God forgave him; for He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: He said, "Lord, because thou hast showed me this grace, I will never again be the helper of the wicked."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And in the city at noon he was full of fear, casting furtive glances round him: and lo! the man whom he had helped the day before, cried out to him again for help. Said Moses to him, "Thou art plainly a most depraved person."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And when he would have laid violent hands on him who was their common foe, he said to him, "O Moses, dost thou desire to slay me, as thou slayedst a man yesterday? Thou desirest only to become a tyrant in this land, and desirest not to become a peacemaker."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: But a man came running up from the city's end. He said, "O Moses, of a truth, the nobles consult to slay thee-Begone then-I counsel thee as a friend."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: So forth he went from it in fear, looking warily about him. He said, "O Lord, deliver me from the unjust people."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And when he was journeying toward Madian, he said, "Haply my Lord will direct me in an even path."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And when he arrived at the water of Madian, he found at it a company of men watering.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And he found beside them, two women8 keeping back their flock: "Why do ye," said he, "thus?" They said "We shall not water till the shepherds shall have driven off; for our father is very aged."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: So he watered for them-then retired to the shade and said, "O my Lord, of the good thou hast caused me to meet with I stand in need."9

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And one of them came to him, walking bashfully. Said she, "My father calleth thee, that he may pay thee wages for thy watering for us." And when he came to him and had told him his STORY, "Fear not," said he, "thou hast escaped from an unjust people."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: One of them said, "O my father, hire him: for the best thou canst hire is the strong, the trusty."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: He said, "Truly to one of these my two daughters I desire to marry thee, if for eight years thou wilt be my hired servant:10 and if thou fulfil ten, it shall be of thine own accord, for I wish not to deal hardly with thee. Thou wilt find me, if God will, one of the upright."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: He said, "Be it so between me and thee: Whichever of the two terms I fulfil, there will be no injustice to me. And God is witness of what we say."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And when Moses had fulfilled the term, and was journeying with his family, he perceived a fire on the mountain side. He said to his family, "Wait ye, for I perceive a fire. Haply I may bring you tidings from it, or a brand from the fire to warm you."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And when he came up to it, a Voice cried to him11 out of the bush from the right side of the valley in the sacred hollow, "O Moses, I truly am God, the Lord of the Worlds:

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Throw down now thy rod." And when he saw it move as though it were a serpent, he retreated and fled and returned not. "O Moses," cried the Voice, "draw near and fear not, for thou art in safety.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Put thy hand into thy bosom; it shall come forth white, but unharmed: and draw back thy hand12 to thee without fear. These shall be two signs from thy Lord to Pharaoh and his nobles; for they are a perverse people."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: He said, "O my Lord! truly I have slain one of them, therefore fear I lest they slay me.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: My brother Aaron is clearer of speech than I. Send him, therefore, with me as a help, and to make good my cause, for I fear lest they treat me as an impostor."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: He said, "We will strengthen thine arm with thy brother, and we will give power unto you both, and they shall not equal you in our signs. Ye twain and they who shall follow you, shall gain the day."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And when Moses came to him with our demonstrative signs they said, "This is nought but magical device. We never heard the like among our sires of old."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And Moses said, "My Lord best knoweth on whom He hath bestowed His guidance, and whose shall be the recompense of the abode of Paradise. Verily, the wicked shall not prosper."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And Pharaoh said, "O ye nobles, ye have no other God that I know of but myself. Burn me then, Haman, bricks of clay,13 and build me a tower that I may mount up to the God of Moses, for in sooth, I deem him a liar."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And he and his hosts behaved themselves proudly and unjustly on the earth, and thought that they should never be brought back to us.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: But we seized on him and his hosts and cast them into the sea: Behold, then, the end of the wrongful doers:

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: And we made them imâms who invite to the fire of hell, and on the day of Resurrection they shall not be helped.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: We followed them with a curse in this world, and covered shall they be with shame on the day of Resurrection.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: And after we had destroyed the former generations, we gave the book of the Law to Moses for man's enlightening, and a guidance and a mercy, that haply they might reflect.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: And thou wast not on the western slope of Sinai when we laid his charge on Moses, nor wast thou one of the witnesses;

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: But we raised up generations after Moses, men whose days were lengthened;14 neither didst thou dwell among the inhabitants of Madian to rehearse to them our signs, but we sent Apostles to them.15

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Nor wast thou on the slope of Sinai when we called to Moses, but it is of the mercy of thy Lord that thou warnest a people, to whom no warner had come before thee, to the intent that they should reflect:

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And that they should not say when a calamity shall befal them for their previous handy work, "O our Lord! why hast thou not sent an Apostle to us? Then we should have followed thy signs and have been of the believers."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Yet when the truth came to them from our very presence, they said, "Unless the like powers be given to him that were given to Moses. . . ."16 But did they not disbelieve in what of old was given to Moses? They said, "Two works of sorcery17 have helped each other;" and they said, "We disbelieve them both."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: SAY: Bring then a Book from before God which shall be a better guide than these, that I may follow it; if ye speak the truth.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And if they answer thee not, then know that verily they are following their own caprices: and who goeth more widely astray than he who followeth his own caprice without guidance from God? for God guideth not the wicked.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And now have we caused our word to come unto them, that they may be warned:

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: They18 to whom we gave the Scriptures before IT, do in IT believe.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And when it is recited to them they say, "We believe in it, for it is the truth from our Lord. We were Muslims before it came."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Twice shall their reward be given them, for that they suffered with patience, and repelled evil with good, and gave alms out of that with which we provided them.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And when they hear light discourse they withdraw from it, and say, "Our works for us and your works for you! Peace be on you! We are not in quest of fools!"

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Thou truly canst not guide whom thou desirest; but God guideth whom He will; and He best knoweth those who yield to guidance.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: But they say, "If we follow the way in which thou art guided,19 we shall be driven from our country." But have we not established for them a sacred secure precinct, to which fruits of every kind, our gift for their support, are gathered together? But most of them have no knowledge.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: And how many cities have we destroyed that flourished in wanton ease! And these their dwellings have not been inhabited since their time save by a few, and it is we who became their heirs.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: But thy Lord did not destroy the cities till He had sent an apostle to their mother-city to rehearse our signs to its people: nor did we destroy the cities unless its people were unjust.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: And all that hath been bestowed on you is merely for enjoyment and pomp of this life present: but that which is with God is better and more lasting. Will ye not be wise?

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Shall he then to whom we have promised a goodly promise and who obtaineth it, be as he on whom we have bestowed the enjoyments of this life present, and who on the day of Resurrection shall be brought up for punishment?

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: On that day will God cry to them and say, "Where are my companions, as ye supposed them?"

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: They on whom doom shall be justly pronounced will say, "O our Lord! these are they whom we led astray: we led them astray even as we had been led astray ourselves: Thou hast no cause of blame against us: It was not we whom they worshipped.20

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: And it shall be said, "Call now on those whom ye made God's companions:" and they shall call on them, but they will not answer them. And they shall see the punishment, and wish that they had been guided aright.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: And on that day shall God call to them and say, "How answered ye the apostles?"

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: But on that day they shall be too blinded with confusion to give an account,21 nor shall they ask it of one another.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: Yet as to him who shall turn to God and believe and do the thing that is right, it may come to pass that he shall be among the happy.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: And thy Lord createth what he will and hath a free choice. But they, the false gods, have no power to choose. Glory be to God! and high let him be exalted above those whom they associate with him.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: And thy Lord knoweth what their breasts conceal and what they bring to light.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: And He is God! There is no god but He! His, all praise in this life and in the next, and His the power supreme,22 and to Him shall ye be brought back!

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If God should enshroud you with a long night until the day of resurrection, what god beside God would bring you light? Will ye not then hearken?

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If God should make it one long day for you until the day of resurrection, what god but God could bring you the night in which to take your rest? Will ye not then see?

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: Of His mercy he hath made for you the night that ye may take your rest in it; and the day that ye may seek what ye need out of his bounteous supplies, and that ye may give thanks.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: One day God will call to them and say, "Where are my companions as ye supposed them?

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And we will bring up a witness out of every nation and say, "Bring your proofs." And they shall know that the truth is with God alone, and the gods of their own devising shall desert them.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Now Korah23 was of the people of Moses: but he behaved haughtily toward them; for we had given him such treasure that its keys would have burdened a company of men of strength. When his people said to him, "Exult not, for God loveth not those who exult;

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: But seek, by means of what God hath given thee, to attain the future Mansion; and neglect not thy part in this world, but be bounteous to others as God hath been bounteous to thee, and seek not to commit excesses on the earth; for God loveth not those who commit excesses:"

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: He said, "It hath been given me only on account of the knowledge that is in me." Did he not know that God had destroyed before him generations that were mightier than he in strength and had amassed more abundant wealth? But the wicked shall not be asked of their crimes.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And Korah went forth to his people in his pomp. Those who were greedy for this present life said, "Oh that we had the like of that which hath been bestowed on Korah! Truly he is possessed of great good fortune."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: But they to whom knowledge had been given said, "Woe to you! the reward of God is better for him who believeth and worketh righteousness, and none shall win it but those who have patiently endured."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: And we clave the earth for him and for his palace, and he had no forces, in the place of God,24 to help him, nor was he among those who are succoured.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: And in the morning those who the day before had coveted his lot said, "Aha! God enlargeth supplies to whom he pleaseth of his servants, or is sparing. Had not God been gracious to us, He had caused it to cleave for us. Aha! the ungrateful can never prosper."

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: As to this future mansion, we will bestow it on those who seek not to exalt them in the earth or to do wrong: And there is a happy issue for the God- fearing.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: Whoso doeth good shall have reward beyond its merits, and whoso doeth evil, they who do evil shall be rewarded only as they shall have wrought.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: He who hath sanctioned the Koran to thee will certainly bring thee to thy home.25 SAY: My Lord best knoweth who hath guidance, and who is in undoubted error.

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: Thou didst never expect that the Book would be given thee. Of thy Lord's mercy only hath it been sent down. Be not thou helpful then to the unbelievers:

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: Neither let them turn thee aside from the signs of God after they have been sent down to thee, but bid men to thy Lord; and be not among those who add gods to God:

records.label: Surah 28 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: And call not on any other god with God. There is no god but He! Everything shall perish except Himself! Judgment is His, and to Him shall ye return!

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ELIF. LAM. MIM.1 Think men that when they say, "We believe," they shall be let alone and not be put to proof?

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: We put to proof those who lived before them; for God will surely take knowledge of those who are sincere, and will surely take knowledge of the liars.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Think they who work evil that they shall escape Us? Ill do they judge.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: To him who hopeth to meet God, the set time of God will surely come. The Hearer, the Knower, He!

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Whoso maketh efforts for the faith, maketh them for his own good only. Verily God is rich enough to dispense with all creatures.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And as to those who shall have believed and done the things that are right, their evil deeds will we surely blot out from them, and according to their best actions will we surely reward them.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Moreover we have enjoined on man to shew kindness to parents: but if they strive with thee that thou join that with Me of which thou hast no knowledge,2 obey them not. To me do ye return, and then will I tell you of your doings:

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And those who shall have believed and done the things that are right, we will surely give them an entering in among the just.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: But some men say, "We believe in God," yet when they meet with sufferings in the cause of God, they regard trouble from man as chastisement from God. Yet if a success come from thy Lord they are sure to say, "We were on your side!" Doth not God well know what is in the breasts of his creatures?

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Yes, and God well knoweth those who believe, and He well knoweth the Hypocrites.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: The unbelievers say to the faithful, "Follow ye our way, and we will surely bear your sins." But not aught of their sins will they bear-verily they are liars!

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: But their own burdens, and burdens beside their own burdens shall they surely bear: and inquisition shall be made of them on the day of Resurrection as to their false devices.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Of old sent we Noah to his people: a thousand years save fifty did he tarry among them; and the flood overtook them in their wrongful doings:

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: But we rescued him and those who were in the vessel; and we made it a sign to all men:

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And Abraham; when he said to his people, "Worship God and fear Him. This will be best for you, if ye have knowledge;"

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Ye only worship idols beside God, and are the authors of a lie. Those whom ye worship beside God can give you no supplies: seek, then, your supplies from God; and serve Him and give Him thanks. To Him shall ye return.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Suppose that ye treat me as a liar! nations before you have treated God's messenger as a liar; but open preaching is his only duty.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: See they not how God bringeth forth creation? and then causeth it to return again? This truly is easy for God.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: SAY,3 Go through the earth, and see how he hath brought forth created beings. Hereafter, with a second birth will God cause them to be born again; for God is Almighty.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Whom He pleaseth will He chastise, and on whom He pleaseth will He have mercy, and to Him shall ye be taken back.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And ye shall not invalidate his power either in the Earth or in the Heaven:4 and, save God, ye shall have neither patron nor helper.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: As for those who believe not in the signs of God, or that they shall ever meet him, these of my mercy shall despair, and these doth a grievous chastisement await."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And the only answer of his people was to say, "Slay him or burn him." But from the fire did God save him! Verily, herein are signs to those who believe.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And Abraham said, "Of a truth ye have taken idols along with God as your bond of union5 in this life present;

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: But on the day of resurrection some of you shall deny the others, and some of you shall curse the others; and your abode shall be the fire, and ye shall have none to help."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: But Lot believed on him,6 and said, "I betake me to my Lord, for He truly is the Mighty, the Wise."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And we bestowed on him Isaac and Jacob,7 and placed the gift of prophecy and the Scripture among his posterity; And we gave him his reward in this world, and in the next he shall be among the just.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: We sent also Lot: when he said to his people, "Proceed ye to a filthiness in which no people in the world hath ever gone before you?

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Proceed ye even to men? attack ye them on the highway? and proceed ye to the crime in your assemblies?" But the only answer of his people was to say, "Bring God's chastisement upon us, if thou art a man of truth."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: He cried: My Lord! help me against this polluted people.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And when our messengers came to Abraham with the tidings of a son, they said, "Of a truth we will destroy the in-dwellers in this city, for its in-dwellers are evil doers."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: He said, "Lot is therein." They said, "We know full well who therein is. Him and his family will we save, except his wife; she will be of those who linger.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And when our messengers came to Lot, he was troubled for them, and his arm was too weak8 to protect them; and they said, "Fear not, and distress not thyself, for thee and thy family will we save, except thy wife; she will be of those who linger.9

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: We will surely bring down upon the dwellers in this city vengeance from Heaven for the excesses they have committed."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And in what we have left of it is a clear sign to men of understanding.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And to Madian we sent their brother Shoaib. And he said, "Oh! my people! worship God, and expect the latter day, and enact not in the land deeds of harmful excess."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: But they treated him as an impostor: so an earthquake assailed them; and at morn they were found prostrate and dead in their dwellings.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And we destroyed Ad and Themoud. Already is this made plain to you in the ruins of their dwellings. For Satan had made their own works fair seeming to them, and drew them from the right path, keen-sighted though they were.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And Corah and Pharaoh and Haman. With proofs of his mission did Moses come to them, and they behaved proudly on the earth; but us they could not outstrip;10

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: For, every one of them did we seize in his sin. Against some of them did wesend a stone-charged wind: Some of them did the terrible cry of Gabriel surprise: for some of them we cleaved the earth; and some of them we drowned. And it was not God who would deal wrongly by them, but they wronged themselves.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: The likeness for those who take to themselves guardians instead of God is the likeness of the SPIDER who buildeth her a house: But verily, frailest of all houses surely is the house of the spider. Did they but know this!

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: God truly knoweth all that they call on beside Him; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: These similitudes do we set forth to men: and none understand them except the wise.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: God hath created the Heavens and the Earth for a serious end.11 Verily in this is a sign to those who believe.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Recite the portions of the Book which have been revealed to thee and discharge the duty of prayer: for prayer restraineth from the filthy and the blame-worthy. And the gravest duty is the remembrance of God; and God knoweth what ye do.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Dispute not, unless in kindly sort, with the people of the Book;12 save with such of them as have dealt wrongfully with you: And say ye, "We believe in what hath been sent down to us and hath been sent down to you. Our God and your God is one, and to him are we self-surrendered" (Muslims).

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Thus have we sent down the Book of the Koran to thee: and they to whom we have given the Book of the law believe in it: and of these Arabians there are those who believe in it: and none, save the Infidels, reject our signs.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Thou didst not recite any book (of revelation) before it: with that right hand of thine thou didst not transcribe one: else might they who treat it as a vain thing have justly doubted:

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: But it is a clear sign in the hearts of those whom "the knowledge" hath reached. None except the wicked reject our signs.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And they say, "Unless a sign be sent down to him from his Lord. . . ." SAY: Signs are in the power of God alone. I am only a plain spoken warner.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Is it not enough for them that we have sent down to thee the Book to be recited to them? In this verily is a mercy and a warning to those who believe.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: SAY: God is witness enough between me and you.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: He knoweth all that is in the Heavens and the Earth, and they who believe in vain things13 and disbelieve in God-these shall be the lost ones.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: They will challenge thee to hasten the punishment: but had there not been a season fixed for it, that punishment had already come upon them. But it shall overtake them suddenly when they look not for it.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: They will challenge thee to hasten the punishment: but verily Hell shall be round about the infidels.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: One day the punishment shall wrap them round, both from above them and from beneath their feet; and God will say, "Taste ye your own doings."

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: O my servants who have believed! Vast truly is my Earth:14 me, therefore! yea worship me.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: Every soul shall taste of death. Then to us shall ye return.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: But those who shall have believed and wrought righteousness will we lodge in gardens with palaces, beneath which the rivers flow. For ever shall they abide therein. How goodly the reward of those who labour,

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Who patiently endure, and put their trust in their Lord!

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: How many animals are there which provide not15 their own food! God feedeth them and you. He Heareth, Knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: If thou ask them who hath created the Heavens and the Earth, and hath imposed laws on the sun and on the moon, they will certainly say, "God." How then can they devise lies?

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: God lavisheth supplies on such of his servants as He pleaseth or giveth to them by measure. God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: If thou ask them who sendeth rain from heaven, and by it quickeneth the earth, after it hath been dead, they will certainly answer, "God." SAY: Praise be to God! Yet most of them do not understand.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: This present life is no other than a pastime and a disport: but truly the future mansion is life indeed! Would that they knew this!

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: Lo! when they embark on shipboard, they call upon God, vowing him sincere worship, but when He bringeth them safe to land, behold they join partners with Him.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: In our revelation they believe not, yet take their fill of good things. But in the end they shall know their folly.

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Do they not see that we have established a safe precinct16 while all around them men are being spoiled? Will they then believe in vain idols, and not own the goodness of God?

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: But who acteth more wrongly than he who deviseth a lie against God, or calls the truth when it hath come to him, a lie? Is there not an abode for the infidels in Hell?

records.label: Surah 29 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: And whoso maketh efforts for us, in our ways will we guide them: for God is assuredly with those who do righteous deeds.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ELIF. LAM. MIM.1 THE GREEKS have been defeated2

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: In a land hard by: But after their defeat they shall defeat their foes,

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: In a few years.3 First and last is the affair with God. And on that day shall the faithful rejoice

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: In the aid of their God: He aideth whom He will; and He is the Mighty, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: It is the promise of God: To his promise God will not be untrue: but most men know it not.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: They know the outward shews of this life present, but of the next life are they careless.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Have they not considered within themselves that God hath not created the Heavens and the Earth and all that is between them but for a serious end, and for a fixed term? But truly most men believe not that they shall meet their Lord.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Have they never journeyed through the land, and seen what hath been the end of those who were before them? Mightier were they than these in strength; and they broke up the land, and dwelt in it in greater numbers than they who dwell there now; and their apostles came to them with proofs of their mission: and it was not God who would wrong them, but they wronged themselves.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Then evil was the end of the evil doers; because they had treated our signs as lies, and laughed them to scorn.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: God bringth forth the creation-then causeth it to return again-then to Him shall ye come back.4

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And on the day when the hour shall arrive, the guilty shall be struck dumb for despair,

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And they shall have no intercessors from among the gods whom they have joined with God, and they shall deny the gods they joined with Him.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And on that day when the Hour shall arrive, shall men be separated one from another;

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And as for those who shall have believed and done the things that are right, they shall enjoy themselves in a flowery mead;

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: But as for those who shall not have believed, but treated our signs and the meeting of the next life as lies, they shall be given over to the torment.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Glorify God therefore when ye reach the evening, and when ye rise at morn:

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And to Him be praise in the Heavens and on the Earth; and at twilight, and when ye rest at noon.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: He bringeth forth the living out of the dead, and He bringeth forth the dead out of the living: and He quickeneth the earth when dead. Thus is it that ye too shall be brought forth.5

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And one of his signs it is that He hath created you out of dust; then lo! ye become men who spread themselves far and wide:

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And one of his signs it is, that He hath created wives for you of your own species,6 that ye may dwell with them, and hath put love and tenderness between you. Herein truly are signs for those who reflect.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And among his signs are the creation of the Heavens and of the Earth, and your variety of tongues and colour. Herein truly are signs for all men.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And of his signs are your sleep by night and by day, and your goings in quest of his bounties. Herein truly are signs to those who hearken.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And of his signs are, that He sheweth you the lightning, a source of awe and hope; and that He sendeth down rain from the heaven and giveth life by it to the earth when dead. Herein truly are signs to those who understand.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And of his signs also one is that the Heaven and the Earth stand firm at his bidding: hereafter, when with one summons He shall summon you out of the earth,-lo! forth shall ye come.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: His, whatsoever is in the Heavens and on the Earth: all are obedient to him.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And He it is who bringeth a creature forth, then causeth it to return again; and to him is this most easy. To whatever is loftiest in heaven and earth is He to be likened; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: He setteth forth to you an instance drawn from yourselves. Have ye among the slaves whom your right hands have won, any partner in what we have bestowed on you, so that ye share alike? Fear ye them as ye fear each other? (Thus make we our signs clear to men of understanding.)

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: No, ye do not. But the wicked, devoid of knowledge, follow their own desires:7 and those whom God shall mislead, who shall guide, and who shall be their protector?

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Set thou thy face then, as a true convert,8 towards the Faith which God hath made, and for which He hath made man. No change is there in the creation of God. This is the right Faith, but the greater part of men know it not.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And be ye turned to Him, and fear Him, and observe prayer, and be not of those who unite gods with God:

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Of those who have split up their religion, and have become sects, where every party rejoices in what is their own.9

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: When some evil toucheth men, they turn to their Lord and call upon him: then when he hath made them taste his mercy, lo, a part of them join other gods with their Lord,

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Ungrateful for our favours! Enjoy yourselves then. But in the end ye shall know your folly.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Have we sent down to them any mandate which speaketh in favour of what they join with God?

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: When we cause men to taste mercy they rejoice in it; but if, for that which their hands have aforetime wrought, evil befall them, they despair.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: See they not that God bestoweth full supplies on whom He pleaseth and giveth sparingly to whom He pleaseth? Signs truly are there herein to those who believe.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: To him who is of kin to thee give his due, and to the poor and to the wayfarer: this will be best for those who seek the face of God; and with them it shall be well.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Whatever ye put out at usury to increase it with the substance of others shall have no increase from God:10 but whatever ye shall give in alms, as seeking the face of God, shall be doubled to you.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: It is God who created you-then fed you-then will cause you to die-then will make you alive. Is there any of your companion-gods who can do aught of these things? Praise be to Him! and far be He exalted above the gods they join with Him.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Destruction hath appeared by land and by sea on account of what men's hands have wrought, that it might make them taste somewhat of the fruit of their doings, that haply they might turn to God.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: SAY: Journey through the land, and see what hath been the end of those who were before you! The greater part of them joined other gods with God.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Set thy face then towards the right faith, ere the day come which none can hinder God from bringing on.11 On that day shall they be parted in twain:

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Unbelievers on whom shall be their unbelief; and they who have wrought righteousness, and prepared for themselves couches of repose:

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: That of his bounty He may reward those who have believed and wrought righteousness; for the unbelievers He loveth not.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And one of his signs is that He sendeth the winds with glad tidings of rain, both that He may cause you to taste his mercy, and that ships may sail at his command, that out of his bounties ye may seek wealth, and that haply ye may render thanks.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: We have sent apostles before thee to their peoples, and they presented themselves to them with clear proofs of their mission; and while it behoved us to succour the faithful, we took vengeance on the guilty.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: It is God who sendeth the winds and uplifteth the clouds, and, as He pleaseth, spreadeth them on high, and breaketh them up; and thou mayest see the rain issuing from their midst; and when He poureth it down on such of his servants as He pleaseth, lo! they are filled with joy,

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Even they who before it was sent down to them, were in mute despair.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: Look then at the traces of God's mercy-how after its death he quickeneth the earth! This same God will surely quicken the dead, for to all things His might is equal.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Yet should we send a blast, and should they see their harvest turn yellow, they would afterwards shew themselves ungrateful.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Thou canst not make the dead to hear, neither canst thou make the deaf to hear the call, when they withdraw and turn their backs:

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: Neither canst thou guide the blind out of their error: in sooth, none shalt thou make to hear, save him who shall believe in our signs: for they are resigned to our will (Muslims).

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: It is God who hath created you in weakness, then after weakness hath given you strength: then after strength, weakness and grey hairs: He createth what He will; and He is the Wise, the Powerful.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: And on the day whereon the Hour shall arrive, the wicked will swear

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: That not above an hour have they waited: Even so did they utter lies on earth:

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: But they to whom knowledge and faith have been given will say, "Ye have waited, in accordance with the book of God, till the day of Resurrection: for this is the day of the Resurrection-but ye knew it not."

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: On that day their plea shall not avail the wicked, neither shall they again be bidden to seek acceptance with God.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: And now have we set before men, in this Koran, every kind of parable: yet if thou bring them a single verse of it, the infidels will surely say, "Ye are only utterers of vain things."

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: It is thus that God hath sealed up the hearts of those who are devoid of knowledge.

records.label: Surah 30 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: But do thou, Muhammad, bear with patience, for true is the promise of God; and let not those who have no firm belief, unsettle thee.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ELIF. LAM. MIM.2 These are the verses (signs) of the wise Book,

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: A guidance and a mercy to the righteous,

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Who observe prayer, and pay the impost,3 and believe firmly in the life to come:-

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: These rest on guidance from their Lord, and with these it shall be well.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But a man there is4 who buyeth an idle tale, that in his lack of knowledge he may mislead others from the way of God, and turn it to scorn. For such is prepared a shameful punishment!

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And when our signs are rehearsed to him, he turneth away disdainfully, as though he heard them not,-as though his ears were heavy with deafness. Announce to him therefore tidings of an afflictive punishment!

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But they who shall have believed and wrought good works, shall enjoy the gardens of delight:

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: For ever shall they dwell therein: it is God's true promise! and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Without pillars that can be seen hath He created the heavens, and on the earth hath thrown mountains lest it should move with you;5 and He hath scattered over it animals of every sort: and from the Heaven we send down rain and cause every kind of noble plant to grow up therein.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: This is the creation of God: Shew me now what others than He have created. Ah! the ungodly are in a manifest delusion.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Of old we bestowed wisdom upon LOKMAN, and taught him thus-"Be thankful to God: for whoever is thankful, is thankful to his own behoof; and if any shall be thankless . . . God truly is self-sufficient, worthy of all praise!"

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And bear in mind when Lokman said to his son by way of warning, "O my son! join not other gods with God, for the joining gods with God is the great impiety."

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: (We have commanded6 man concerning his parents. His mother carrieth him with weakness upon weakness; nor until after two years is he weaned.7 Be grateful to me, and to thy parents. Unto me shall all come.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: But if they importune thee to join that with Me of which thou hast no knowledge, obey them not: comport thyself towards them in this world as is meet and right; but follow the way of him who turneth unto me. Unto me shall ye return at last, and then will I tell you of your doings;)

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: "O my son! verily God will bring everything to light, though it were but the weight of a grain of mustard-seed, and hidden in a rock or in the heavens or in the earth; for, God is subtile, informed of all.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: O my son! observe prayer, and enjoin the right and forbid the wrong, and be patient under whatever shall betide thee: for this is a bounden duty.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And distort not thy face at men; nor walk thou loftily on the earth; for God loveth no arrogant vain-glorious one.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: But let thy pace be middling; and lower thy voice: for the least pleasing of voices is surely the voice of asses."

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: See ye not how that God hath put under you all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and hath been bounteous to you of his favours, both for soul and body.8 But some are there who dispute of God without knowledge, and have no guidance and no illuminating Book:

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And when it is said to them, Follow ye what God hath sent down, they say, "Nay; that religion in which we found our fathers will we follow." What! though Satan bid them to the torment of the flame?

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: But whoso setteth his face toward God with self-surrender, and is a doer of that which is good, hath laid hold on a sure handle; for unto God is the issue of all things.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: But let not the unbelief of the unbelieving grieve thee: unto us shall they return: then will we tell them of their doings; for God knoweth the very secrets of the breast.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Yet a little while will we provide for them: afterwards will we force them to a stern punishment.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: If thou ask them who hath created the heavens and the earth, they will certainly reply, "God." SAY: God be praised! But most of them have no knowledge.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: God's, whatever is in the Heavens and the Earth! for God, He is the Rich,9 the Praiseworthy.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: If all the trees that are upon the earth were to become pens, and if God should after that swell the sea into seven seas of ink, His words would not be exhausted: for God is Mighty, Wise.10

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Your creation and your quickening hereafter, are but as those of a single individual. Verily, God Heareth, Seeth!

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Seest thou not that God causeth the night to come in upon the day, and the day to come in upon the night? and that he hath subjected the sun and the moon to laws by which each speedeth along to an appointed goal? and that God therefore is acquainted with that which ye do?

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: This, for that God is the truth; and that whatever ye call upon beside Him is a vain thing; and that God-He is the High, the Great.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Seest thou not how the ships speed on in the sea, through the favour of God, that he may shew you of his signs? for herein are signs to all patient, grateful ones.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: When the waves cover them like dark shadows they call upon God as with sincere religion; but when He safely landeth them, some of them there are who halt between two opinions.11 Yet none reject our signs but all deceitful, ungrateful ones.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: O men! fear ye your Lord, and dread the day whereon father shall not atone for son, neither shall a son in the least atone for his father.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Aye! the promise of God is a truth. Let not this present life then deceive you; neither let the deceiver deceive you concerning God.

records.label: Surah 31 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Aye! God!-with Him is the knowledge of the Hour: and He sendeth down the rain-and He knoweth what is in the wombs-but no soul knoweth what it shall have gotten on the morrow: neither knoweth any soul in what land it shall die. But God is knowing, informed of all.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ELIF. LAM. MIM.1 This Book is without a doubt a Revelation sent down from the Lord of the Worlds.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Will they say, He hath forged it? Nay, it is the truth from thy Lord that thou mayest warn a people to whom no warner hath come before thee, that haply they may be guided.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: God it is who hath created the Heavens and the Earth and all that is between them in six days; then ascended his throne. Save Him ye have no patron, and none to plead for you. Will ye not then reflect?

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: From the Heaven to the Earth He governeth all things: hereafter shall they come up to him on a day whose length shall be a thousand of such years as ye reckon.2

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: This is He who knoweth the unseen and the seen; the Mighty, the Merciful,

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Who hath made everything which he hath created most good; and began the creation of man with clay;

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Then ordained his progeny from germs of life,3 from sorry water:

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Then shaped him, and breathed of His Spirit into him, and gave you hearing and seeing and hearts: what little thanks do ye return!

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And they say, "What! when we shall have lain hidden in the earth, shall we become a new creation?"

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Yea, they deny that they shall meet their Lord.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: SAY: The angel of death who is charged with you shall cause you to die: then shall ye be returned to your Lord.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Couldst thou but see when the guilty shall droop their heads before their Lord, and cry, "O our Lord! we have seen and we have heard: return us then to life: we will do that which is right. Verily we believe firmly!"

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: (Had we pleased we had certainly given to every soul its guidance. But true shall be the word which hath gone forth from me-I will surely fill hell with Djinn and men together.)

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: "Taste then the recompense of your having forgotten the meeting with this your day. We, too, we have forgotten you: taste then an eternal punishment for that which ye have wrought."

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: They only believe in our signs, who, when mention is made of them, fall down in ADORATION, and celebrate the praise of their Lord, and are not puffed up with disdain:

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Who, as they raise them4 from their couches, call on their Lord with fear and desire, and give alms of that with which we have supplied them.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: No soul knoweth what joy of the eyes is reserved for the good in recompense of their works.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Shall he then who is a believer be as he who sinneth grossly? they shall not be held alike.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: As to those who believe and do that which is right, they shall have gardens of eternal abode as the meed of their works:

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: But as for those who grossly sin, their abode shall be the fire: so oft as they shall desire to escape out of it, back shall they be turned into it. And it shall be said to them, Taste ye the torment of the fire, which ye treated as a lie.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And we will surely cause them to taste a punishment yet nearer at hand, besides the greater punishment, that haply they may turn to us in penitence.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Who acteth worse than he who is warned by the signs of his Lord, then turneth away from them? We will surely take vengeance on the guilty ones.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: We heretofore gave the Book of the law to Moses: have thou no doubt as to our meeting with him:5 and we appointed it for the guidance of the children of Israel.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And we appointed Imâms from among them who should guide after our command when they had themselves endured with constancy, and had firmly believed in our signs.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Now thy Lord! He will decide between them on the day of resurrection as to the subject of their disputes.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Is it not notorious to them how many generations, through whose abodes they walk, we have destroyed before them? Truly herein are sings: will they not then hear?

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: See they not how we drive the rain to some parched land and thereby bring forth corn of which their cattle and themselves do eat? Will they not then behold?

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: They say, "When will this decision take place? Tell us, if ye are men of truth?"

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: SAY: On the day of that decision, the faith of infidels shall not avail them, and they shall have no further respite.

records.label: Surah 32 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Stand aloof from them then, and wait thou, for they too wait.6

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O PROPHET, fear thou God, and obey not the unbelievers and the hypocrites;- Truly God is Knowing, Wise:

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: But follow what is revealed to thee from thy Lord: Cognisant truly is He of all your actions-

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And put thou thy trust in God, for a sufficient guardian is God.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: God hath not given a man two hearts within him; neither hath he made your wives whom ye divorce2 to be as your mothers; nor hath he made your adopted sons to be as your own sons. Such words are indeed in your mouths; but God speaketh the truth, and in the right way He guideth.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Name them after their fathers: this will be more right before God. But if ye know not who their fathers are, then let them be your brethren in the faith, and your comrades. And unless made with intent of heart, mistakes in this matter shall be no crime in you: for God is Lenient, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Nearer of kin to the faithful is the Prophet, than they are to their own selves. His wives are their mothers. According to the Book of God, they who are related by blood, are nearer the one to the other than other believers, and than those who have fled their country3 for the cause of God: but whatever kindness ye shew to your kindred, shall be noted down in the Book.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And remember that we have entered into covenant with the Prophets, and with thee, and with Noah, and Abraham, and Moses, and Jesus, Son of Mary: and we formed with them a strict covenant,

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: That God may question the men of truth as to their truth.4 But a sore torment hath He prepared for the unbelievers.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: O believers!5 remember the goodness of God towards you, when the armies came against you, and we sent against them a blast, and hosts that ye saw not; for the eye of God was upon your doings:

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: When they assailed you from above you, and from below you,6 and when your eyes became distracted, and your hearts came up into your throat, and ye thought divers thoughts of God:

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Then were the faithful tried, and with strong quaking did they quake:

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And when the disaffected and the diseased7 of heart said, "God and his Apostle have made us but a cheating promise:"

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And when a party of them said, "O people of Yathrib!8 there is no place of safety for you here;9 therefore return into the city." And another party of you asked the prophet's leave to return, saying, "Our houses are left defenceless." No! they were not left defenceless: but their sole thought was to flee away.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: If the enemy had effected an entry at all points, and they (the disaffected) had been asked to promote confusion, they would have done so; but only a short time would they have remained in it.-(Medina).10

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: They had before pledged themselves to God that they would not turn their backs; and a pledge given to God must be enquired of.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: SAY: Flight shall not profit you; if ye have fled the death or the slaughter, yet even then, but a little while shall ye enjoy your good things!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: SAY: Who is he that will screen you from God, whether He choose to bring evil on you, or to shew you mercy? None beside God shall they find to be their patron or helper.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: God well knoweth those among you who cause hindrances, and those who say to their brethren, "Come hither to us;" and who come not to the fight except a little.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: It is out of covetousness in your regard: for when an alarm cometh, thou mayest see them look to thee, and roll their eyes like him on whom the shadows of death have fallen! Yet, when the alarm is passed, with sharp tongues will they assail you, covetous of the best of the spoil. No faith have these! God will make their doings of no avail! And easy is this with God.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: They thought that the CONFEDERATES would never retire:11 and were the confederates to come again, they would fain be dwelling among the Arabs of the desert, and there ask news about you! for though they were with you, they fought not except a little.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: A noble pattern had ye in God's Apostle, for all who hope in God, and in the latter day, and oft remember God!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And when the faithful saw the confederates, they said, "This is what God and His Apostle promised us,12 and God and His Apostle spoke truly:" and it only increased their faith and self-devotion.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Some were there among the faithful who made good what they had promised to God. Some have fulfilled their course, and others await its fulfilment, and have not been changelings who change-

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: That God may reward the faithful for their faithfulness, and may punish the hypocrites, if He so please, or be turned unto them: for God is Forgiving, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And God drove back the infidels in their wrath; they won no advantage; God sufficed the faithful in the fight: for God is Strong, Mighty!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And He caused those of the people of the Book (the Jews), who had aided the confederates, to come down out of their fortresses, and cast dismay into their hearts: some ye slew, others ye took prisoners.13

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And He gave you their land, and their dwellings, and their wealth, for an heritage-even a land on which ye had never set foot: for the might of God is equal to all things.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: O Prophet! say to thy wives,14 If ye desire this present life and its braveries, come then, I will provide for you, and dismiss you with an honourable dismissal.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: But if ye desire God and His Apostle, and a home in the next life, then, truly, hath God prepared for those of you who are virtuous, a great reward.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: O wives of the Prophet! should any of you be guilty of a proven lewdness, doubly shall her chastisement be doubled: and with God this is easy.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: But whoever of you shall obey God and His Apostle, and shall do that which is right, twice over will we give her her reward, and we have prepared for her a noble provision.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: O wives of the Prophet! ye are not as other women. If ye fear God, be not too complaisant of speech, lest the man of unhealthy heart should lust after you, but speak with discreet speech.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And abide still in your houses, and go not in public decked as in the days of your former ignorance,15 but observe prayer, and pay the impost, and obey God and the Apostle: for God only desireth to put away filthiness from you16 as his household, and with cleansing to cleanse you.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And recollect what is rehearsed to you in your houses of the Book of God, and of wisdom: for God is keen-sighted, cognisant of all.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Truly the men who resign themselves to God (Muslims), and the women who resign themselves, and the believing men and the believing women, and the devout men and the devout women, and the men of truth, and the women of truth, and the patient men and the patient women, and the humble men and the humble women, and the men who give alms and the women who give alms, and the men who fast and the women who fast, and the chaste men and the chaste women, and the men and the women who oft remember God: for them hath God prepared forgiveness and a rich recompense.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And it is not for a believer, man or woman, to have any choice in their affairs, when God and His Apostle have decreed a matter: and whoever disobeyeth God and His Apostle, erreth with palpable error.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 38
