records.text: And, remember, when thou saidst to him unto whom God had shewn favour,17 and to whom thou also hadst shewn favour, "Keep thy wife to thyself, and fear God;" and thou didst hide in thy mind what God would bring to light.18 and thou didst fear man; but more right had it been to fear God. And when Zaid had settled concerning her to divorce her, we married her to thee, that it might not be a crime in the faithful to marry the wives of their adopted sons, when they have settled the affair concerning them. And the behest of God is to be performed.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: No blame attacheth to the prophet where God hath given him a permission. Such was the way of God with those prophets who flourished before thee; for God's behest is a fixed decree-

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Who fulfilled the mission with which God had charged them,19 and feared Him, and feared none but God. And God taketh a sufficient account.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Muhammad is not the father of any man among you, but he is the Apostle of God, and the seal of the prophets: and God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: O Believers! remember God with frequent remembrance, and praise Him morning and evening.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: He blesseth you, and His angels intercede for you, that He may bring you forth out of darkness into light: and Merciful is He to the Believers.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Their greeting on the day when they shall meet Him shall be "Peace!" And He hath got ready for them a noble recompense.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: O Prophet ! we have sent thee to be a witness, and a herald of glad tidings, and a warner;

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And one who, through His own permission, summoneth to God, and a light-giving torch.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Announce, therefore, to believers, that great boons do await them from God;

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And obey not the Infidels and Hypocrites-yet abstain from injuring them: and put thou thy trust in God, for God is a sufficient guardian.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: O Believers! when ye marry believing women, and then divorce them before ye have consummated the marriage, ye have no term prescribed you, which ye must fulfil towards them: provide for them, and dismiss them with a reputable dismissal.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: O Prophet! we allow thee thy wives whom thou hast dowered, and the slaves whom thy right hand possesseth out of the booty which God hath granted thee, and the daughters of thy uncle, and of thy paternal and maternal aunts who fled with thee to Medina, and any believing woman who hath given herself up to the Prophet, if the Prophet desired to wed her-a Privilege for thee above the rest of the Faithful.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: We well know what we have settled for them, in regard to their wives and to the slaves whom their right hands hold, that there may be no fault on thy part:20 and God is Indulgent, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Thou mayst decline for the present whom thou wilt of them, and thou mayest take to thy bed her whom thou wilt, and whomsoever thou shalt long for of those thou shalt have before neglected; and this shall not be a crime in thee. Thus will it be easier to give them the desire of their eyes, and not to put them to grief, and to satisfy them with what thou shalt accord to each of them. God knoweth what is in your hearts, and God is Knowing, Gracious.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: It is not permitted thee to take other wives hereafter,21 nor to change thy present wives for other women, though their beauty charm thee, except slaves whom thy right hand shall possess.22 And God watcheth all things.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: O Believers! enter not into the houses of the Prophet,23 save by his leave, for a meal, without waiting his time. When ye are invited then enter, and when ye have eaten then disperse at once.24 And engage not in familiar talk, for this would cause the Prophet trouble, and he would be ashamed to bid you go; but God is not ashamed to say the truth. And when ye would ask any gift of his wives, ask it from behind a veil. Purer will this be for your hearts and for their hearts. And ye must not trouble the Apostle of God, nor marry his wives, after him, for ever. This would be a grave offence with God.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Whether ye bring a matter to the light or hide it, God truly hath knowledge of all things.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: No blame shall attach to them (your wives) for speaking to their fathers unveiled, or to their sons, or to their brothers, or to their brothers' sons, or to their sisters' sons, or to their women, or to the slaves whom their right hands hold. And fear ye God: for God witnesseth all things.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Verily, God and His Angels bless the Prophet! Bless ye Him, O Believers, and salute Him with salutations of Peace.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: Verily, they who affront God and His Apostle, the curse of God is on them in this world, and in the world to come: and He hath prepared for them a shameful chastisement.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: And they who shall affront believing men and believing women, for no fault of theirs, they shall surely bear the guilt of slander, and of a clear wrong.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: O Prophet! speak to thy wives and to thy daughters,25 and to the wives of the Faithful, that they let their veils fall low. Thus will they more easily be known, and they will not be affronted. God is Indulgent, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: If the Hypocrites, and the men of tainted heart, and the stirrers of sedition in Medina desist not, we will surely stir thee up against them. Then shall they not be suffered to dwell near thee therein, but a little while:

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Cursed wherever they are found; they shall be seized and slain with slaughter!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Such hath been the way of God with those who lived before them; and no change canst thou find in the way of God.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Men will ask thee of "the Hour." SAY: The knowledge of it is with God alone: and who can tell thee whether haply the Hour be not nigh at hand?

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Verily, God hath cursed the Infidels, and hath got ready for them the flame:

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: For aye shall they abide therein; none to befriend them, no helper shall they find!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: On the day when their faces shall be rolled in the fire, they shall cry: "Oh! would that we had obeyed God, and obeyed the Apostle!"

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: And they shall say: "Oh our Lord! indeed we obeyed our chiefs and our great ones, and they misled us from the way of God-

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: O our Lord! give them a double chastisement, and curse them with a heavy curse."

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: O Believers! be not like those who affronted Moses.26 But God cleared him from what they said of him, and of God was he highly esteemed.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: O Believers! fear God, and speak with well-guided speech.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: That God may bless your doings for you, and forgive you your sins. And whoso obeyeth God and His Apostle with great bliss shall be blessed.

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: Verily, we proposed to the Heavens, and to the Earth, and to the Mountains to receive the Faith, but they refused the burden, and they feared to receive it. Man undertook to bear it, but hath proved unjust, senseless!

records.label: Surah 33 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: Therefore will God punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the men and the women who join gods with God; but to the believing men and women will God turn him: for God is Indulgent, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: PRAISE be to God! to whom belongeth all that is in the Heavens and all that is on the Earth; and to Him be praise in the next world: for he is the All- wise, the All-informed!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: He knoweth what entereth into the earth, and what proceedeth from it; and what cometh down from heaven, and what goeth up into it: and He is the Merciful, the Forgiving!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: "Never," say the unbelievers, "will the Hour come upon us!" SAY: Yea, by my Lord who knoweth the unseen, it will surely come upon you! not the weight of a mote either in the Heavens or in the Earth escapeth him; nor is there aught less than this or aught greater, which is not in the clear Book;-

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: To the intent that God may reward those who have believed and done the things that are right: Pardon and a noble provision shall they receive:

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But as for those who aim to invalidate our signs,-a chastisement of painful torment awaiteth them!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And they to whom knowledge hath been given see that what hath been sent down to thee from thy Lord is the truth, and that it guideth into the way of the Glorious one, the Praiseworthy.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But the unbelievers say to those whom they fall in with, "Shall we shew you a man who will foretell you that when ye shall have been utterly torn and rent to pieces, ye shall be restored in a new form?

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: He deviseth a lie about God, or there is a djinn in him," but they who believe not in the next life, shall incur the chastisement, and be lost in the mazes of estrangement from God.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: What! have they never contemplated that which is before them and behind them, the Heaven and the Earth? If such were our pleasure, we could sink them into that Earth, or cause a portion of that Heaven to fall upon them! herein truly is a sign for our every returning servant.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Of old bestowed we on David a gift, our special boon:-"Ye mountains and ye birds answer his songs of praise." And we made the iron soft for him:-"Make coats of mail, and arrange its plates; and work ye righteousness; for I behold your actions."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And unto Solomon did we subject the wind, which travelled in the morning a month's journey, and a month's journey in the evening. And we made a fountain of molten brass to flow for him. And of the Djinn were some who worked in his presence, by the will of his Lord; and such of them as swerved from our bidding will we cause to taste the torment of the flame.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: They made for him whatever he pleased, of lofty halls, and images, and dishes large as tanks for watering camels, and cooking pots that stood firmly. "Work," said we, "O family of David with thanksgiving:" But few of my servants are the thankful!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And when we decreed the death of Solomon, nothing shewed them that he was dead but a reptile of the earth that gnawed the staff which supported his corpse.2 And when it fell, the Djinn perceived that if they had known the things unseen, they had not continued in this shameful affliction.3

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: A sign there was to SABA, in their dwelling places:-two gardens, the one on the right hand and the other on the left:-"Eat ye of your Lord's supplies, and give thanks to him: Goodly is the country, and gracious is the Lord!"

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: But they turned aside: so we sent upon them the flood of Irem;4 and we changed them their gardens into two gardens of bitter fruit and tamarisk and some few jujube trees.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Such was our retribution on them for their ingratitude: but do we thus recompense any except the ungrateful?

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And we placed between them and the cities which we have blessed, conspicuous cities, and we fixed easy stages: "Travel ye through them by night and day, secure."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: But they said, "O Lord! make the distance between our journeys longer,"5-and against themselves did they act unjustly: so we made them a tale, and scattered them with an utter scattering. Truly herein are signs to everyone that is patient, grateful.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And Eblis found that he had judged truly of them: and they all except a remnant of the faithful, followed him:

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Yet no power had he over them. Only we would discern him who believed in the life to come, from him who doubted of it; for thy Lord watcheth all things.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: SAY: Call ye upon those whom ye deem gods, beside God: their power in the Heavens and in the Earth is not the weight of an atom-neither have they any share in either; nor hath He a helper from among them.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: No intercession shall avail with Him but that which He shall Himself allow. Until when at last their hearts shall be relieved from terror, they shall say, "What saith your Lord?" they shall say, "The Truth; and He is the High, the Great."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: SAY: Who supplieth you out of the Heavens and the Earth? SAY: God. And either we or ye have guidance, or are in palpable error!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: SAY: Not as to our faults shall ye be questioned; neither shall we be questioned as to your actions.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: SAY: Our Lord will gather us together: then will He judge between us in justice; for He is the Judge, the Knowing!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: SAY: Shew me those whom ye have united with Him as associates: Nay, rather, He is God, the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And we have sent thee to mankind at large, to announce and to threaten. But most men understand not.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And they say, "When will this threat come to pass? Tell us, if ye be men of truth."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: SAY: Ye are menaced with a day, which not for an hour shall ye retard or hasten on.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: The unbelievers say, "We will not believe in this Koran, nor in the Books which preceded it." But couldst thou see when the wicked shall be set before their Lord! With reproaches will they answer one another. The weak shall say to the mighty ones, "But for you we had been believers:"

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Then shall the mighty ones say to the weak, "What! was it we who turned you aside from the guidance which had reached you? Nay, but ye acted wickedly yourselves."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And the weak shall say to the mighty ones, "Nay, but there was a plot by night and by day, when ye bad us believe not in God, and gave him peers." And they shall proclaim their repentance after they have seen the punishment! And yokes will we place on the necks of those who have not believed! Shall they be rewarded but as they have wrought?

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And never have we sent a warner to any city whose opulent men did not say, "In sooth we disbelieve your message."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And they said, "We are the more abundant in riches and in children, nor shall we be among the punished."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: SAY: Of a truth my Lord will be liberal or sparing in his supplies to whom he pleaseth: but the greater part of men acknowledge it not.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Neither by your riches nor by your children shall you bring yourselves into nearness with Us; but they who believe and do the thing that is right shall have a double reward for what they shall have done: and in the pavilions of Paradise shall they dwell secure!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: But they who shall aim to invalidate our signs, shall be consigned to punishment.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: SAY: Of a truth my Lord will be liberal in supplies to whom he pleaseth of his servants, or will be sparing to him: and whatever ye shall give in alms he will return; and He is the best dispenser of gifts.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: One day he will gather them all together: then shall he say to the angels, "Did these worship you?"

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: They shall say, "Glory be to thee! Thou art our master, not these! But they worshipped the Djinn: it was in them that most of them believed.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: On this day the one of you shall have no power over others for help or hurt. And we will say to the evil doers, "Taste ye the torment of the fire, which ye treated as a delusion."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: For when our distinct signs are recited to them, they say, "This is merely a man who would fain pervert you from your father's Worship." And they say, "This (Koran) is no other than a forged falsehood." And the unbelievers say to the truth when it is presented to them, "Tis nothing but palpable sorcery."

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Yet have we given them no books in which to study deeply, nor have we sent any one to them before thee, charged with warnings.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: They also flourished before them, treated our apostles as impostors in like sort: but not to the tenth part of what we bestowed on them,6 have these attained. And yet when they charged my apostles with deceit, how terrible was my vengeance:

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: SAY: One thing in sooth do I advise you:-that ye stand up before God two and two, or singly,7 and then reflect that in your fellow citizen is no djinn:8 he is no other than your warner before a severe punishment.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: SAY: I ask not any wage from you: keep it for yourselves: my wage is from God alone. And He is witness over all things!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: SAY: Truly my Lord sendeth forth the Truth:-Knower of things unseen!

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: SAY: Truth is come, and falsehood shall vanish and return no more.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: SAY: If I err, verily to my own cost only shall I err: but if I have guidance, it will be of my Lord's revealing, for He is the Hearer, the near at hand.

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Couldst thou see how they shall tremble and find no escape, and be taken forth from the place that is so near;9

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And shall say, "We believe in Him!" But how, in their present distance, shall they receive the faith,

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: When they had before denied it, and aimed their shafts at the mysteries from afar?10

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And a gulf shall be between them and that which they shall desire-

records.label: Surah 34 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: As was done unto their likes of old, who were lost in the questionings of doubt.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: PRAISE be to God, Maker of the Heavens and of the Earth! Who employeth the ANGELS as envoys, with pairs of wings, two, three, and four: He addeth to his creature what He will! Truly God hath power for all things.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: The mercy which God layeth open for man, no one can keep back; and what He shall keep back, none can afterwards send forth. And He is the Mighty, the Wise.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: O men! bear in mind the favour of God towards you. Is there a creator other than God, who nourisheth you with the gifts of heaven and earth? There is no God but He! How then are ye turned aside from Him?

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: If they treat thee as an impostor, then before thee have apostles been treated as impostors. But to God shall all things return.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: O men! assuredly the promise of God is true: let not then the present life deceive you: and let not the Deceiver deceive you as to God.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Yes, Satan is your foe. For a foe then hold him. He calleth his followers to him that they may become inmates of the flame.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: The unbelievers,-for them a terrible punishment!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: But believers and doers of good works, for them is mercy, and a great reward!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Shall he, the evil of whose deeds are so tricked out to him that he deemeth them good, be treated like him who seeth things aright? Verily God misleadeth whom He will, and guideth whom He will. Spend not thy soul in sighs for them: God knoweth their doings.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: It is God who sendeth forth the winds which raise the clouds aloft: then drive we them on to some land dead from drought,1 and give life thereby to the earth after its death. So shall be the resurrection.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: If any one desireth greatness, all greatness is in God. The good word riseth up to Him, and the righteous deed will He exalt. But a severe punishment awaiteth the plotters of evil things; and the plots of such will He render vain.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Moreover, God created you of dust-then of the germs of life-then made you two sexes: and no female conceiveth or bringeth forth without his knowledge; and the aged ageth not, nor is aught minished from man's age, but in accordance with the Book. An easy thing truly is this to God.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Nor are the two seas2 alike: the one fresh, sweet, pleasant for drink, and the other salt, bitter; yet from both ye eat fresh fish, and take forth for you ornaments to wear, and thou seest the ships cleaving their waters that ye may go in quest of his bounties, and that ye may be thankful.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: He causeth the night to enter in upon the day, and the day to enter in upon the night; and He hath given laws to the sun and to the moon, so that each journeyeth to its appointed goal: This is God your Lord: All power is His: But the gods whom ye call on beside Him have no power over the husk of a date stone!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: If ye cry to them they will not hear your cry; and if they heard they would not answer you, and in the day of resurrection they will disown your joining them with God: and none can instruct thee like Him who is informed of all.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: O men! ye are but paupers in need of God; but God is the Rich, the Praiseworthy!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: If He please, He could sweep you away, and bring forth a new creation!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Nor will this be hard for God.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And the burdened soul shall not bear the burden of another: and if the heavy laden soul cry out for its burden to be carried, yet shall not aught of it be carried, even by the near of kin! Thou shalt warn those who fear their Lord in secret, and observe prayer. And whoever shall keep himself pure, he purifieth himself to his own behoof: for unto God shall be the final gathering.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And the blind and the seeing are not alike; neither darkness and light; nor the shade and the hot wind;

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Nor are the living and the dead the same thing! God indeed shall make whom He will to hearken, but thou shalt not make those who are in their graves to hearken; for only with warning art thou charged.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Verily we have sent thee with the truth; a bearer of good tidings and a warner; nor hath there been a people unvisited by its warner.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And if they treat thee as a liar, so did those who were before them threat their Apostles who came to them with the proofs of their mission, and with the Scriptures and with the enlightening Book:3

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Then chastised I the unbelievers: and how great was my vengeance!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Seest thou not how that God sendeth down water from the Heaven, and that by it we cause the up-growth of fruits of varied hues, and that on the mountains4 are tracks of varied hues, white and red, and others are of a raven black? And of men and reptiles and animals, various likewise are the hues. Such only of his servants as are possessed of knowledge fear God. Lo! God is Mighty, Gracious!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Verily they who recite the Book of God, and observe prayer, and give alms in public and in private from what we have bestowed upon them, may hope for a merchandise that shall not perish:

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: God will certainly pay them their due wages, and of his bounty increase them: for He is Gracious, Grateful.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And that which we have revealed to thee of the Book is the very Truth, confirmatory of previous Scriptures: for God knoweth and beholdeth his servants.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Moreover, we have made the Book an heritage to those of our servants whom we have chosen. Some of them injure themselves by evil deeds; others keep the midway between good and evil; and others, by the permission of God, outstrip in goodness; this is the great merit!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Into the gardens of Eden shall they enter: with bracelets of gold and pearl shall they be decked therein, and therein shall their raiment be of silk:

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And they shall say, "Praise be to God who hath put away sorrow from us. Verily our Lord is Gracious, Grateful,

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Who of His bounty hath placed us in a manison that shall abide for ever: therein no toil shall reach us, and therein no weariness shall touch us."

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: But for infidels is the fire of Hell; to die shall never be decreed them, nor shall aught of its torment be made light to them. Thus reward we every infidel!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And therein shall they cry aloud, "Take us hence, O our Lord! righteousness will we work, and not what we wrought of old."-"Prolonged we not your days that whoever would be warned might be warned therein? And the preacher came to you-

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Taste it then."-There is no protector for the unjust.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: God truly knoweth the hidden things both of the Heavens and of the Earth: for He knoweth the very secrets of the breast.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: He hath appointed you his vicegerents in the earth: And whoever believeth not, on him shall be his unbelief; and their unbelief shall only increase for the unbelievers, hatred at the hands of their Lord:-and their unbelief shall only increase for the unbelievers their own perdition!

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: SAY: What think ye of the gods whom ye invoke beside God? Shew me what part of the earth they have created? Had they a share in the creation of the Heavens? Have we given them a Book in which they can find proofs that they are to be called on? Nay, the wicked promise one another only deceits.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Verily God holdeth fast the Heavens and the Earth that they pass not away: and if they were passing away none could hold them back but He: for He is Kind, Gracious.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: They swore by God with their mightiest oath that should a preacher come to them they would yield to guidance more than any people: but when the preacher came to them it only increased in them their estrangement,

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Their haughtiness on earth and their plotting of evil! But the plotting of evil shall only enmesh those who make use of it.5 Look they then for aught but God's way6 of dealing with the peoples of old? Thou shalt not find any change in the way of God,-

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Yea, thou shalt not find any variableness in the way of God.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Have they never journeyed in the land and seen what hath been the end of those who flourished before them, though mightier in strength than they? God is not to be frustrated by aught in the Heavens or in the Earth; for He is the All-knowing, the All-mighty.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: If, moreover, God should chastise men according to their deserts, He would not leave even a reptile on the back of the earth! But to an appointed time doth He respite them.

records.label: Surah 35 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And when their time shall come, then verily God's eye is on his servants.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: YA. SIN.1 By the wise Koran!

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Surely of the Sent Ones, Thou,

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Upon a right path!

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: That thou shouldest warn a people whose fathers were not warned and therefore lived in heedlessness!

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Just, now, is our sentence2 against most of them; therefore they shall not believe.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: On their necks have we placed chains which reach the chin, and forced up are their heads:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Before them have we set a barrier and behind them a barrier, and we have shrouded them in a veil, so that they shall not see.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Alike is it to them if thou warn them or warn them not: they will not believe.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Him only shalt thou really warn, who followeth the monition and feareth the God of mercy in secret: him cheer with tidings of pardon, and of a noble recompense.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Verily, it is We who will quicken the dead, and write down the works which they have sent on before them, and the traces which they shall have left behind them: and everything have we set down in the clear Book of our decrees.3

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Set forth to them the instance of the people of the city4 when the Sent Ones came to it.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: When we sent two unto them and they charged them both with imposture- therefore with a third we strengthened them: and they said, "Verily we are the Sent unto you of God."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: They said, "Ye are only men like us: Nought hath the God of Mercy sent down. Ye do nothing but lie."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: They said, "Our Lord knoweth that we are surely sent unto you;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: To proclaim a clear message is our only duty."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: They said, "Of a truth we augur ill from you:5 if ye desist not we will surely stone you, and a grievous punishment will surely befall you from us."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: They said, "Your augury of ill is with yourselves. Will ye be warned?6 Nay, ye are an erring people."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Then from the end of the city a man came running:7 He said, "O my people! follow the Sent Ones;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Follow those who ask not of you a recompense, and who are rightly guided.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And why should I not worship Him who made me, and to whom ye shall be brought back?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Shall I take gods beside Him? If the God of Mercy be pleased to afflict me, their intercession will not avert from me aught, nor will they deliver:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Truly then should I be in a manifest error.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Verily, in your Lord have I believed; therefore hear me."8

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: -It was said to him, "Enter thou into Paradise:" And he said, "Oh that my people knew

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: How gracious God hath been to me, and that He hath made me one of His honoured ones."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But no army sent we down out of heaven after his death, nor were we then sending down our angels-

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: There was but one shout from Gabriel, and lo! they were extinct.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Oh! the misery that rests upon my servants! No apostle cometh to them but they laugh him to scorn.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: See they not how many generations we have destroyed before them?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Not to false gods is it that they shall be brought9 back,

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: But all, gathered together, shall be set before Us.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Moreover, the dead earth is a sign to them: we quicken it and bring forth the grain from it, and they eat thereof:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And we make in it gardens of the date and vine; and we cause springs to gush forth in it;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: That they may eat of its fruits and of the labour of their hands. Will they not therefore be thankful?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Glory be to Him, who hath created all the sexual pairs of such things as Earth produceth,10 and of mankind themselves; and of things beyond their ken!

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: A sign to them also is the Night. We withdraw the day from it, and lo! they are plunged in darkness;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And the Sun hasteneth to her place of rest. This, the ordinance of the Mighty, the Knowing!

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And as for the Moon, We have decreed stations for it, till it change like an old and crooked palm branch.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: To the Sun it is not given to overtake the Moon, nor doth the night outstrip the day; but each in its own sphere doth journey on.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: It is also a sign to them that we bare their posterity in the full-laden Ark;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: And that we have made for them vessels like it on which they embark;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: And if we please, we drown them, and there is none to help them, and they are not rescued,

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Unless through our mercy, and that they may enjoy themselves for yet awhile.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And when it is said to them, Fear what is before you and what is behind you,11 that ye may obtain mercy. . . .

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Aye, not one sign from among the signs of their Lord dost thou bring them, but they turn away from it!

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And when it is said to them, Give alms of what God hath bestowed on you,12 they who believe not say to the believers, "Shall we feed him whom God can feed if He will? Truly ye are in no other than a plain error."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And they say, "When will this promise be fulfilled, if what ye say be true?"

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: They await but a single blast: as they are wrangling shall it assail them:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And not a bequest shall they be able to make, nor to their families shall they return.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And the trumpet shall be blown, and, lo! they shall speed out of their sepulchres to their Lord:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: They shall say, "Oh! woe to us! who hath roused us from our sleeping place? 'Tis what the God of Mercy promised; and the Apostles spake the truth."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: But one blast shall there be,13 and, lo! they shall be assembled before us, all together.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: And on that day shall no soul be wronged in the least: neither shall ye be rewarded but as ye shall have wrought.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: But joyous on that day shall be the inmates of Paradise, in their employ;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: In shades, on bridal couches reclining, they and their spouses:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: Therein shall they have fruits, and shall have whatever they require-

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: "Peace!" shall be the word on the part of a merciful Lord.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: "But be ye separated this day, O ye sinners!

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Did I not enjoin on you, O sons of Adam, 'Worship not Satan, for that he is your declared foe,'

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: But 'Worship Me: this is a right path'?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: But now hath he led a vast host of you astray. Did ye not then comprehend?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: This is Hell with which ye were threatened:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Endure its heat this day, for that ye believed not."

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: On that day will we set a seal upon their mouths; yet shall their hands speak unto us, and their feet14 shall bear witness of that which they shall have done.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: And, if we pleased, we would surely put out their eyes: yet even then would they speed on with rivalry in their path: but how should they see?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: And, if we pleased, we would surely transform them as they stand,15 and they would not be able to move onward, or to return.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Him cause we to stoop through age whose days we lengthen. Will they not understand?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: We have not taught him (Muhammad) poetry,16 nor would it beseem him. This Book is no other than a warning and a clear Koran,

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: To warn whoever liveth; and, that against the Infidels sentence may be justly given.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: See they not that we have created for them among the things which our hands have wrought, the animals of which they are masters?

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: And that we have subjected them unto them? And on some they ride, and of others they eat;

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: And they find in them profitable uses and beverages:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: Yet have they taken other gods beside God that they might be helpful to them.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: No power have they to succour them: yet are their votaries an army at their service.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Let not their speech grieve thee: We know what they hide and what they bring to light.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: Doth not man perceive that we have created him of the moist germs of life? Yet lo! is he an open caviller.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: And he meeteth us with arguments,17 and forgetteth his creation: "Who," saith he, "shall give life to bones when they are rotten?"

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: SAY: He shall give life to them who gave them being at first, for in all creation is he skilled:

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: Who even out of the green tree hath given you fire18, and lo! ye kindle flame from it.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: What! must not He who hath created the Heavens and the Earth be mighty enough to create your likes? Yes! and He is the skilful creator.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: His command when He willeth aught, is but to say to it, BE, and IT IS.

records.label: Surah 36 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: So glory be to Him in whose hand is sway over all things! And to Him shall ye be brought back.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: By the angels ranged in order for Songs of Praise,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And by those who repel demons,1

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And by those who recite the Koran for warning,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Truly your God is but one,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that is between them, and Lord of the East.2

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: We have adorned the lower heaven with the adornment of the stars.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: They serve also as a guard against every rebellious Satan,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: That they overhear not what passeth in the assembly on high, for they are darted at from every side,3

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Driven off and consigned to a lasting torment;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: While, if one steal a word by stealth, a glistening flame pursueth him.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Ask the Meccans then, Are they, or the angels whom we have made, the stronger creation? Aye, of coarse clay have we created them.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: But while thou marvellest they mock;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: When they are warned, no warning do they take;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And when they see a sign, they fall to mocking,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And say, "This is no other than clear sorcery:

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: What! when dead, and turned to dust and bones, shall we indeed be raised?

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Our sires also of olden times?"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Say, Yes; and ye shall be covered with disgrace.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: For, one blast only, and lo! they shall gaze around them, And shall say, "Oh! woe to us! this is the day of reckoning; This is the day of decision which ye gainsaid as an untruth."

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Gather together those who have acted unjustly, and their consorts,4 and the gods whom they adored

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Beside God; and guide them to the road for Hell.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Set them forth: they shall be questioned.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: "How now, that ye help not one another?"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: But on this day they shall submit themselves to God,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And shall address one another with mutual reproaches.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: They shall say, "In sooth, ye came to us in well-omened sort:"5

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But they will answer, "Nay, it was ye who would not believe; and we had no power whatever over you. Nay, ye were people given to transgress;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Just, therefore, is the doom which our Lord hath passed upon us.6 We shall surely taste it:

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: We made you err, for we had erred ourselves."

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Partners therefore shall they be in punishment on that day.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Truly, thus will we deal with the wicked,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Because when it was said to them, There is no God but God, they swelled with pride,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And said, "Shall we then abandon our gods for a crazed poet?"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Nay, he cometh with truth and confirmeth the Sent Ones of old.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Ye shall surely taste the painful punishment,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And ye shall not be rewarded but as ye have wrought,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Save the sincere servants of God!

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: A stated banquet shall they have

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Of fruits; and honoured shall they be

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: In the gardens of delight,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Upon couches face to face.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: A cup shall be borne round among them from a fountain,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Limpid, delicious to those who drink;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: It shall not oppress the sense, nor shall they therewith be drunken.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And with them are the large-eyed ones with modest refraining glances, fair like the sheltered egg.7

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And they shall address one another with mutual questions.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Saith one of them, "I truly had a bosom friend,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Who said, 'Art thou of those who credit it?

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: What! when we shall have died, and become dust and bones, shall we indeed be judged?"'

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: He shall say to those around him, "Will ye look?"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And he shall look and see him in the midst of Hell.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And he shall say to him, "By God, thou hadst almost caused me to perish;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And, but for the favour of my Lord, I had surely been of those who have been brought with thee into torment."

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: "But do we not die," say the blessed,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: "Any other than our first death? and have we escaped the torment?"8

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: This truly is the great felicity!

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: For the like of this should the travailers travail!

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: Is this the better repast or the tree Ez-zakkoum?

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Verily, we have made it for a subject of discord to the wicked.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: It is a tree which cometh up from the bottom of hell;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Its fruits is as it were the heads of Satans;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And, lo! the damned shall surely eat of it and fill their bellies with it:

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Then shall they have, thereon, a mixture of boiling water:

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Then shall they return to hell.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: They found their fathers erring,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: And they hastened on in their footsteps.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: Also before them the greater number of the ancients had erred.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Though we had sent warners among them.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: But see what was the end of these warned ones,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: Except of God's true servants.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: Noah called on us of old, and right prompt were we to hear him,9

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: And we saved him and his family out of the great distress,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: And we made his offspring the survivors;

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: And we left for him with posterity,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: "Peace be on Noah throughout the worlds!"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Thus do we reward the well-doers,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: For he was one of our believing servants;-

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: And the rest we drowned.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And truly, of his faith was Abraham,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: When he brought to his Lord a perfect heart,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: When he said to his father and to his people, "What is this ye worship?

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: Prefer ye with falsehood gods to God?

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: And what deem ye of the Lord of the worlds?"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: So gazing he gazed towards the stars,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: And said, "In sooth I am ill:10

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: And they turned their back on him and departed.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: He went aside to their gods and said, "Do ye not eat?

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: What aileth you that ye do not speak?"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: He broke out upon them, with the right hand striking:

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: When his tribesmen came back to him with hasty steps

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: He said, "Worship ye what ye carve,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: When God hath created you, and that ye make?"

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: They said, "Build up a pyre for him and cast him into the glowing flame."

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: Fain would they plot against him, but we brought them low.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: And he said, "Verily, I repair to my Lord who will guide me:

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: O Lord give me a son, of the righteous."

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 98
records.text: We announced to him a youth of meekness.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 99
records.text: And when he became a full-grown youth,11

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 100
records.text: His father said to him, "My son, I have seen in a dream that I should sacrifice thee; therefore, consider what thou seest right."

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 101
records.text: He said, "My father, do what thou art bidden; of the patient, if

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 102
records.text: God please, shalt thou find me."

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 103
records.text: And when they had surrendered them to the will of God, he laid him down upon his forehead:

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 104
records.text: We cried unto him, "O Abraham!

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 105
records.text: Now hast thou satisfied the vision." See how we recompense the righteous.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 106
records.text: This was indeed a decisive test.

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 107
records.text: And we ransomed his son with a costly12 victim,

records.label: Surah 37 · edition paragraph 108
records.text: And we left this13 for him among posterity,

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: SAD.1 By the Koran full of warning! In sooth the Infidels are absorbed in pride, in contention with thee.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: How many generations have we destroyed before them! And they cried for mercy but no time was it of escape!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And they marvel that a warner from among themselves hath come to them; and the Infidels say, "This is a sorcerer, a liar:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Maketh he the gods to be but one god? A strange thing forsooth is this!"

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And their chiefs took themselves off. "Go, said they, and cleave steadfastly2 to your gods. Ye see the thing aimed at.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: We heard not of this in the previous creed.3 It is but an imposture:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: To him alone of us all hath a book of warning been sent down?" Yes! they are in doubt as to my warnings, for they have not yet tasted my vengeance.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Are the treasures of the mercy of thy Lord, the Mighty, the bounteous, in their hands?

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Is the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and of all that is between them theirs? Then let them mount up by cords!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Any army of the confederates4 shall here be routed.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Before them the people of Noah and Ad and Pharaoh the impaler5 treated their prophets as impostors;

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And Themoud, and the people of Lot, and the dwellers in the forest: these were the confederates.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Nought did they all but charge the apostles with falsehood: Just, therefore, the retribution.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And these (Meccans) await but one single trumpet blast-There shall be no delaying it-

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Yet they dare to say, "O our Lord! hasten our lot to us, before the day of reckoning."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Put thou up with what they say: and remember our servant David, a man strong of hand6, one who turned him to Us in penitence:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: We constrained the mountains7 to join with him in lauds at even and at sunrise;

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And the birds which flocked to him, and would all return to him oft;

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And we stablished his kingdom: and wisdom, and skill to pronounce clear decisions, did we bestow on him.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Hath the story of the two pleaders8 reached thee, O Muhammad, when they mounted the walls of his closet?

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: When they entered in upon David, and he was frightened at them, they said, "Be not afraid; we are two opposing parties: one of us hath wronged the other. Judge therefore with truth between us, and be not unjust, but guide us to the right way.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Now this my brother had ninety and nine ewes, and I had but a single ewe; and he said, make me her keeper. And he over-persuaded me in the dispute."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: He said, "Certainly he hath wronged thee in asking for thine ewe to add her to his own ewes: and truly many associates do one another wrong-except those who believe and do the things that are right; and few indeed are they!" And David perceived that we had tried him; so he asked pardon of his Lord, and fell down and bowed himself and repented.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: So we forgave him that his sin; and truly he shall have a high rank with Us, and an excellent retreat in Paradise.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: O David! verily we have made thee our vicegerent upon earth. Judge therefore between men with truth, and follow not thy passions, lest they cause thee to err from the way of God. For they who err from the way of God shall meet with a grievous chastisement, for that they have forgotten the day of reckoning.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: We have not created the heaven and the earth and what is between them for nought. That is the thought of infidels; but woe to the infidels because of the fire!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Shall we treat those who believe and do the things that are right like those who propagate evil on earth? Shall we treat the God-fearing like the impious?

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: A blessed Book9 have we sent down to thee, that men may meditate its verses, and that those endued with understanding may bear it in mind.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And Solomon gave we unto David. An excellent servant, for he loved to turn him Godward.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Remember when at eventide the prancing10 chargers were displayed before him,

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And he said, "Truly I have loved the love of earthly goods above the remembrance of my Lord, till the sun hath been hidden by the veil of darkness.11

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Bring them back to me." And he began to sever the legs and necks.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: We also made trial of Solomon, and placed a phantom12 on his throne: whereupon he returned to Us (in penitence).

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: He said, O my Lord! pardon me, and give me a dominion that may not be to any one beside me, for thou art the liberal giver.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: So we subjected the wind to him; it ran softly at his bidding, whithersoever he directed it:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And the Satans-every builder and diver-

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And others bound in chains:13

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: "This," said we, "is our gift: be bounteous then, or withhold thy favours; no account shalt thou render."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And his rank also is high with Us, and an excellent retreat.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And remember our servant Job when he cried to his Lord, "Verily, Satan hath laid on me disease and pain."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: "Stamp," said we, "with thy foot. This14 is to wash with; cool, and to drink."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: And we gave him back his family, and as many more with them in our mercy; and for a monition to men of judgment.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: And we said, "Take in thine hand a rod, and strike15 with it, nor break thine oath." Verily, we found him patient!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: How excellent a servant, one who turned to Us was he!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And remember our servants Abraham and Isaac and Jacob, men of might and vision.16

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: With this cleansing did we cleanse them the remembrance of the abode of Paradise.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And verily, they were, in our sight, of the elect and of the good.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And remember Ishmael and Elisha and Dhoulkefl, for all these were of the just.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: This is a monition: and verily, the pious shall have a goodly retreat:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Gardens of Eden, whose portals shall stand open to them:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Therein reclining, they shall there call for many a fruit and drink:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And with them shall be virgins of their own age, with modest retiring glances:

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: "This is what ye were promised at the day of reckoning."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: "Yes! this is our provision: it shall never fail."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: Even so. But for the evil doers is a wretched home-

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Hell-wherein they shall be burned: how wretched a bed!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: Even so. Let them then taste it-boiling water and gore,

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: And other things of kindred sort!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: To their leaders it shall be said, "This company shall be thrown in headlong with you. No greetings shall await them, for they shall be burned in the fire."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: They shall say: "But ye, too! there shall be no welcome for you. It was ye who prepared this for us, and wretched is the abode!"

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: They will say: "O our Lord! increase twofold in the fire, the punishment of him who hath brought this upon us."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And they will say: "Why see we not the men whom we numbered among the wicked-

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Whom we used to treat with scorn? Have they escaped our eyes?"17

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Verily this is truth-the wrangling together of the people of the fire.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: SAY: I am but a warner; and there is no God but God the One, the Almighty!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, and of all that is between them,18 the Potent, the Forgiving!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: SAY: this is a weighty message,19

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: From which ye turn aside!

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: Yet had I no knowledge of what passed among the celestial chiefs when they disputed,20

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: -Verily, it hath been revealed to me only because I am a public preacher-

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: When thy Lord said to the angels, "I am about to make man of clay,21

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: And when I have formed him and breathed my spirit into him, then worshipping fall down before him."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: And the angels prostrated themselves, all of them with one accord,

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: Save Eblis. He swelled with pride, and became an unbeliever.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: "O Eblis," said God, "what hindereth thee from prostrating thyself before him whom my hands have made?

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Is it that thou are puffed up with pride? or art thou a being of lofty merit?"

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: He said: "I am more excellent than he; me hast thou created of fire:22 of clay hast thou created him."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: He said: "Begone then hence: thou art accursed,23

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: And lo! my ban shall be on thee till the day of the reckoning."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: He said: "O my Lord! respite me till the day of Resurrection."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: He said, "One then of the respited shalt thou be,

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: Till the day of the time appointed."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: He said: "I swear by thy might then that all of them will I seduce,

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: Save thy sincere servants among them."

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: He said: "It is truth, and the truth I speak. From thee will I surely fill Hell, and with such of them as shall follow thee, one and all.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: Say: I ask no wage of you for this, nor am I one who intermeddleth.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: Of a truth the Koran is no other than a warning to all creatures.

records.label: Surah 38 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: And after a time shall ye surely know its message.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: THE Book1 sent down from God, the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: We have sent down the Book to thee with the truth: serve thou God then, and be sincere in thy worship:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Is not a sincere worship due to God?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: But they who take others beside him as lords saying, "We serve them only that they may bring us near to God"-God will judge between them and the faithful, concerning that wherein they are at variance.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Verily God will not guide him who is a liar, an infidel.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Had God desired to have had a son, he had surely chosen what he pleased out of his own creation. But praise be to Him! He is God, the One, the Almighty.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: For truth2 hath he created the Heavens and the Earth: It is of Him that the night returneth upon the day and that the day returneth upon the night: and He controlleth the sun and the moon so that each speedeth to an appointed goal. Is He not the Mighty, the Gracious?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: He created you all of one man, from whom He afterwards formed his wife; and of cattle He hath sent down to you four pairs.3 In the wombs of your mothers did He create you by creation upon creation in triple darkness. It is He who is God your Lord: the kingdom is His: There is no God but He. How then are ye so turned aside from Him?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Suppose ye render him no thanks! yet forsooth is God rich without you: but He is not pleased with thanklessness in His servants: yet if ye be thankful He will be pleased with you. The soul burdened with its own works shall not be burdened with the burden of another: hereafter shall ye return to your Lord, and he will tell you of all your works,

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: For he knoweth the very secrets of your breasts.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: When some trouble toucheth a man, he turneth to his Lord and calleth on him: yet no sooner hath He enriched him with his favour than he forgetteth Him on whom he before had called, and setteth up peers with God, that he may beguile others from His way. SAY: Enjoy thou thyself yet a little in thine ingratitude! but thou shalt surely be one of the inmates of the fire.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Shall he who observeth the hours of the night, prostrate or standing in devotion, heedful of the life to come, and hoping for the mercy of his Lord . . .? SAY: Shall they who have knowledge and they who have it not, be treated alike? In sooth, men of understanding only will take the warning.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: SAY: O my believing servants, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good: and broad is God's earth4-verily those who endure with patience shall be repaid: their reward shall not be by measure.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: SAY: I am bidden to serve God with a sincere worship: and I am bidden to be the first of those who surrender themselves to him (Muslims).

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: SAY: Verily I fear if I rebel against my Lord the punishment of a great day.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: SAY: God will I serve, presenting him with a sincere worship:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And serve ye what ye choose beside Him. SAY: The losers truly will they be who shall lose their own souls and their families on the day of resurrection: Is not this the clear ruin?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Canopies of fire shall be over them, and floors of fire beneath them. With this doth God alarm his servants: Fear ye me, then, O my servants!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: But good tidings are there for those who shun the worship of Thagout and are turned to God. Cheer then with good tidings those my servants who hearken to my word and follow its excellence. These are they whom God guideth, and these are men of insight.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Him then on whom the sentence of punishment hath justly lighted-him who is doomed to the fire canst thou rescue?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: But for those who fear their Lord are storied pavilions beneath which shall the rivers flow: it is the promise of God, and God will not fail in his promise.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Seest thou not that God sendeth down water from heaven, and guideth it along so as to form springs in the earth-then bringeth forth by it corn of varied sorts-then causeth he it to wither, and thou seest it become yellow-then crumbleth it away? Lo! herein is teaching for men of insight.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Shall he then whose breast God hath opened to Islam, and who hath light from his Lord . . .? But woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of God! They plainly err.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: The best of recitals hath God sent down a book in unison with itself, and teaching by iteration.5 The very skins of those who fear their Lord do creep at it! Then do their skins and their hearts soften at the remembrance of their Lord! This is God's guidance: by it will He guide whom He pleaseth; and, whom God shall mislead, no guide shall there be for him.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Shall he who shall have nought but his own face to shelter him with from the torment of the punishment on the day of the resurrection . . .? Aye, to the evil doers it shall be said, "Taste what ye have earned."

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: They who were before them said it was a lie; but a punishment came upon them whence they looked not for it:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And God made them taste humiliation in this present life: but greater surely will be the punishment of the life to come. Did they but know it!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Now have we set before man in this Koran every kind of parable for their warning:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: An Arabic Koran, free from tortuous wording, to the intent that they may fear God.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: God setteth forth the comparison of a man with associates6 at variance among themselves, and of a man devoted wholly to a man. Are these to be held alike? No, praise be to God! But the greater part of them understand not.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Thou truly shall die, O Muhammad, and they too shall die:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Then, at the day of resurrection, ye shall wrangle with one another in the presence of your Lord.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And who acteth more unjustly than he who lieth of God, and treateth the truth when it cometh to him as a lie? Is there not a dwelling-place in Hell for the infidels?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: But he who bringeth the truth, and he who believeth it to be the truth: these are the God-fearing.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Whatever they shall desire, awaiteth them with their Lord! This is the reward of the righteous;

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 37
