records.text: That God may do away the guilt of their worst actions, and for their best actions render them their reward.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Is not God all-sufficient for his servant? Yet would they scare thee by their idols. But no guide shall there be for him whom God misleadeth:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And he whom God guideth shall have none to mislead him. Is not God, all- mighty, able to revenge?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And if thou ask them who hath created the Heavens and the Earth, they will surely answer, God. SAY: Think ye, then, that they7 on whom ye call beside God, if God choose to afflict me, could remove his affliction? or if he choose to show me mercy, could they withhold His mercy? SAY: God sufficeth me: in Him let the trusting trust.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: SAY: O my people, act your part as best ye can, I too will act mine; and in the end ye shall know

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: On whom shall light a punishment that shall shame him, and on whom a lasting punishment shall fall.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Assuredly we have sent down the Book to thee for man and for the ends of truth. Whoso shall be guided by it-it will be for his own advantage, and whoso shall err, shall only err to his own loss. But not to thy keeping are they entrusted.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: God taketh souls unto Himself at death; and during their sleep those who do not die:8 and he retaineth those on which he hath passed a decree of death, but sendeth the others back till a time that is fixed. Herein are signs for the reflecting.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Have they taken aught beside God as intercessors? SAY: What! though they have no power over anything, neither do they understand?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: SAY: Intercession is wholly with God:9 His the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth! To him shall ye be brought back hereafter!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: But when the One God is named, the hearts of those who believe not in the life to come, shrivel up: but when the deities who are adored beside Him are named, lo! they are filled with joy.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: SAY: O God, creator of the Heaven and of the Earth, who knowest the hidden and the manifest, thou shalt judge between thy servants as to the subject of their disputes.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: If the wicked possessed all that is in the earth and as much again therewith, verily they would ransom themselves with it from the pain of the punishment on the day of the resurrection; and there shall appear to them, from God, things they had never reckoned on:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: And their own ill deeds shall be clearly perceived by them, and that fire at which they mocked shall encircle them on every side.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: When trouble befalleth a man he crieth to Us; afterwards, when we have vouchsafed favour to him, he saith, "God knew that I deserved it."10 Nay, it is a trial. But the greater part of them knew it not.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: The same said those who flourished before them; but their deeds profited them not.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And their own ill deeds recoiled upon them. And whoso among these (Meccans) shall do wrong, on them likewise their own misdeeds shall light, neither shall they invalidate God.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: Know they not that God giveth supplies with open hand, and that He is sparing to whom He will? Of a truth herein are signs to those who believe.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: SAY: O my servants who have transgressed to your own hurt,11 despair not of God's mercy, for all sins doth God forgive. Gracious, Merciful is He!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And return ye to your Lord, and to Him resign yourselves, ere the punishment come on you, for then ye shall not be helped:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: And follow that most excellent thing which hath been sent down to you from your Lord, ere the punishment come on you suddenly, and when ye look not for it:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: So that a soul say, "Oh misery! for my failures in duty towards God! and verily I was of those who scoffed:"

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: Or say, "Had God guided me, I had surely been of those who feared Him:"

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Or say, when it seeth the punishment, "Could I but return, then I would be of the righteous."

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Nay! my signs had already come to thee, and thou didst treat them as untruths, and wast arrogant, and becamest of those who believed not.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: And on the resurrection day, thou shalt see those who have lied of God, with their faces black. Is there not an abode in Hell for the arrogant?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: But God shall rescue those who fear him into their safe retreat: no ill shall touch them, neither shall they be put to grief.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: God is the creator of all things, and of all things is He the guardian! His the keys of the Heavens and of the Earth! and-who believe not in the signs of God-these! they shall perish!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: SAY: What! do ye then bid me worship other than God, O ye ignorant ones?

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: But now hath it been revealed to thee and to those who flourished before thee,-"Verily, if thou join partners with God, vain shall be all thy work, and thyself shalt be of those who perish.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: Nay, rather worship God! and be of those who render thanks."

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: But they have not deemed of God as is His due;12 for on the resurrection day the whole Earth shall be but his handful, and in his right hand shall the Heavens be folded together. Praise be to Him! and high be He uplifted above the partners they join with Him!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: And there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and all who are in the Heavens and all who are in the Earth shall expire, save those whom God shall vouchsafe to live. Then shall there be another blast on it, and lo! arising they shall gaze around them:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: And the earth shall shine with the light of her Lord, and the Book shall be set, and the prophets shall be brought up, and the witnesses; and judgment shall be given between them with equity; and none shall be wronged:

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: And every soul shall receive as it shall have wrought, for well knoweth He men's actions.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: And by TROOPS shall the unbelievers be driven towards Hell, until when they reach it, its gates shall be opened, and its keepers shall say to them, "Came not apostles from among yourselves to you, reciting to you the signs of your Lord, and warning you of the meeting with Him on this your day?"13 They shall say, "Yes." But just is the sentence of punishment on the unbelievers.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: It shall be said to them, "Enter ye the gates of Hell, therein to dwell for ever;" and wretched the abode of the arrogant!

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: But those who feared their Lord shall be driven on by troops to Paradise, until when they reach it, its gates shall be opened, and its keepers shall say to them, "All hail! virtuous have ye been: enter then in, to abide herein for ever."

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: And they shall say, "Praise be to God, who hath made good to us His promise, and hath given to us the earth as our heritage, that we may dwell in Paradise wherever we please!" And goodly is the reward of those who travailed virtuously.

records.label: Surah 39 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And thou shalt see the Angels circling around the Throne with praises of their Lord: and judgment shall be pronounced between them with equity: and it shall be said, "Glory be to God the Lord of the Worlds."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HA. MIM. The Revelation (sending down) of the Book is from God the Almighty, the All-knowing,1

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Forgiver of sin, and receiver of penitence,-vehement in chastisement,

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Long-suffering! There is no God but He: to Him shall be the final gathering.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: None but infidels gainsay the signs of God: but let not their prosperity in the land deceive thee.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: The people of Noah, and the confederates after them, have brought the charge of imposture before these Meccans: each nation schemed against their apostle to lay violent hold on him, and disputed with vain words to refute the truth. Therefore did I lay violent hold on them; and how great was my chastisement!

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Thus is it that thy Lord's sentence, that inmates shall they be of the fire, was accomplished upon the infidels.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: They who bear the throne2 and they who encircle it, celebrate the praise of their Lord and believe in Him, and implore forgiveness for the believers:-"O our Lord! thou embracest all things in mercy and knowledge; forgive, therefore, those who turn to thee and follow thy path; keep them from the pains of hell:

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: O our Lord! and bring them into the Gardens of Eden which thou hast promised to them, and to the righteous ones of their fathers and their wives and their children; for thou art the All-mighty, the All-wise:

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And keep them from evil: for on him hast thou mercy whom on that day thou shalt keep from evil;" and this will be the great felicity.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: But to the infidels shall a voice cry, "Surely the hatred of God is more grievous than your hatred of yourselves, when ye were called to the faith, and remained unbelievers."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: They shall say, "Twice, O our Lord, hast thou given us death, and twice hast thou given us life:3 and we acknowledge our sins: is there no way to escape?"

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: "This hath befallen you, for that when One God was proclaimed to you, ye believed not: but when partners had been united with him, ye believed: But judgment belongeth unto God, the High, the Great."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: It is He who sheweth you his signs, and sendeth down supplies to you from Heaven: but none will receive warning save he who turneth to God.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Call then on God, offering him a pure worship, though the infidels abhor it.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Of exalted grade, of the throne possessed, He sendeth forth the Spirit at His own behest on whomsoever of His servants He pleaseth, that He may warn of the day of meeting,

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: The day when they shall come forth from their graves, when nought that concerneth them shall be hidden from God. With whom shall be the power supreme on that day? With God, the One, the Almighty.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: On that day shall every soul be recompensed as it hath deserved: no injustice on that day! Verily, God will be swift to reckon.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Warn them, then, of the approaching day, when men's hearts shall rise up, choking them, into their throats.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: The evil-doers shall have no friend or intercessor who shall prevail.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: God knoweth the deceitful of eye, and what men's breasts conceal.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And everything will God decide with truth: But nothing shall those gods whom men call on beside him, decide. Verily, God! the Hearer, the Beholder, He!

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Have they never journeyed in this land, and seen what hath been the end of those who flourished before them? Mightier were they in strength than these Meccans, and their traces remain in the land: Yet God took them in their sins, and there was none to defend them against God.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: This, because their apostles had come to them with proofs of their mission, and they believed not: so God took them in hand; for He is mighty, vehement in punishing.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Moreover we had sent Moses of old with our signs and with clear authority.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: To Pharaoh, and Haman, and Karun:4 and they said, "Sorcerer, impostor."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And when he came to them from our presence with the truth, they said, "Slay the sons of those who believe as he doth, and save their females alive;" but the stratagem of the unbelievers issued only in failure.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And Pharaoh said, "Let me alone, that I may kill Moses; and let him call upon his Lord: I fear lest he change your religion, or cause disorder to shew itself in the land."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And Moses said, "I take refuge with my Lord and your Lord from every proud one who believeth not in the day of reckoning."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And a man of the family of Pharaoh, who was a BELIEVER,5 but hid his faith, said, "Will ye slay a man because he saith my Lord is God, when he hath already come to you with proofs of his mission from your Lord? and if he be a liar, on him will be his lie:6 but if he be a man of truth, part at least of what he threateneth will fall upon you. Truly God guideth not him who is a transgressor, a liar.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: O my people! this day is the kingdom yours, the eminent of the earth! but who shall defend us from the vengeance of God if it come on us?" Pharaoh said, "I would have you see only what I see; and in a right way only will I guide you."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Then said he who believed, "O my people! truly I fear for you the like of the day of the allies,7

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: The like of the state of the people of Noah and Ad and Themoud,

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And of those who came after them; yet God willeth not injustice to his servants.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And, O my people! I indeed fear for you the day of mutual outcry-

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: The day when ye shall be turned back from the Judgment into hell. No protector shall ye have then against God. And he whom God shall mislead no guide shall there be for him.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Moreover, Joseph had come to you before with clear tokens, but ye ceased not to doubt of the message with which he came to you, until when he died, ye said, 'God will by no means raise up an apostle after him.' " Thus God misleadeth him who is the transgressor, the doubter.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: They who gainsay the signs of God without authority having come to them, are greatly hated by God and by those who believe. Thus God sealeth up every proud, contumacious heart.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And Pharaoh said, "O Haman,8 Build for me a tower that I may reach the avenues,

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: The avenues of the heavens, and may mount to the God of Moses, for I verily deem him a liar."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And thus the evil of his doings was made fair-seeming to Pharaoh, and he turned away from the path of truth; but the artifice of Pharaoh ended only in his ruin.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: And he who believed said, "O my people! follow me: into the right way will I guide you.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: O my people! this present life is only a passing joy, but the life to come is the mansion that abideth.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Whoso shall have wrought evil shall not be recompensed but with its like; but whoso shall have done the things that are right, whether male or female, and is a believer-these shall enter paradise: good things unreckoned shall they enjoy therein.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: And, O my people! how is it that I bid you to salvation, but that ye bid me to the fire?

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Ye invite me to deny God, and to join with him gods of whom I know nothing; but I invite you to the Mighty, the Forgiving.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: No doubt is there that they to whom ye invite me are not to be invoked either in this world or in the world to come: and that unto God is our return, and that the transgressors shall be the inmates of the fire.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Then shall ye remember what I am saying unto you: and to God commit I my case: Verily, God beholdeth his servants."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: So God preserved him from the evils which they had planned, and the woe of the punishment encompassed the people of Pharaoh.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: It is the fire to which they shall be exposed morning and evening, and on the day when "the Hour" shall arrive-"Bring in the people of Pharaoh into the severest punishment."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And when they shall wrangle together in the fire, the weak shall say to those who had borne themselves so proudly, "It is you we followed: will ye therefore relieve us from aught of the fire?"

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And those proud ones shall say, "Verily we are all in it; for now hath God judged between his servants."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And they who are in the fire shall say to the keepers of Hell, "Implore your Lord that he would give us ease but for one day from this torment."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: They shall say, "Came not your apostles to you with the tokens?" They shall say, "Yes." They shall say, "Cry ye then aloud for help:" but the cry of the unbelievers shall be only in vain.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Assuredly, in this present life will we succour our apostles and those who shall have believed, and on the day when the witnesses shall stand forth;

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: A day whereon the plea of the evil doers shall not avail them; but theirs shall be a curse, and theirs the woe of the abode in Hell.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: And of old gave we Moses the guidance, and we made the children of Israel the heritors of the Book,-a guidance and warning to men endued with understanding.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: Therefore be steadfast thou and patient; for true is the promise of God: and seek pardon for thy fault,9 and celebrate the praise of thy Lord at evening and at morning.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: As to those who cavil at the signs of God without authority having reached them, nought is there but pride in their breasts: but they shall not succeed. Fly thou for refuge then to God, for He is the Hearer, the Beholder.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Greater surely than the creation of man is the creation of the heavens and of the earth: but most men know it not.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Moreover, the blind and the seeing, and the evil doer and they who believe and do the things that are right, shall not be deemed equal. How few ponder this!

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Aye, "the Hour" will surely come: there is no doubt of it: but most men believe it not.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And your Lord saith, "Call upon me-I will hearken unto you: but they who turn in disdain from my service shall enter Hell with shame."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: It is God who hath ordained the night for your rest, and the day to give you light: verily God is rich in bounties to men: but most men render not the tribute of thanks.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: This is God your Lord, Creator of all things: no god is there but He: why then do ye turn away from Him?

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: Yet thus are they turned aside who gainsay the signs of God.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: It is God who hath given you the earth as a sure foundation, and over it built up the Heaven, and formed you, and made your forms beautiful, and feedeth you with good things. This is God your Lord. Blessed then be God the Lord of the Worlds!

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: He is the Living One. No God is there but He. Call then upon Him and offer Him a pure worship. Praise be to God the Lord of the Worlds!

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: SAY: Verily I am forbidden to worship what ye call on beside God, after that the clear tokens have come to me from my Lord, and I am bidden to surrender myself to the Lord of the Worlds.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: He it is who created you of the dust, then of the germs of life, then of thick blood, then brought you forth infants: then he letteth you reach your full strength, and then become old men (but some of you die first), and reach the ordained term. And this that haply ye may understand.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: It is He who giveth life and death; and when He decreeth a thing, He only saith of it, "Be," and it is.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: Seest thou not those who cavil at the signs of God? how are they turned aside!

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: They who treat "the Book," and the message with which we have sent our Sent Ones, as a lie, shall know the truth hereafter,

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: When the collars shall be on their necks and the chains to drag them into Hell: then in the fire shall they be burned.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: Then shall it be said to them, "Where are they whom ye made the objects of joint worship with God?" They shall say, "They have vanished away from us. Yea, it was nought on which we called heretofore." Thus God leadeth the unbelievers astray.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: -"This for you, because of your unrighteous insolence and immoderate joys on earth.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Enter ye the portals of Hell to abide therein for ever. And, wretched the abode of the haughty ones!"

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: Therefore be thou steadfast in patience: for the promise of God is truth: and whether we shall make thee see part of the woes with which we threatened them, or whether we cause thee first to die, unto us shall they be brought back.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: And we have already sent apostles before thee: of some we have told thee, and of others we have told thee nothing:10 but no apostle had the power to work a miracle unless by the leave of God. But when God's behest cometh, everything will be decided with truth: and then they perish who treated it as a vain thing.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: It is God who hath given you the cattle that on some of them ye may ride, and of some may eat:

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: (Other advantages too do ye derive from them)-and that by them ye may effect the projects ye cherish in your breasts; for on them, and on ships are ye borne:

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: And He sheweth you His signs: which, then, of the signs of God will ye deny?

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: Have they not journeyed in this land, and seen what hath been the end of those who flourished before them? More were they than these in number and mightier in strength, and greater are the traces of their power remaining in the land:11 yet their labours availed them nothing.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: And when their apostles had come to them with the tokens of their mission, they exulted in what they possessed of knowledge; but that retribution at which they scoffed, encompassed them.

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: And when they beheld our vengeance they said, "We believe in God alone, and we disbelieve in the deities we once associated with Him."

records.label: Surah 40 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: But their faith, after they had witnessed our vengeance, profited them not. Such the procedure of God with regard to his servants who flourished of old. And then the unbelievers perished.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HA. MIM.2 A Revelation from the Compassionate, the Merciful!

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: A Book whose verses (signs) are MADE PLAIN-an Arabic Koran, for men of knowledge;

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Announcer of glad tidings and charged with warnings! But most of them withdraw and hearken not:

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And they say, "Our hearts are under shelter from thy teachings, and in our ears is a deafness, and between us and thee there is a veil. Act as thou thinkest right: we verily shall act as we think right."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: SAY: I am only a man like you.3 It is revealed to me that your God is one God: go straight then to Him, and implore his pardon. And woe to those who join gods with God;

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Who pay not the alms of obligation, and in the life to come believe not!

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But they who believe and do the things that are right shall receive a perfect4 recompense.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: SAY: Do ye indeed disbelieve in Him who in two days created the earth? and do ye assign Him peers? The Lord of the worlds is He!

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And he hath placed on the earth the firm mountains which tower above it; and He hath blessed it, and distributed food throughout it, for the cravings of all alike, in four days:

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Then He applied himself to the Heaven, which then was but smoke: and to it and to the Earth He said, "Come ye, whether in obedience or against your will?" and they both said, "We come obedient."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And He made them seven heavens in two days, and in each heaven made known its office: And we furnished the lower heaven with lights and guardian angels. This, the disposition of the Almighty, the All-knowing.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: If they turn away, then SAY: I warn you of a tempest, like the tempest of Ad and Themoud!

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: When the apostles came to them on every side,5 saying, "Worship none but God," they said, "Had our Lord been pleased to send down, He had surely sent down angels; and in sooth, your message we do not believe."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: As to Ad, they bore them proudly and unjustly in the land, and said, "Who more mighty than we in prowess?" Saw they not that God their creator was mightier than they in prowess? And they rejected our signs.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Therefore on ill-omened days did we send against them an impetuous blast that we might make them taste the chastisement of shame in this world:-but more shameful shall be the chastisement of the life to come; and they shall not be protected.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And as to Themoud, we had vouchsafed them guidance; but to guidance did they prefer blindness; wherefore the tempest of a shameful punishment overtook them for their doings:

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: But we rescued the believing and the God-fearing:

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And warn of the day when the enemies of God shall be gathered6 unto the fire urged on in bands:

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Until when they reach it, their ears and their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them of their deeds:

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And they shall say to their skins, "Why witness ye against us?" They shall say, "God, who giveth a voice to all things, hath given us a voice: He created you at first, and to Him are ye brought back.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And ye did not hide yourselves so that neither your ears nor your eyes nor your skins should witness against you: but ye thought that God knew not many a thing that ye did!

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And this your thought which ye did think of your Lord hath ruined you, so that ye are become of those who perish."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And be they patient, still the fire shall be their abode: or if they beg for favour, yet shall they not be of favoured.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And we will appoint Satans as their fast companions; for it was they who made their present and future state seem fair and right to them; and the sentence passed on the peoples of Djinn and men who flourished before them hath become their due, and they shall perish.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Yet the unbelievers say, "Hearken not to this Koran, but keep up a talking, that ye may overpower the voice of the reader."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Surely therefore will we cause the unbelievers to taste a terrible punishment;

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And recompense them according to the worst of their actions.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: This the reward of the enemies of God,-the Fire! it shall be their eternal abode, in requital for their gainsaying our signs.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And they who believed not shall say, "O our Lord! shew us those of the Djinn and men who led us astray: both of them will we put under out feet, that they may be of the humbled."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: But as for those who say, "Our Lord is God;" and who go straight to Him,7 angels shall descend to them and say, "Fear ye not, neither be ye grieved, but rejoice ye in the paradise which ye have been promised.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: We are your guardians in this life and in the next: your's therein shall be your soul's desire, and your's therein whatever ye shall ask for,

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: The hospitality of a Gracious, a Merciful One."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And who speaketh fairer than he who biddeth to God and doth the thing that is right, and saith, "I for my part am of the Muslims"?

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Moreover, good and evil are not to be treated as the same thing. Turn away evil by what is better, and lo! he between whom and thyself was enmity, shall be as though he were a warm friend.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: But none attain to this save men steadfast in patience, and none attain to it except the most highly favoured.8

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And if an enticement from Satan entice thee, then take refuge in God, for He is the Hearing, the Knowing.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And among his signs are the night, and the day, and the sun, and the moon. Bend not in adoration to the sun or the moon, but bend in adoration before God who created them both, if ye would serve Him.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: But if they are too proud for this, yet they who are with thy Lord do celebrate His praises night and day,9 and cease not.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And among His signs is this, that thou seest the earth drooping: but, when we send down the rain upon it, it is stirred and swelleth; verily He who giveth it life, will surely give life to the dead; for His might extendeth over all things.10

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: They truly who with obloquy disown our signs are not hidden from us. Is he then who shall be cast into the fire, or he who shall come forth secure on the day of resurrection, in the better position? Do what ye will: but His eye is on all your doings.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Verily, they who believe not in "the warning," after it hath come to them . . . and yet the Koran is a glorious book!

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Falsehood, from whatever side it cometh, shall not come night it;11 it is a missive down from the Wise, the Praiseworthy.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Nothing hath been said to thee which hath not been said of old to apostles before thee. Verily with thy Lord is forgiveness, and with Him is terrible retribution.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Had we made it a Koran in a foreign tongue, they had surely said, "Unless its signs be made clear . . . !12 What! in a foreign tongue? and the people Arabian?" SAY: It is to those who believe a guide and a medicine;13 but as to those who believe not, there is a thickness in their ears, and to them it is a blindness: they are like those who are called to from afar.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Of old we gave the Book to Moses, and disputes arose about it: and if a decree of respite from thy Lord had gone before, there would surely have been a decision between them: for great were their doubts and questionings about it.14

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: He who doth right-it is for himself:15 and he who doth evil-it is for himself: and thy Lord will not deal unfairly with his servants.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: With Him alone16 is the knowledge of "the Hour." No fruit cometh forth from its coverings, neither doth any female conceive, nor is she delivered, but with His knowledge. And on that day He shall call men to Him, saying, "Where are the companions ye gave me?" They shall say, "We own to thee, there is no one of us can witness for them."

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And what they erst called on shall pass away from them, and they shall perceive that there will be no escape for them.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: Man ceaseth not to pray for good: but if evil betide him he despondeth, despairing.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And if we cause him to taste our mercy after affliction hath touched him, he is sure to say, "This is my due: and I take no thought of the Hour of Resurrection: and if I be brought back to my Lord, I shall indeed attain with Him my highest good." But we will then certainly declare their doings to the Infidels, and cause them to taste a stern punishment.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: When we are gracious to man, he withdraweth and turneth him aside: but when evil toucheth him, he is a man of long prayers.

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If this Book be from God and ye believe it not, who will have gone further astray than he who is at a distance from it?

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: We will shew them our signs in different countries and among themselves, until it become plain to them that it is the truth. Is it not enough for thee that thy Lord is witness of all things?

records.label: Surah 41 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Are they not in doubt as to the meeting with their Lord? But doth he not encompass all things?

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HA. MIM. AIN. SIN. KAF.1 Thus unto thee as unto those who preceded thee doth God, the Mighty, the Wise, reveal!

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: All that is in the Heavens and all that is in the Earth is His: and He is the High, the Great!

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Ready are the Heavens to cleave asunder from above for very awe: and the angels celebrate the praise of their Lord, and ask forgiveness for the dwellers on earth: Is not God the Indulgent, the Merciful?

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: But whose take aught beside Him as lords-God watcheth them! but thou hast them not in thy charge.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: It is thus moreover that we have revealed to thee an Arabic Koran, that thou mayest warn the mother city2 and all around it, and that thou mayest warn them of that day of the Gathering, of which there is no doubt-when part shall be in Paradise and part in the flame.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Had God so pleased, He had made them one people and of one creed: but He bringeth whom He will within His mercy; and as for the doers of evil, no patron, no helper shall there be for them.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Will they take other patrons than Him? But God is man's only Lord: He quickeneth the dead; and He is mighty over all things.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And whatever the subject of your disputes, with God doth its decision rest. This is God, my Lord: in Him do I put my trust, and to Him do I turn in penitence;

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Creator of the Heavens and of the Earth! he hath given you wives from among your own selves, and cattle male and female-by this means to multiply you: Nought is there like Him! the Hearer, the Beholder He!

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: His, the keys of the Heavens and of the Earth! He giveth with open hand, or sparingly, to whom He will: He knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: To you hath He prescribed the faith which He commanded unto Noah, and which we have revealed to thee, and which we commanded unto Abraham and Moses and Jesus, saying, "Observe this faith, and be not divided into sects therein." Intolerable to those who worship idols jointly with God

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Is that faith to which thou dost call them. Whom He pleaseth will God choose for it, and whosoever shall turn to Him in penitence will He guide to it.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Nor were they divided into sects through mutual jealousy, till after that "the knowledge" had come to them: and had not a decree from thy Lord gone forth respiting them to a fixed time, verily, there had at once been a decision between them.3 And they who have inherited "the Book" after them, are in perplexity of doubt concerning it.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: For this cause summon thou them to the faith, and go straight on as thou hast been bidden, and follow not their desires: and SAY: In whatsoever Books God hath sent down do I believe: I am commanded to decide justly between you: God is your Lord and our Lord: we have our works and you have your works: between us and you let there be no strife: God will make us all one: and to Him shall we return.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And as to those who dispute about God, after pledges of obedience given to Him,4 their disputings shall be condemned by their Lord, and wrath shall be on them, and theirs shall be a sore torment.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: It is God who hath sent down the Book with truth, and the Balance:5 but who shall inform thee whether haply "the Hour" be nigh?

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: They who believe not in it, challenge its speedy coming:6 but they who believe are afraid because of it, and know it to be a truth. Are not they who dispute of the Hour, in a vast error?

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Benign is God towards his servants: for whom He will doth He provide: and He is the Strong, the Mighty.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Whoso will choose the harvest field of the life to come, to him will we give increase in this his harvest field: and whoso chooseth the harvest field of this life, thereof will we give him: but no portion shall there be for him in the life to come.7

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Is it that they have gods who have sanctioned for them aught in the matter of religion which God hath not allowed? But had it not been for a decree of respite till the day of severance, judgment had ere now taken place among them; and assuredly the impious shall undergo a painful torment.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: On that day thou shalt see the impious alarmed at their own works, and the consequence thereof shall fall upon them: but they who believe and do the things that are right, shall dwell in the meadows of paradise: whatever they shall desire awaiteth them with their Lord. This, the greatest boon.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: This is what God announceth to his servants who believe and do the things that are right. SAY: For this ask I no wage of you, save the love of my kin. And whoever shall have won the merit of a good deed, we will increase good to him therewith; for God is forgiving, grateful.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Will they say he hath forged a lie of God? If God pleased,

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: He could then seal up thy very heart.8 But God will bring untruth to nought, and will make good the truth by his word: for He knoweth the very secrets of the breast.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: He it is who accepteth repentance from his servants, and forgiveth their sins and knoweth your actions:

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And to those who believe and do the things that are right will he hearken, and augment his bounties to them:9 but the unbelievers doth a terrible punishment await.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Should God bestow abundance upon his servants, they might act wantonly on the earth: but He sendeth down what He will by measure; for he knoweth, beholdeth his servants.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: He it is who after that men have despaired of it, sendeth down the rain, and spreadeth abroad his mercy: He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Among his signs is the creation of the Heavens and of the Earth, and the creatures which he hath scattered over both: and, for their gathering together when he will, He is allpowerful!

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Nor happeneth to you any mishap, but it is for your own handy-work: and yet he forgiveth many things.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Ye cannot weaken him on the earth: neither, beside God, patron or helper shall ye have.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Among his signs also are the sea-traversing ships like mountains: if such be his will, He lulleth the wind, and they lie motionless on the back of the waves:-truly herein are signs to all the constant, the grateful;-

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Or if, for their ill deserts, He cause them to founder, still He forgiveth much:

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: But they who gainsay our signs shall know that there will be no escape for them.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: All that you receive is but for enjoyment in this life present: but better and more enduring is a portion with God, for those who believe and put their trust in their Lord;

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And who avoid the heinous things of crime, and filthiness, and when they are angered, forgive;

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And who hearken to their Lord, and observe prayer, and whose affairs are guided by mutual COUNSEL, and who give alms of that with which we have enriched them;

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And who, when a wrong is done them, redress themselves:

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: -Yet let the recompense of evil be only a like evil but he who forgiveth and is reconciled, shall be rewarded by God himself; for He loveth not those who act unjustly.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And there shall be no way open against those who, after being wronged, avenge themselves;

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: But there shall be a way open against those who unjustly wrong others, and act insolently on the earth in disregard of justice. These! a grievous punishment doth await them.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: And whoso beareth wrongs with patience and forgiveth;-this verily is a bounden duty;

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: But he whom God shall cause to err, shall thenceforth have no protector. And thou shalt behold the perpetrators of injustice,

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Exclaiming, when they see the torment, "Is there no way to return?"

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And thou shalt see them when set before it, downcast for the shame: they shall look at it with stealthy glances: and the believers shall say, "Truly are the losers they who have lost themselves and their families on the day of Resurrection! Shall not the perpetrators of injustice be in lasting torment?"

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And no other protectors shall there be to succour them than God; and no pathway for him whom God shall cause to err.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Hearken then to your Lord ere the day come, which none can put back when God doth ordain its coming. No place of refuge for you on that day! no denying your own works!

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: But if they turn aside from thee, yet we have not sent thee to be their guardian. 'Tis thine but to preach. When we cause man to taste our gifts of mercy, he rejoiceth in it; but if for their by-gone handy-work evil betide them, then lo! is man ungrateful.

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: God's, the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth! He createth what He will! and he giveth daughters to whom He will, and sons to whom He will:

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Or He giveth them children of both sexes, and He maketh whom He will to be childless; for He is Wise, Powerful!

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: It is not for man that God should speak with him but by vision, or from behind a veil:

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: Or, He sendeth a messenger to reveal, by his permission, what He will: for He is Exalted, Wise!

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: Thus have we sent the Spirit (Gabriel10) to thee with a revelation, by our command. Thou knewest not, ere this, what "the Book" was, or what the faith. But we have ordained it for a light: by it will we guide whom we please of our servants. And thou shalt surely guide into the right way,

records.label: Surah 42 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: The way of God, whose is all that the Heaven and the Earth contain. Shall not all things return to God?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Ha. Mim.1 By the Luminous Book!

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: We have made it an Arabic Koran that ye may understand:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And it is a transcript of the archetypal Book,2 kept by us; it is lofty, filled with wisdom,

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Shall we then turn aside this warning from you because ye are a people who transgress?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Yet how many prophets sent we among those of old!

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: But no prophet came to them whom they made not the object of their scorn:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Wherefore we destroyed nations mightier than these Meccans in strength; and the example of those of old hath gone before!

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And if thou ask them who created the Heavens and the Earth, they will say: "The Mighty, the Sage, created them both,"

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Who hath made the Earth as a couch for you, and hath traced out routes therein for your guidance;

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And who sendeth down out of Heaven the rain in due degree, by which we quicken a dead land; thus shall ye be brought forth from the grave:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And who hath created the sexual couples, all of them, and hath made for you the ships and beasts whereon ye ride:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: That ye may sit balanced on their backs and remember the goodness of your Lord as ye sit so evenly thereon, and say: "Glory to Him who hath subjected these to us! We could not have attained to it of ourselves:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And truly unto our Lord shall we return."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Yet do they assign to him some of his own servants for offspring! Verily man is an open ingrate!

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Hath God adopted daughters from among those whom he hath created, and chosen sons for you?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But when that3 is announced to any one of them, which he affirmeth to be the case with the God of Mercy,4 his face settleth into darkness and he is silent-sad.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: What! make they a being to be the offspring of God who is brought up among trinkets, and is ever contentious without reason?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And they make the angels who are the servants of God of Mercy, females. What! did they witness their creation? Their witness shall be taken down, and they shall hereafter be enquired at.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And they say: "Had the God of Mercy so willed it we should never have worshipped them." No knowledge have they in this: they only lie.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Have we ere this given them a Book?5 and do they possess it still?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: But say they: "Verily we found our fathers of that persuasion, and verily, by their footsteps do we guide ourselves."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And thus never before thy time did we send a warner to any city but its wealthy ones said: "Verily we found our fathers with a religion, and in their tracks we tread."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: SAY,-such was our command to that apostle-"What! even if I bring you a religion more right than that ye found your fathers following?" And they said, "Verily we believe not in your message."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Wherefore we took vengeance on them, and behold what hath been the end of those who treated our messengers as liars!

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And bear in mind when Abraham said to his father and to his people, "Verily I am clear of what ye worship,

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Save Him who hath created me; for he will vouchsafe me guidance."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And this he established as a doctrine that should abide among his posterity, that to God might they be turned.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: In sooth to these idolatrous Arabians and to their fathers did I allow their full enjoyments, till the truth should come to them, and an undoubted apostle:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: But now that the truth hath come to them, they say, "'Tis sorcery, and we believe it not."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And they say, "Had but this Koran been sent down to some great one of the two cities6 . . .!"

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Are they then the distributors of thy Lord's Mercy?7 It is we who distribute their subsistence among them in this world's life; and we raise some of them by grades above others, that the one may take the other to serve him: but better is the mercy of thy Lord than all their hoards.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: But for fear that all mankind would have become a single people of unbelievers, verily we would certainly have given to those who believe not in the God of Mercy roofs of silver to their houses, and silver stairs to ascend by;

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And doors of silver to their houses, and couches of silver to recline on;

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And ORNAMENTS OF GOLD: for all these are merely the good things of the present life; but the next life doth thy Lord reserve for those who fear Him.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And whoso shall withdraw from the Warning of the God of Mercy, we will chain a Satan to him, and he shall be his fast companion:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: For the Satans will turn men aside from the Way, who yet shall deem themselves rightly guided;

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Until when man shall come before us, he shall say, "O Satan, would that between me and thee were the distance of the East and West."8 And a wretched companion is a Satan.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: But it shall not avail you on that day, because ye were unjust: partners shall ye be in the torment.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: What! Canst thou then make the deaf to hear, or guide the blind and him who is in palpable error?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Whether therefore we take thee off by death, surely will we avenge ourselves on them;

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Or whether we make thee a witness of the accomplishment of that with which we threatened them, we will surely gain the mastery over them.9

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Hold thou fast therefore what hath been revealed to thee, for thou art on a right path:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: For truly to thee and to thy people it is an admonition; and ye shall have an account to render for it at last.10

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: And ask our Sent Ones whom we have sent before thee,

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: "Appointed we gods beside the God of Mercy whom they should worship?"11

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Of old sent we Moses with our signs to Pharaoh and his nobles: and he said, "I truly am the Apostle of the Lord of the worlds."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And when he presented himself before them with our signs, lo! they laughed at them,

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Though we shewed them no sign that was not greater than its fellow:12 and therefore did we lay hold on them with chastisement, to the intent that they might be turned to God.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: Then they said, "O Magician! call on thy Lord on our behalf to do as he hath engaged with thee, for truly we would fain be guided."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: But when we relieved them from the chastisement, lo! they broke their pledge.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And Pharaoh made proclamation among his people. Said he, "O my people! is not the kingdom of Egypt mine, and these rivers which flow at my feet?13 Do ye not behold?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: Am I not mightier than this despicable fellow,

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And who scarce can speak distinctly?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Have bracelets of gold14 then been put upon him, or come there with him a train of Angels?"

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And he inspired his people with levity, and they obeyed him; for they were a perverse people:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: And when they had angered us, we took vengeance on them, and we drowned them all.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: And we made them a precedent and instance of divine judgments to those who came after them.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: And when the Son of Mary was set forth as an instance of divine power, lo! thy people cried out for joy thereat:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: And they said, "Are our gods or is he the better?"15 They put this forth to thee only in the spirit of dispute. Yea, they are a contentious people.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Jesus is no more than a servant whom we favoured, and proposed as an instance of divine power to the children of Israel.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: (And if we pleased, we could from yourselves bring forth Angels to succeed you on earth:)16

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: And he shall be a sign of the last hour;17 doubt not then of it, and follow ye me: this is the right way;

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: And let not Satan turn you aside from it, for he is your manifest foe.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: And when Jesus came with manifest proofs, he said, "Now am I come to you with wisdom; and a part of those things about which ye are at variance I will clear up to you; fear ye God therefore and obey me.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: Verily, God is my Lord and your Lord; wherefore worship ye him: this is a right way."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: But the different parties18 fell into disputes among themselves; but woe to those who thus transgressed, because of the punishment of an afflictive day!

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: For what wait they but for the hour "to come suddenly on them, while they expect it not?"

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Friends on that day shall become foes to one another, except the God- fearing:-

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: "O my servants! on this day shall no fear come upon you, neither shall ye be put to grief,

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: Who have believed in our signs and become Muslims:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: Enter ye and your wives into Paradise, delighted."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: Dishes and bowls of gold shall go round unto them: there shall they enjoy whatever their souls desire, and whatever their eyes delight in; and therein shall ye abide for ever.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: This is Paradise, which ye have received as your heritage in recompense for your works;

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: Therein shall ye have fruits in abundance, of which ye shall eat.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: But in the torment of Hell shall the wicked remain for ever:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: It shall not be mitigated to them, and they shall be mute for despair therein,

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: For it is not we who have treated them unjustly, but it was they who were unjust to themselves.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: And they shall cry: "O Malec!19 would that thy Lord would make an end of us!" He saith: "Here must ye remain."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: We have come to you with the truth (O Meccans), but most of you abhor the truth.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: Have they drawn tight their toils for thee?20 We too will tighten ours.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: Think they that we hear not their secrets and their private talk? Yes, and our angels who are at their sides write them down.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: SAY: If the God of Mercy had a son, the first would I be to worship him:

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: But far be the Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they impute to Him!

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: Wherefore let them alone, to plunge on, and sport, until they meet the day with which they are menaced.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: He who is God in the Heavens is God in earth also: and He is the Wise, the Knowing.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: And Blessed be He whose is the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth and of all that is between them; for with Him is the knowledge of the Hour, and to Him shall ye be brought back.

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: The gods whom they call upon beside Him shall not be able to intercede for others: they only shall be able who bore witness to the truth and21 knew it."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: If thou ask them who hath created them, they will be sure to say, "God." How then hold they false opinions?

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: And one22 saith, "O Lord! verily these are people who believe not."

records.label: Surah 43 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: Turn thou then from them, and say, "Peace:" In the end they shall know their folly.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Ha. Mim.1 By this clear Book!

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: See! on a blessed night2 have we sent it down, for we would warn mankind:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: On the night wherein all things are disposed in wisdom,3

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: By virtue of our behest. Lo! we have ever sent forth Apostles,

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: A mercy from thy Lord: he truly heareth and knoweth all things-

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Lord of the Heavens and of the Earth and of all that is between them,-if ye be firm in faith-

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: There is no God but He!-He maketh alive and killeth!-Your Lord and the Lord of your sires of old!

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Yet with doubts do they disport them.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: But mark them on the day when the Heaven shall give out a palpable SMOKE,

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Which shall enshroud mankind: this will be an afflictive torment.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: They will cry, "Our Lord! relieve us from this torment: see! we are believers."

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: But how did warning avail them, when an undoubted apostle had come to them;

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And they turned their backs on him, and said, "Taught by others, possessed?"

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Were we to relieve you from the plague even a little, ye would certainly relapse.4

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: On the day when we shall fiercely put forth our great fierceness, we will surely take vengeance on them!

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Of old, before their time, had we proved the people of Pharaoh, when a noble apostle presented himself to them.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: "Send away with me," cried he, "the servants of God; for I am an apostle worthy of all credit:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And exalt not yourselves against God, for I come to you with undoubted power;

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And I take refuge with Him who is my Lord and your Lord, that ye stone me not:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And if ye believe me not, at least separate yourselves from me."

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And he cried to his Lord, "That these are a wicked people."

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: "March forth then, said God, with my servants by night, for ye will be pursued.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And leave behind you the cleft sea: they are a drowned host."

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: How many a garden and fountain did they quit!

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And corn fields and noble dwellings!

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And pleasures in which they rejoiced them!

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: So was it: and we gave them as a heritage to another people.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Nor Heaven nor Earth wept for them, nor was their sentence respited;

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And we rescued the children of Israel from a degrading affliction-

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: From Pharaoh, for he was haughty, given to excess.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And we chose them, in our prescience, above all peoples,5

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And we shewed them miracles wherein was their clear trial.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Yet these infidels say,

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: "There is but our first death, neither shall we be raised again:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Bring back our sires, if ye be men of truth."

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Are they better than the people of Tobba,6

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And those who flourished before them whom we destroyed for their evil deeds?

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: We have not created the Heavens and the Earth and whatever is between them in sport:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: We have not created them but for a serious end:7 but the greater part of them understand it not.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Verily the day of severing8 shall be the appointed time of all:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: A day when the master shall not at all be aided by the servant, neither shall they be helped;

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Save those on whom God shall have mercy: for He is the mighty, the merciful.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Verily the tree of Ez-Zakkoum9

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Shall be the sinner's10 food:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Like dregs of oil shall it boil up in their bellies,

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Like the boiling of scalding water.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: "-Seize ye him, and drag him into the mid-fire;

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Then pour on his head of the tormenting boiling water.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: -'Taste this:' for thou forsooth art the mighty, the honourable!

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Lo! this is that of which ye doubted."

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: But the pious shall be in a secure place,

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: Amid gardens and fountains,

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: Clothed in silk and richest robes, facing one another:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Thus shall it be: and we will wed them to the virgins with large dark eyes:

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: Therein shall they call, secure, for every kind of fruit;

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Therein, their first death passed, shall they taste death no more; and He shall keep them from the pains of Hell:-

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: 'Tis the gracious bounty of thy Lord! This is the great felicity.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: We have made this Koran easy for thee in thine own tongue, that they may take the warning.

records.label: Surah 44 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Therefore wait thou, for they are waiting.11

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HA. MIM.1 This Book is sent down2 from God, the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Assuredly in the Heavens and the Earth are signs for those who believe:

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And in your own creation, and in the beasts which are scattered abroad are signs to the firm in faith:

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And in the succession of night and day, and in the supply which God sendeth down from the Heaven whereby He giveth life to the earth when dead, and in the change of the winds, are signs for a people of discernment.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Such are the signs of God: with truth do we recite them to thee. But in what teaching will they believe, if they reject3 God and his signs?

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Woe to every lying sinner,

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Who heareth the signs of God recited to him, and then, as though he heard them not, persisteth in proud disdain! Apprise him of an afflictive punishment.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And when he becometh acquainted with any of our signs he turneth them into ridicule. These! a shameful punishment for them!

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Hell is behind them! and neither their gains nor the lords whom they have adopted beside God shall avail them in the least: and theirs, a great punishment!

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: This is "Guidance:" and for those who disbelieve the signs of their Lord is the punishment of an afflictive torment.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: It is God who hath subjected the sea to you that the ships may traverse it at his bidding, and that ye may go in quest of the gifts of his bounty, and that ye may be thankful.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And he hath subjected to you all that is in the Heavens and all that is on the Earth: all is from him. Verily, herein are signs for those who reflect.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Tell the believers to pardon those who hope not for the days of God4 in which He purposeth to reward men according to their deeds.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: He who doth that which is right, doth it to his own behoof, and whoso doth evil, doth it to his own hurt. Hereafter, to your Lord shall ye be brought back.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: To the children of Israel gave we of old the Book and the Wisdom, and the gift of Prophecy, and we supplied them with good things, and privileged them above all peoples:

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And we gave them clear sanctions for our behests: neither did they differ, through mutual envy, till after they had become possessed of knowledge; but thy Lord will judge between them on the day of resurrection, as to the subject of their disputes.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Afterwards we set thee over our divine law:5 follow it then: and follow not the wishes of those who have no knowledge,

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: For against God shall they avail thee nothing. And in sooth, the doers of evil are one another's patrons; but the patron of them that fear Him is God himself.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: This Book hath insight for mankind, and a Guidance and Mercy to a people who are firm in faith.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Deem they whose gettings are only evil, that we will deal with them as with those who believe and work righteousness, so that their lives and deaths shall be alike? Ill do they judge.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: In all truth hath God created the Heavens and the Earth, that he may reward every one as he shall have wrought; and they shall not be wronged.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: What thinkest thou? He who hath made a God of his passions, and whom God causeth wilfully to err, and whose ears and whose heart he hath sealed up, and over whose sight he hath placed a veil-who, after his rejection by God, shall guide such a one? Will ye not then be warned?

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And they say, "There is only this our present life: we die and we live, and nought but time destroyeth us." But in this they have no knowledge: it is merely their own conceit.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And when our clear signs are recited to them, their only argument is to say, "Bring back our fathers, if ye speak the truth."

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 26
