records.text: Say: God giveth you life, then causeth you to die: then will He assemble you on the day of resurrection: there is no doubt of it: but most men have not this knowledge.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And God's is the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth; and on the day when the Hour shall arrive, on that day shall the despisers6 perish.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And thou shalt see every nation KNEELING: to its own book shall every nation be summoned:-”This day shall ye be repaid as ye have wrought.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: This our Book will speak of you with truth: therein have we written down whatever ye have done."

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: As to those who have believed and wrought righteously, into his mercy shall their Lord cause them to enter. This shall be undoubted bliss!

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: But as to the Infidels-"Were not my signs recited to you? but ye proudly scorned them, and became a sinful people."

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And when it was said, "Verily the Promise of God is truth; and as to the Hour, there is no doubt of it;" ye said, "We know not what the hour is-we conceive it a mere conceit,-we have no assurance of it."

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And the evils they have wrought shall rise up into their view, and that at which they mocked shall hem them in on every side.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And it shall be said to them, "This day will we forget you as ye forgat your meeting with us this day, and your abode shall be the fire, and none shall there be to succour you:-

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: This, because ye received the signs of God with mockery, and this present life deceived you." On that day therefore they shall not come out from it; and they shall not be asked to win the favour of God.

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Praise then be to God, Lord of the Heavens and Lord of the Earth; the Lord of the worlds!

records.label: Surah 45 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And His be the greatness in the Heavens and on the Earth; for He is the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HA. MIM.1 The Revelation (sending down) of this Book is from the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: We have not created the Heavens and the Earth and all that is between them otherwise than in truth and for a settled term. But they who believe not, turn away from their warning.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: SAY: What think ye? As for those whom ye invoke beside God, shew me what part of the earth it is which they have created? Had they a share in the Heavens? Bring me a Book sent down by them before this Koran, or traces of their knowledge;2-if ye are men of truth.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And who erreth more than he who, beside God, calleth upon that which shall not answer him until the day of Resurrection? Yes, they regard not their invocations;

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And when mankind shall be assembled together, they will become their enemies, and ungratefully disown their worship.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And when our clear signs are recited to them, they who believe not say of the truth when it cometh to them, "This is plain sorcery."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Will they say, "He hath devised It?" SAY: If I have devised the Koran, then not one single thing shall ye ever obtain for me from God! He best knoweth what ye utter in its regard! Witness enough is He between me and you! And He is the Gracious, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: SAY: I am no apostle of new doctrines: neither know I what will be done with me or you. Only what is revealed to me do I follow, and I am only charged to warn openly.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If this Book be from God, and ye believe it not, and a witness of the children of Israel3 witness to its conformity with the Law, and believe, while ye proudly disdain it . . . ? Ah! God guideth not the people guilty of such a wrong!

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: But the infidels say of the believers, "If it were a good Book they would not have been before us in believing it:"4 And not having submitted to guidance, they proceed to say, "It is an old lying legend!"

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: But before the Koran was the Book of Moses, a rule and a mercy; and this Book confirmeth it (the Pentateuch)-in the Arabic tongue-that those who are guilty of that wrong may be warned, and as glad tidings to the doers of good.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Assuredly they who say, "Our Lord is God," and take the straight way to Him- no fear shall come on them, neither shall they be put to grief:

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: These shall be the inmates of Paradise to remain therein for ever,-the recompense of their deeds!

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Moreover, we have enjoined on man to shew kindness to his parents. With pain his mother beareth him; with pain she bringeth him forth: and his bearing and his weaning is thirty months; until when he attaineth his strength, and attaineth to forty years,5 he saith, "O my Lord! stir me up to be grateful for thy favours wherewith thou hast favoured me and my parents, and to do good works which shall please thee: and prosper me in my offspring: for to thee am I turned, and am resigned to thy will" (am a Muslim).

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: These are they from whom we will accept their best works, and whose evil works we will pass by; among the inmates shall they be of Paradise:-a true promise which they are promised.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But he who saith to his parents, "Fie on you both! Promise ye me that I shall be taken forth from the grave alive, when whole generations have already passed away before me?" But they both will implore the help of God, and say, "Alas for thee! Believe: for the promise of God is true." But he saith, "It is no more than a fable of the ancients."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: These are they in whom the sentence passed on the nations, djinn and men, who flourished before them, is made good. They shall surely perish.6

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And there are grades for all, according to their works, that God may repay them for their works; and they shall not be dealt with unfairly.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And they who believe not shall one day be set before the fire. "Ye made away your precious gifts during your life on earth; and ye took your fill of pleasure in them: This day, therefore, with punishment of shame shall ye be rewarded, for that ye behaved you proudly and unjustly on the earth, and for that ye were given to excesses."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Remember, too, the brother of Ad7 when he warned his people in AL AHKAF8-and before and since his time there have been warners-"Worship none but God: verily I fear for you the punishment of the great day."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: They said, "Art thou come to us to turn us away from our Gods? Bring on us now the woes which thou threatenest if thou speakest truth."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: "That knowledge," said he, "is with God alone: I only proclaim to you the message with which I am sent. But I perceive that ye are a people sunk in ignorance."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: So when they saw a cloud coming straight for their valleys, they said, "It is a passing cloud that shall give us rain." "Nay, it is that whose speedy coming ye challenged a blast wherein is an afflictive punishment:-

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: It will destroy everything at the bidding of its Lord!" And at morn nought was to be seen but their empty dwellings! Thus repay we a wicked people.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: With power had we endued them, even as with power have we endued you; and we had given them ears and eyes and hearts: yet neither their eyes, nor their ears, nor their hearts aided them at all, when once they gainsaid the signs of God; but that punishment which they had mocked at enveloped them on all sides.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Of old, too, did we destroy the cities which were round about you; and, in order that they might return to us, we varied our signs before them.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But did those whom they took for gods beside God as his kindred deities, help them?9 Nay, they withdrew from them. Such was their delusion, and their device!

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And remember when we turned aside a company of the djinn to thee, that they might hearken to the Koran: and no sooner were they present at its reading than they said to each other, "Hist;" and when it was ended, they returned to their people with warnings.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: They said, "O our people! verily we have been listening to a book sent down since the days of Moses, affirming the previous scriptures; it guideth to the truth, and to the right way.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: O our people! Obey the Summoner of God, and believe in him, that He may forgive your sins, and rescue you from an afflictive punishment.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And he who shall not respond to God's preacher, yet cannot weaken God's power on earth, nor shall he have protectors beside Him. These are in obvious error."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: See they not that God who created the Heavens and the Earth, and was not wearied with their creation, is of power to quicken the dead? Yea, he is for all things Potent.

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And a day is coming when the infidels shall be set before the fire. "Is not this it in truth?" They shall say, "Aye, by our Lord." He said, "Taste then the punishment for that ye would not believe."

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Bear thou up, then, with patience, as did the Apostles endued with firmness, and seek not to accelerate their doom. For, on the day when they shall see that with which they have been menaced,

records.label: Surah 46 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: It shall be as though they had waited but an hour of the day. Enough! shall any perish save they who transgress?

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHOSO believe not, and prevent others from the way of God-their works will He cause to miscarry;2

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: But whoso believe, and do things that are right, and believe in what hath been sent down to MUHAMMAD-for it is the truth from their Lord-their sins will He cancel, and dispose their hearts aright.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: This-because the infidels followed vanity, while those who believe, followed the truth from their Lord. Thus to men doth God set forth their likenesses.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: When ye encounter the infidels,3 strike off their heads till ye have made a great slaughter among them, and of the rest make fast the fetters.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And afterwards let there either be free dismissals or ransomings, till the war hath laid down its burdens. Thus do. Were such the pleasure of God, he could himself take vengeance upon them: but He would rather prove the one of you by the other. And whoso fight for the cause of God, their works he will not suffer to miscarry;

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: He will vouchsafe them guidance, and dispose their hearts aright;

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And he will bring them into the Paradise, of which he hath told them.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Believers! if ye help God, God will help you, and will set your feet firm:

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: But as for the infidels, let them perish: and their works shall God bring to nought:

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: This-because they were averse from the command which God sent down; Fruitless, therefore, shall their works become!

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Have they not journeyed through the land, and seen what hath been the end of those who flourished before them? God brought destruction on them: and the like of this doth await the infidels.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: This-because God is the protector of those who believe, and because the infidels have no protector.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Verily God will bring those who believe, and do the things that are right, into the Gardens, beneath whose shades the rivers flow: but they who believe not, take their fill, and eat as the beasts eat! And their dwelling-place the fire!

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And how many cities were mightier in strength than thy city, which hath thrust thee forth!4 We destroyed them, and there was none to help them.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Shall he who followeth the clear teaching of his Lord be as he, the evil of whose doings hath been made to seem good to him, or like those who follow their own lusts?

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: A picture of the Paradise which is promised to the God-fearing! Therein are rivers of water, which corrupt not: rivers of milk, whose taste changeth not: and rivers of wine, delicious to those who quaff it;

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And rivers of honey clarified: and therein are all kinds of fruit for them from their Lord! Is this like the lot of those who must dwell for ever in the fire? and shall have draughts of boiling water forced on them which will rend their bowels asunder?

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Some of them indeed hearken to thee, until when they go out from thee, they say with sneers to those to whom "the knowledge" hath been given, "What is this he said?" These are they whose hearts God hath sealed up, and who follow their own lusts.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: But as to those who have the guidance, He will increase their guidance, and He will teach them what to fear.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: For what do the infidels wait, but that the Hour come suddenly on them? Already are its signs come,5 and when it hath come on them indeed, how can they be warned then?

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Know, then, that there is no god but God: and ask pardon for thy sin, and for believers, both men and women. God knoweth your busy movements, and your final resting-places.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: The believers say, "Oh, would that a Sura were sent down!"6 but when a peremptory Sura is revealed, whose burden is war, thou mayest see the diseased of heart look toward thee, with a look of one on whom the shadows of death have fallen! But better in them would be obedience and becoming language.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And if, when the command for war is issued, they are true to God, it will be assuredly best for them.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Were ye not ready, if ye had turned back from Him, to spread disorder in the land, and violate the ties of blood?

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: These are they whom God hath cursed, and made deaf, and blinded their eyes!

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Will they not then meditate on the Koran? Are locks upon their hearts?

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But as to those who return to their errors after "the guidance" hath been made plain to them, Satan shall beguile them, and fill them with his suggestions.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: This-because they say to those who abhor what God hath sent down, "We will comply with you in part of what ye enjoin." But God knoweth their secret reservations.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: But how? When the angels, in causing them to die, shall smite them on the face and back!

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: This because they follow that which angereth God, and abhor what pleaseth Him: therefore will He make their works fruitless.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Think these men of diseased hearts, that God will not bring out their malice to light?

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: If such were our pleasure, we could point them out to thee, and thou surely know them by their tokens: and know them thou shalt, by the strangeness of their words.7 God knoweth your doings.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And we will surely test you, until we know the valiant and the steadfast among you: and we will test the reports of your conduct.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Verily they who believe not, and turn others from the way of God, and separate from the Apostle after that "the guidance" hath been clearly shewn them, shall in no way injure God: but their works shall he bring to nought.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Believers! obey God and the Apostle: and render not your works vain.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Verily those who believe not, and who pervert others from the way of God, and then die in unbelief, God will not forgive.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Be not fainthearted then; and invite not the infidels to peace when ye have the upper hand: for God is with you, and will not defraud you of the recompense of your works.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Surely this present life is only a play, and pastime! but if ye believe, fear God; He will give you your rewards: but He will not ask all your riches of you.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Should He ask them of you, and urge you, ye would shew yourself niggards: and He would bring your grudges to light.

records.label: Surah 47 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Lo! ye are they, who are called to expend for the cause of God: and some of you are niggards: but whoso is niggardly shall be niggard only to his own loss; for God is the Rich, and ye are the poor: and if ye turn back, He will change you for another people,8 and they shall not be your like!

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Verily, We have won for thee an undoubted VICTORY1-

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: In token that God forgiveth thy earlier and later faults, and fulfilleth His goodness to thee, and guideth thee on the right way,

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And that God succoureth thee with a mighty succour.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: He it is who sendeth down a spirit of secure repose into the hearts of the faithful that they might add faith to their faith; (for God's are the armies of the Heavens and of the Earth: and God is Knowing, Wise:)

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And that He may bring the believing men and the believing women into gardens 'neath whose trees the rivers flow, to dwell therein for ever, and that He may cancel their evil deeds: for this is the great bliss with God:

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And that He may punish the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women, and the men and women who join other gods with God, and think evil thoughts of Him. Theirs shall be a round of evil; and God is angry with them and curseth them, and hath prepared Hell for them: and, an evil journey thither!

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: The armies of the Heavens and of the Earth are God's, and God is Mighty, Wise!

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Verily, we have sent thee to be a witness and a herald of good (an announcer), and a warner,

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: That ye may believe on God and on His Apostle; and may assist Him, and honour Him, and praise him, morning and evening.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: In truth, they who plighted fealty to thee, really plighted that fealty to God: the hand of God was over their hands! Whoever, therefore, shall break his oath shall only break it to his own hurt; but whoever shall be true to his engagement with God, He will give him a great reward.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: The Arabs who took not the field with you,2 will say to thee,3 "We were engaged with our property and our families; therefore ask thou pardon for us." They speak with their tongues what is not in their hearts. SAY: And who can have any power over God in your behalf, whether he will you some loss, or whether he will you an advantage? Yes, God is acquainted with your doings.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: But ye thought that the Apostle and the faithful could never more come back to their families; and your hearts were pleased at this; and ye thought an evil thought of this expedition, and ye became an undone people:

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: For, whoso believeth not in God, and His Apostle. . . . Verily, we have got ready the flame for the Infidels!

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And God's is the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth: Whom He will He forgiveth, and whom He will He punisheth: and God is Gracious, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: They who took not the field with you will say, when ye go forth to the spoil to take it, "Let us follow you." Fain would they change the word of God.4 SAY: Ye shall by no means follow us: thus hath God said already. They will say, "Nay, ye are jealous of us." Nay! they are men of little understanding.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: SAY to those Arabs of the desert, who took not the field, ye shall be called forth against a people of mighty valour. Ye shall do battle with them, or they shall profess Islam. If ye obey, a goodly recompense will God give you; but if ye turn back, as ye turned back aforetime, He will chastise you with a sore chastisement.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: It shall be no crime on the part of the blind, the lame, or the sick, if they go not to the fight. But whoso shall obey God and His Apostle, he shall bring him into the gardens 'neath which the rivers flow: but whoso shall turn back, He will punish him with a sore punishment.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Well pleased now hath God been with the believers when they plighted fealty to thee under the tree;5 and He knew what was in their hearts: therefore did He send down upon them a spirit of secure repose, and rewarded them with a speedy victory,

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And with the rich booty which they took: for God is Mighty, Wise!

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: God promised you the taking of a rich booty6 and sped it to you; and He withheld men's hands from you, for a sign to the faithful, and that He might guide you along the right way:-

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And other booty, over which ye have not yet had power: but now hath God compassed them for you; for God is over all things Potent.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: If the Infidels shall fight against you, they shall assuredly turn their backs; then, neither protector nor helper shall they find!

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Such is God's method carried into effect of old; no change canst thou find in God's mode of dealing.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And He it was who held their hands from you and your hands from them in the valley of Mecca,7 after that He had given you the victory over them: for God saw what ye did.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: These are they who believed not, and kept you away from the sacred Mosque, as well as the offering which was prevented from reaching the place of sacrifice. And had it not been that ye would have trodden down believers, both men and women, whom ye knew not, so that a crime might have lighted on you without your knowledge on their account, and that God would bring whom He will within His mercy, this would have been otherwise ordered. Had they been apart,8 we had surely punished such of them as believed not, with a sore punishment.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: When the unbelievers had fostered rage in their hearts-the rage of ignorance (of heathens)-God sent down His peace on His Apostle and on the faithful, and stablished in them the word of piety, for they were most worthy and deserving of it: and God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Now hath God in truth made good to His Apostle the dream9 in which he said, "Ye shall surely enter the sacred Mosque, if God will, in full security, having your heads shaved and your hair cut: ye shall not fear; for He knoweth what ye know not; and He hath ordained you, beside this, a speedy victory."

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: It is He who hath sent His Apostle with "the Guidance," and the religion of truth, that He may exalt it above every religion. And enough for thee is this testimony on the part of God.

records.label: Surah 48 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Muhammad is the Apostle of God; and his comrades are vehement against the infidels, but full of tenderness among themselves. Thou mayst see them bowing down, prostrating themselves, imploring favours from God, and His acceptance. Their tokens10 are on their faces, the marks of their prostrations. This is their picture in the Law, and their picture in the Evangel:11 they are as the seed which putteth forth its stalk; then strengtheneth it, and it groweth stout, and riseth upon its stem,12 rejoicing the husbandman-that the infidels may be wrathful at them. To such of them as believe and do the things that are right, hath God promised forgiveness and a noble recompense.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O BELIEVERS! enter not upon any affair ere God and His Apostle1 permit you; and fear ye God: for God Heareth, Knoweth.2

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: O Believers! raise not your voices above the voice of the Prophet, neither speak loud to him as ye speak loud one to another, lest your works come to nought, and ye unaware of it.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: They who lower their voices in the presence of the Apostle of God, are the persons whose hearts God hath inclined to piety. Forgiveness shall be theirs and a rich reward.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: They who call out to thee while thou art within3 thine APARTMENTS, have most of them no right perception of what is due to thee.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But if they wait patiently till thou come forth to them, it were far better for them. But God is Indulgent, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: O Believers! if any bad man4 come to you with news, clear it up at once, lest through ignorance ye harm others, and speedily have to repent of what ye have done.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And know that an Apostle of God is among you! should he give way to you in many matters ye would certainly become guilty of a crime. But God hath endeared the faith to you, and hath given it favour in your hearts, and hath made unbelief, and wickedness, and disobedience hateful to you. Such are they who pursue a right course.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Through the bounty and grace which is from God: and God is Knowing, Wise.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: If two bodies of the faithful are at war, then make ye peace between them:5 and if the one of them wrong the other, fight against that party which doth the wrong, until they come back to the precepts of God: if they come back, make peace between them with fairness, and act impartially; God loveth those who act with impartiality.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Only the faithful are brethren; wherefore make peace between your brethren; and fear God, that ye may obtain mercy.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: O Believers! let not men laugh men to scorn who haply may be better than themselves; neither let women laugh women to scorn who may haply be better than themselves!6 Neither defame one another, nor call one another by nicknames. Bad is it to be called wicked after having professed the faith:7 and whoso repent not of this are doers of wrong.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: O Believers! avoid frequent suspicions, for some suspicions are a crime; and pry not: neither let the one of you traduce another in his absence. Would any one of you like to eat the flesh of his dead brother? Surely ye would loathe it. And fear ye God: for God is Ready to turn, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: O men! verily, we have created you of a male and a female; and we have divided you into peoples and tribes that ye might have knowledge one of another. Truly, the most worthy of honour in the sight of God is he who feareth Him most.8 Verily, God is Knowing, Cognisant.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: The Arabs of the desert9 say, "We believe." Say thou: Ye believe not; but rather say, "We profess Islam;" for the faith hath not yet found its way into your hearts. But if ye obey God and His Apostle, he will not allow you to lose any of your actions: for God is Indulgent, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: The true believers are those only who believe in God and His Apostle, and afterwards doubt not; and who contend with their substance and their persons on the path of God. These are the sincere.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: SAY: Will ye teach God about your religion? when God knoweth whatever is in the Heavens and on the Earth: yea, God hath knowledge of all things.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: They taunt thee with their having embraced Islam.10 SAY: Taunt me not with your having embraced Islam: God rather taunteth you with His having guided you to the faith: acknowledge this if ye are sincere.

records.label: Surah 49 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Verily, God knoweth the secrets of the Heavens and of the Earth: and God beholdeth what ye do.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Kaf1. By the glorious Koran:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: They marvel forsooth that one of themselves hath come to them charged with warnings. "This," say the infidels, "is a marvellous thing:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: What! when dead and turned to dust shall we. . . .? Far off is such a return as this?"

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Now know we what the earth consumeth of them, and with us is a Book in which account is kept.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But they have treated the truth which hath come to them as falsehood; perplexed therefore is their state.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Will they not look up to the heaven above them, and consider how we have reared it and decked it forth, and that there are no flaws therein?

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And as to the earth, we have spread it out, and have thrown the mountains upon it, and have caused an upgrowth in it of all beauteous kinds of plants,

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: For insight and admonition to every servant who loveth to turn to God:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And we send down the rain from Heaven with its blessings, by which we cause gardens to spring forth and the grain of harvest,

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And the tall palm trees with date-bearing branches one above the other

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: For man's nourishment: And life give we thereby to a dead country. So also shall be the resurrection.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Ere the days of these (Meccans) the people of Noah, and the men of Rass2 and Themoud, treated their prophets as impostors:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And Ad and Pharaoh, and the brethren of Lot and the dwellers in the forest, and the people of Tobba,3 all gave the lie to their prophets: justly, therefore, were the menaces inflicted.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Are we wearied out with the first creation? Yet are they in doubt with regard to a new creation!4

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: We created man: and we know what his soul whispereth to him, and we are closer to him than his neck-vein.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: When the two angels charged with taking account shall take it, one sitting on the right hand, the other on the left:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Not a word doth he utter, but there is a watcher with him ready to note it down:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And the stupor of certain death cometh upon him: "This is what thou wouldst have shunned"-

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And there shall be a blast on the trumpet,-it is the threatened day!

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And every soul shall come,-an angel with it urging it along, and an angel to witness against it5-

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Saith he, "Of this day didst thou live in heedlessness: but we have taken off thy veil from thee, and thy sight is becoming sharp this day."

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And he who is at this side6 shall say, "This is what I am prepared with against thee."

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And God will say, "Cast into Hell, ye twain, every infidel, every hardened one,

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: The hinderer of the good, the transgressor, the doubter,

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Who set up other gods with God. Cast ye him into the fierce torment."

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: He who is at his side shall say, "O our Lord! I led him not astray, yet was he in an error wide of truth."

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: He shall say, "Wrangle not in my presence. I had plied you beforehand with menaces:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: My doom changeth not, and I am not unjust to man."

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: On that day will we cry to Hell, "Art thou full?" And it shall say, "Are there more?"7

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And not far from thence shall Paradise be brought near unto the Pious:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: - "This is what ye have been promised: to every one who hath turned in penitence to God and kept his laws;

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Who hath feared the God of Mercy in secret, and come to him with a contrite heart:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Enter it in peace: this is the day of Eternity."

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: There shall they have all that they can desire: and our's will it be to augment their bliss:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And how many generations have we destroyed ere the days of these (Meccans), mightier than they in strength! Search ye then the land. Is there any escape?

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Lo! herein is warning for him who hath a heart, or giveth ear, and is himself an eye-witness.8

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days, and no weariness touched us.9

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Wherefore put up with what they say, and celebrate the praise of thy Lord before sunrise and before sunset:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And praise Him in the night: and perform the two final prostrations.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And list for the day whereon the crier shall cry from a place near to every one alike:

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: The day on which men shall in truth hear that shout will be the day of their coming forth from the grave.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Verily, we cause to live, and we cause to die. To us shall all return.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: On the day when the earth shall swiftly cleave asunder over the dead, will this gathering be easy to Us.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: We know best what the infidels say: and thou art not to compel them.

records.label: Surah 50 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Warn then by the Koran those who fear my menace.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: By the clouds1 which scatter with SCATTERING,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And those which bear their load,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And by those which speed lightly along,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And those which apportion by command!

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: True, indeed, is that with which ye are threatened,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And lo! the judgment will surely come.2

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: By the star-tracked heaven!

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Ye are discordant in what ye say;

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: But whose turneth him from the truth, is turned from it by a divine decree.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Perish the liars,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Who are bewildered in the depths of ignorance!

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: They ask, "When this day of judgment?"

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: On that day they shall be tormented at the fire.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: "Taste ye of this your torment, whose speedy coming ye challenged."

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: But the God-fearing shall dwell amid gardens and fountains,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Enjoying what their Lord hath given them, because, aforetime they were well- doers:

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: But little of the night was it that they slept,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And at dawn they prayed for pardon,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And gave due share of their wealth to the suppliant and the outcast.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: On Earth are signs for men of firm belief,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And also in your own selves: Will ye not then behold them?

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: The Heaven hath sustenance for you, and it containeth that which you are promised.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: By the Lord then of the heaven and of the earth, I swear that this is the truth, even as ye speak yourselves.3

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Hath the story reached thee of Abraham's honoured guests?4

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: When they went in unto him and said, "Peace!" he replied, "Peace:-they are strangers."

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And he went apart to his family, and brought a fatted calf,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And set it before them. He said, "Eat ye not?"

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And he conceived a fear of them. They said to him, "Fear not;" and announced to him a wise son.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: His wife came up with outcry: she smote her face and said, "What I, old and barren!"

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: They said, "Thus saith thy Lord. He truly is the Wise, the Knowing."

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Said he, "And what, O messengers, is your errand?"

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: They said, "To a wicked people are we sent,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: To hurl upon them stones of clay,

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Destined5 by thy Lord for men guilty of excesses."

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And we brought forth the believers who were in the city:

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: But we found not in it but one family of Muslims.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: And signs we left in it for those who dread the afflictive chastisement,-

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And in Moses: when we sent him to Pharaoh with manifest power:

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: But relying on his forces6 he turned his back and said, "Sorcerer, or Possessed."

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: So we seized him and his hosts and cast them into the sea; for of all blame was he worthy.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: And in Ad: when we sent against them the desolating blast:

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: It touched not aught over which it came, but it turned it to dust.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: And in Themoud:7 when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for yet a while."

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: But they rebelled against their Lord's command: so the tempest took them as they watched its coming.8

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: They were not able to stand upright, and could not help themselves.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And we destroyed the people of Noah, before them; for an impious people were they.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And the Heaven-with our hands have we built it up, and given it its expanse;

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And the Earth-we have stretched it out like a carpet; and how

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: smoothly have we spread it forth!

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And of everything have we created pairs: that haply ye may reflect.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Fly then to God: I come to you from him a plain warner.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And set not up another god with God: I come to you from him a plain warner.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: Even thus came there no apostle to those who flourished before them, but they exclaimed, "Sorcerer, or Possessed."

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Have they made a legacy to one another of this scoff? Yes, they are a rebel people.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: Turn away, then, from them, and thou shalt not incur reproach:

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Yet warn them, for, in truth, warning will profit the believers.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: I have not created Djinn and men, but that they should worship me:

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: I require not sustenance from them, neither require I that they feed me:

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Verily, God is the sole sustainer: possessed of might: the unshaken!

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: Therefore to those who injure thee shall be a fate like the fate of

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: their fellows of old. Let them not challenge me to hasten it.

records.label: Surah 51 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Woe then to the infidels, because of their threatened day.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BY the MOUNTAIN,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And by the Book written

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: On an outspread roll,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And by the frequented fane,1

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And by the lofty vault,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And by the swollen sea,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Verily, a chastisement from thy Lord is imminent,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And none shall put it back.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Reeling on that day the Heaven shall reel,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And stirring shall the mountains stir.2

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And woe, on that day, to those who called the apostles liars,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Who plunged for pastime into vain disputes-

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: On that day shall they be thrust with thrusting to the fire of Hell:-

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: "This is the fire which ye treated as a lie.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: What! is this magic, then? or, do ye not see it?

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Burn ye therein: bear it patiently or impatiently 'twill be the same to you: for ye shall assuredly receive the reward of your doings."

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: But mid gardens and delights shall they dwell who have feared God,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Rejoicing in what their Lord hath given them; and that from the pain of hell- fire hath their Lord preserved them.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: "Eat and drink with healthy enjoyment, in recompense for your deeds."

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: On couches ranged in rows shall they recline; and to the damsels with large dark eyes will we wed them.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And to those who have believed, whose offspring have followed them in the faith, will we again unite their offspring; nor of the meed of their works will we in the least defraud them. Pledged to God is every man for his actions and their desert.3

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And fruits in abundance will we give them, and flesh as they shall desire:

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Therein shall they pass to one another the cup which shall engender no light discourse, no motive to sin:

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And youths shall go round among them beautiful as imbedded pearls:

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And shall accost one another and ask mutual questions.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: "A time indeed there was," will they say, "when we were full of care as to the future lot of our families;

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But kind hath God been to us, and from the pestilential torment hath he preserved us;

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: For, heretofore we called upon Him-and He is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Warn thou, then. For thou by the favour of thy Lord art neither soothsayer nor possessed.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Will they say, "A poet! let us await some adverse turn of his fortune?"

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: SAY, wait ye, and in sooth I too will wait with you.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Is it their dreams which inspire them with this? or is it that they are a perverse people?

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Will they say, "He hath forged it (the Koran) himself?" Nay, rather it is that they believed not.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Let them then produce a discourse like it, if they speak the Truth.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Were they created by nothing? or were they the creators of themselves?

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Created they the Heavens and Earth? Nay, rather, they have no faith.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Hold they thy Lord's treasures? Bear they the rule supreme?

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Have they a ladder for hearing the angels? Let any one who hath heard them bring a clear proof of it.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Hath God daughters and ye sons?

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Asketh thou pay of them? they are themselves weighed down with debts.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Have they such a knowledge of the secret things that they can write them down?

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Desire they to lay snares for thee? But the snared ones shall be they who do not believe.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Have they any God beside God? Glory be to God above what they join with Him.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: And should they see a fragment of the heaven falling down, they would say, "It is only a dense cloud."

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Leave them then until they come face to face with the day when they shall swoon away:

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: A day in which their snares shall not at all avail them, neither shall they be helped.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And verily, beside this is there a punishment for the evildoers: but most of them know it not.

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Wait thou patiently the judgment of thy Lord, for thou art in our eye; and celebrate the praise of thy Lord when thou risest up,

records.label: Surah 52 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: And in the night-season: Praise him when the stars are setting.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: By the STAR when it setteth,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Your compatriot erreth not, nor is he led astray,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Neither speaketh he from mere impulse.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: The Koran is no other than a revelation revealed to him:

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: One terrible in power2 taught it him,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Endued with wisdom. With even balance stood he

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: In the highest part of the horizon:

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Then came he nearer and approached,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And was at the distance of two bows, or even closer,-

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And he revealed to his servant what he revealed.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: His heart falsified not what he saw.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: What! will ye then dispute with him as to what he saw?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: He had seen him also another time,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Near the Sidrah-tree, which marks the boundary.3

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Near which is the garden of repose.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: When the Sidrah-tree4 was covered with what covered it,5

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: His eye turned not aside, nor did it wander:

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: For he saw the greatest of the signs of his Lord.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Do you see Al-Lat and Al-Ozza,6

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And Manat the third idol besides?7

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: What? shall ye have male progeny and God female?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: This were indeed an unfair partition!

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: These are mere names: ye and your fathers named them thus: God hath not sent down any warranty in their regard. A mere conceit and their own impulses do they follow. Yet hath "the guidance" from their Lord come to them.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Shall man have whatever he wisheth?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: The future and the present are in the hand of God:

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And many as are the Angels in the Heavens, their intercession shall be of no avail8

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Until God hath permitted it to whom he shall please and will accept.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Verily, it is they who believe not in the life to come, who name the angels with names of females:

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: But herein they have no knowledge: they follow a mere conceit; and mere conceit can never take the place of truth.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Withdraw then from him who turneth his back on our warning and desireth only this present life.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: This is the sum of their knowledge. Truly thy Lord best knoweth him who erreth from his way, and He best knoweth him who hath received guidance.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And whatever is in the Heavens and in the Earth is God's that he may reward those who do evil according to their deeds: and those who do good will He reward with good things.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: To those who avoid great crimes and scandals but commit only lighter faults, verily, thy Lord will be diffuse of mercy. He well knew you when he produced you out of the earth, and when ye were embryos in your mother's womb. Assert not then your own purity. He best knoweth who feareth him.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Hast thou considered him who turned his back?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Who giveth little and is covetous?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Is it that he hath the knowledge and vision of the secret things?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Hath he not been told of what is in the pages of Moses?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And of Abraham faithful to his pledge?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: That no burdened soul shall bear the burdens of another,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And that nothing shall be reckoned to a man but that for which he hath made efforts:

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: And that his efforts shall at last be seen in their true light:

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: That then he shall be recompensed with a most exact recompense,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: And that unto thy Lord is the term of all things,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: And that it is He who causeth to laugh and to weep,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And that He causeth to die and maketh alive,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And that He hath created the sexes, male and female,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: From the diffused germs of life,9

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And that with Him is the second creation,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: And that He enricheth and causeth to possess,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: And that He is the Lord of Sirius,10

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: And that it was He who destroyed the ancient Adites,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And the people of Themoud and left not one survivor,

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And before them the people of Noah who were most wicked and most perverse.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: And it was He who destroyed the cities that were overthrown.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: So that that which covered them covered them.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Which then of thy Lord's benefits wilt thou make a matter of doubt?11

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: He who warneth you is one of the warners of old.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: The day that must draw nigh, draweth nigh already: and yet none but God can reveal its time.

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Is it at these sayings that ye marvel?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: And that ye laugh and weep not?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: And that ye are triflers?

records.label: Surah 53 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Prostrate yourselves then to God and worship.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: The hour hath approached and the MOON hath been cleft:

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: But whenever they see a miracle they turn aside and say, This is well-devised magic.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And they have treated the prophets as impostors, and follow their own lusts; but everything is unalterably fixed.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: A message of prohibition had come to them-

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Consummate wisdom-but warners profit them not.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Quit them then. On the day when the summoner shall summon to a stern business,

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: With downcast eyes shall they come forth from their graves, as if they were scattered locusts,

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Hastening to the summoner. "This," shall the infidels say, "is the distressful day."

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Before them the people of Noah treated the truth as a lie. Our servant did they charge with falsehood, and said, "Demoniac!" and he was rejected.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Then cried he to his Lord, "Verily, they prevail against me; come thou therefore to my succour."

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: So we opened the gates of Heaven with water which fell in torrents,

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And we caused the earth to break forth with springs, and their waters met by settled decree.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And we bare him on a vessel made with planks and nails.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Under our eyes it floated on: a recompence to him who had been rejected with unbelief.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And we left it a sign: but, is there any one who receives the warning?

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And how great was my vengeance and my menace!

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Easy for warning have we made the Koran-but, is there any one who receives the warning?

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: The Adites called the truth a lie: but how great was my vengeance and my menace;

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: For we sent against them a roaring wind in a day of continued distress:

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: It tore men away as though they were uprooted palm stumps.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And how great was my vengeance and my menace!

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Easy for warning have we made the Koran-but, is there any one who receives the warning?

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: The tribe of Themoud treated the threatenings as lies:

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And they said, "Shall we follow a single man from among ourselves? Then verily should we be in error and in folly.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: To him alone among us is the office of warning entrusted? No! he is an impostor, an insolent person."

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: To-morrow shall they learn who is the impostor, the insolent.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: "For we will send the she-camel to prove them: do thou mark them well, O Saleh, and be patient:

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And foretell them that their waters shall1 be divided between themselves and her, and that every draught shall come by turns to them."

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: But they called to their comrade, and he took a knife and ham-strung her.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And how great was my vengeance and my menance!

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: We sent against them a single shout; and they became like the dry sticks of the fold-builders.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Easy have we made the Koran for warning-but, is there any one who receives the warning?

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: The people of Lot treated his warning as a lie;

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: But we sent a stone-charged wind against them all, except the family of Lot, whom at daybreak we delivered,

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: By our special grace-for thus we reward the thankful.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: He, indeed, had warned them of our severity, but of that warning they doubted.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Even this guess did they demand: therefore we deprived them of sight,

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And said, "Taste ye my vengeance and my menace;"

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And in the morning a relentless punishment overtook them.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Easy have we made the Koran for warning but, is there any one who receives the warning?

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: To the people of Pharaoh also came the threatenings:

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: All our miracles did they treat as impostures. Therefore seized we them as he only can seize, who is the Mighty, the Strong.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Are your infidels, O Meccans, better men than these? Is there an exemption for you in the sacred Books?

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Will they say, "We are a host that lend one another aid?"

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: The host shall be routed, and they shall turn them back.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: But, that Hour is their threatened time, and that Hour shall be most severe and bitter.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Verily, the wicked are sunk in bewilderment and folly.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: On that day they shall be dragged into the fire on their faces. "Taste ye the touch of Hell."

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: All things have we created after a fixed decree:

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Our command was but one word, swift as the twinkling of an eye.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Of old, too, have we destroyed the like of you-yet is any one warned?

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And everything that they do is in the Books;2

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: Each action, both small and great, is written down.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Verily, amid gardens3 and rivers shall the pious dwell.

records.label: Surah 54 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: In the seat of truth, in the presence of the potent King.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: The God of MERCY hath taught the Koran,

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Hath created man,

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Hath taught him articulate speech,

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: The Sun and the Moon have each their times,

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And the plants and the trees bend in adoration.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And the Heaven, He hath reared it on high, and hath appointed the balance;

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: That in the balance ye should not transgress.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Weigh therefore with fairness, and scant not the balance.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And the Earth, He hath prepared it for the living tribes:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Therein are fruits, and the palms with sheathed clusters,

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And the grain with its husk, and the fragrant plants.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will ye twain1 deny?

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: He created man of clay like that of the potter.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And He created the djinn of pure fire:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Which then of the bounties, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: He is the Lord of the East,2

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: He is the Lord of the West:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: He hath let loose the two seas3 which meet each other:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Yet between them is a barrier which they overpass not:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: From each he bringeth up pearls both great and small:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And His are the ships towering up at sea like mountains:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: All on the earth shall pass away,

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But the face of thy Lord shall abide resplendent with majesty and glory:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: To Him maketh suit all that is in the Heaven and the Earth. Every day doth some new work employ Him:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: We will find leisure to judge you, O ye men and djinn:4

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: O company of djinn and men, if ye can overpass the bounds of the Heavens and the Earth, then overpass them. But by our leave only shall ye overpass them:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: A bright flash of fire shall be hurled at you both, and molten brass, and ye shall not defend yourselves from it:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: When the Heaven shall be cleft asunder, and become rose red, like stained leather:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: On that day shall neither man nor djinn be asked of his sin:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: By their tokens shall the sinners be known, and they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: "This is Hell which sinners treated as a lie."

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: To and fro shall they pass between it and the boiling water:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: But for those who dread the majesty of their Lord shall be two gardens:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: With o'erbranching trees in each:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: In each two kinds of every fruit:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: On couches with linings of brocade shall they recline, and the fruit of the two gardens shall be within easy reach:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: Therein shall be the damsels with retiring glances, whom nor man nor djinn hath touched before them:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: Like jacynths and pearls:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: Shall the reward of good be aught but good?

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: And beside these shall be two other gardens:5

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Of a dark green:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: With gushing fountains in each:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: In each, fruits and the palm and the pomegranate:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: In each, the fair, the beauteous ones:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: With large dark eyeballs, kept close in their pavilions:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: Whom man hath never touched, nor any djinn:6

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: Their spouses on soft green cushions and on beautiful carpets shall recline:

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: Which, etc.

records.label: Surah 55 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of majesty and glory.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHEN the day that must come shall have come suddenly,1

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: None shall treat that sudden coming as a lie:

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Day that shall abase! Day that shall exalt!

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: When the earth shall be shaken with a shock,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And the mountains shall be crumbled with a crumbling,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And shall become scattered dust,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And into three bands shall ye be divided:2

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Then the people of the right hand3-Oh! how happy shall be the people of the right hand!

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And the people of the left hand-Oh! how wretched shall be the people of the left hand!

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And they who were foremost on earth-the foremost still.4

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: These are they who shall be brought nigh to God,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: In gardens of delight;

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: A crowd of the former

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And few of the latter generations;

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: On inwrought couches

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Reclining on them face to face:
