records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Aye-blooming youths go round about to them

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: With goblets and ewers and a cup of flowing wine;

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Their brows ache not from it, nor fails the sense:

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And with such fruits as shall please them best,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And with flesh of such birds, as they shall long for:

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And theirs shall be the Houris, with large dark eyes, like pearls hidden in their shells,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: In recompense of their labours past.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: No vain discourse shall they hear therein, nor charge of sin,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: But only the cry, "Peace! Peace!"

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And the people of the right hand-oh! how happy shall be the people of the right hand!

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Amid thornless sidrahs5

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And talh6 trees clad with fruit,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And in extended shade,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And by flowing waters,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And with abundant fruits,7

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Unfailing, unforbidden,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And on lofty couches.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Of a rare creation have we created the Houris,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And we have made them ever virgins,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Dear to their spouses, of equal age with them,8

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: For the people of the right hand,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: A crowd of the former,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And a crowd of the latter generations.9

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: But the people of the left hand-oh! how wretched shall be the people of the left hand!

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Amid pestilential10 winds and in scalding water,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: And in the shadow of a black smoke,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Not cool, and horrid to behold.11

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: For they truly, ere this, were blessed with worldly goods,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: But persisted in heinous sin,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And were wont to say,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: "What! after we have died, and become dust and bones, shall we be raised?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And our fathers, the men of yore?"

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: SAY: Aye, the former and the latter:

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Gathered shall they all be for the time of a known day.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Then ye, O ye the erring, the gainsaying,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: Shall surely eat of the tree Ez-zakkoum,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: And fill your bellies with it,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: And thereupon shall ye drink boiling water,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: And ye shall drink as the thirsty camel drinketh.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 57
records.text: This shall be their repast in the day of reckoning!

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 58
records.text: We created you, will ye not credit us?12

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 59
records.text: What think ye? The germs of life13-

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 60
records.text: Is it ye who create them? or are we their creator?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 61
records.text: It is we who have decreed that death should be among you;

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 62
records.text: Yet are we not thereby hindered14 from replacing you with others, your likes, or from producing you again in a form which ye know not!

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 63
records.text: Ye have known the first creation: will ye not then reflect?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 64
records.text: What think ye? That which ye sow-

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 65
records.text: Is it ye who cause its upgrowth, or do we cause it to spring forth?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 66
records.text: If we pleased we could so make your harvest dry and brittle that ye would ever marvel and say,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 67
records.text: "Truly we have been at cost,15 yet are we forbidden harvest."

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 68
records.text: What think ye of the water ye drink?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 69
records.text: Is it ye who send it down from the clouds, or send we it down?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 70
records.text: Brackish could we make it, if we pleased: will ye not then be thankful?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 71
records.text: What think ye? The fire which ye obtain by friction-

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 72
records.text: Is it ye who rear its tree, or do we rear it?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 73
records.text: It is we who have made it for a memorial and a benefit to the wayfarers of the desert,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 74
records.text: Praise therefore the name of thy Lord, the Great.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 75
records.text: It needs not that I swear by the setting of the stars,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 76
records.text: And it is a great oath, if ye knew it,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 77
records.text: That this is the honourable Koran,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 78
records.text: Written in the preserved Book:16

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 79
records.text: Let none touch it but the purified,17

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 80
records.text: It is a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 81
records.text: Such tidings as these will ye disdain?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 82
records.text: Will ye make it your daily bread to gainsay them?

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 83
records.text: Why, at the moment when the soul of a dying man shall come up into his throat,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 84
records.text: And when ye are gazing at him,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 85
records.text: Though we are nearer to him than ye, although ye see us not:-

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 86
records.text: Why do ye not, if ye are to escape the judgment,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 87
records.text: Cause that soul to return? Tell me, if ye speak the truth.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 88
records.text: But as to him who shall enjoy near access to God,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 89
records.text: His shall be repose, and pleasure, and a garden of delights.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 90
records.text: Yea, for him who shall be of the people of the right hand,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 91
records.text: Shall be the greeting from the people of the right hand-"Peace be to thee."

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 92
records.text: But for him who shall be of those who treat the prophets as deceivers,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 93
records.text: And of the erring,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 94
records.text: His entertainment shall be of scalding water,

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 95
records.text: And the broiling of hell-fire.

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 96
records.text: Verily this is a certain truth:

records.label: Surah 56 · edition paragraph 97
records.text: Praise therefore the name of thy Lord, the Great.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ALL that is in the Heavens and in the Earth praiseth God, and He is the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: His the Kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth; He maketh alive and killeth; and He hath power over all things!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: He is the first and the last; the Seen and the Hidden;2 and He knoweth all things!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: It is He who in six days created the Heavens and the Earth, then ascended His throne. He knoweth that which entereth the earth, and that which goeth forth from it, and what cometh down from Heaven, and what mounteth up to it; and wherever ye are, He is with you; and God beholdeth all your actions!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: His the kingdom of the Heavens and the Earth; and to God shall all things return!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: He causeth the night to pass into the day, and He causeth the day to pass into the night: and He knoweth the very secrets of the bosom!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Believe in God and his apostle, and bestow in alms of that whereof God hath made you heirs: for whoever among you believe and give alms-their's shall be a great recompense.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: What hath come to you that ye believe not in God, although the apostle exhorteth you to believe in your Lord, and He hath accepted your alliance-if ye are true believers?

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: He it is who hath sent down clear tokens upon His servant, that He may bring you out of darkness into light; and truly, Kind, Merciful to you is God.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And what hath come to you that ye expend not for the cause of God? since the heritage of the Heavens and of the Earth is God's only! Those among you who contributed before the victory, and fought, shall be differently treated from certain others among you! Such shall have a nobler grade than those who contributed and fought after it. But a goodly recompense hath God promised to all; and God is fully informed of your actions.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Who is he that will lend a generous loan to God? So will He double it to him, and he shall have a noble reward.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: One day thou shalt see the believers, men and women, with their light running before them, and on their right hand.3 The angels shall say to them, "Good tidings for you this day of gardens beneath whose shades the rivers flow, in which ye shall abide for ever!" This the great bliss!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: On that day the hypocrites, both men and women, shall say to those who believe, "Tarry for us, that we may kindle our light at yours." It shall be said, "Return ye back, and seek light for yourselves." But between them shall be set a wall with a gateway, within which shall be the Mercy, and in front, without it, the Torment. They shall cry to them, "Were we not with you?" They shall say, "Yes! but ye led yourselves into temptation, and ye delayed, and ye doubted, and the good things ye craved deceived you, till the doom of God arrived:-and the deceiver deceived you in regard to God."

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: On that day, therefore, no ransom shall be taken from you or from those who believe not:-your abode the fire!-This shall be your master!4 and wretched the journey thither!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Hath not the time come, for those who believe, to humble their hearts at the warning of God and at the truth which he hath sent down? and that they be not as those to whom the Scriptures were given heretofore, whose lifetime was prolonged, but whose hearts were hardened, and many of them were perverse?

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Know that God quickeneth the earth after its death! Now have we made these signs clear to you, that ye may understand.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Verily, they who give alms, both men and women, and they who lend a generous loan to God,-doubled shall it be to them-and they shall have a noble recompense.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And they who believed in God and his apostle are the men of truth, and the witnesses in the presence of their Lord;5 They shall have their recompense and their light: But as for the infidels, and those who give the lie to our signs, these shall be the inmates of Hell.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Know ye that this world's life is only a sport, and pastime, and show, and a cause of vainglory among you! And the multiplying of riches and children is like the plants which spring up after rain-Their growth rejoiceth the husband-man; then they wither away, and thou seest them all yellow; then they become stubble. And in the next life is a severe chastisement,

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Or else pardon from God and His satisfaction: and this world's life is but a cheating fruition.6

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Vie in hasting after pardon from your Lord, and Paradise-whose outspread is as the outspread of the Heaven and of the Earth: Prepared is it for those who believe in God and His apostles: Such is the bounty of God: to whom He will He giveth it: and of immense bounty is God!

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: No mischance chanceth either on earth or in your own persons, but ere we created them, it was in the Book;7-for easy is this to God-

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Lest ye distress yourselves if good things escape you, and be over joyous for what falleth to your share. God loveth not the presumptuous, the boaster,

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Who are covetous themselves and incite others to covetousness. But whose turneth away from almsgiving-Ah! God is the Rich, the Praiseworthy.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: We have sent our apostles with the clear tokens, and we have caused the Book and the balance8 to descend with them, that men might observe fairness. And we have sent down IRON. Dire evil9 resideth in it, as well as advantage, to mankind! God would know who will assist Him and his apostle in secret. Verily, God is Powerful, Strong.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And of old sent we Noah and Abraham, and on their seed conferred the gift of prophecy, and the Book; and some of them we guided aright; but many were evil doers.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Then we caused our apostles to follow in their footsteps; and we caused Jesus the son of Mary to follow them; and we gave him the Evangel,10 and we put into the hearts of those who followed him kindness and compassion: but as to the monastic life, they invented it themselves. The desire only of pleasing God did we prescribe to them, and this they observed not as it ought to have been observed: but to such of them as believed gave we their reward, though many of them were perverse.

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: O ye who believe! fear God and believe in his apostle: two portions of his mercy will He give you. He will bestow on you light to walk in, and He will forgive you: for God is Forgiving, Merciful;

records.label: Surah 57 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: That the people of the Book may know that they have no control over aught of the favours of God, and that these gifts of grace11 are in the hands of God, and that He vouchsafeth them to whom he will; for God is of immense bounty.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: God hath heard the words of HER1 WHO PLEADED with thee against her husband, and made her plaint to God; and God hath heard your mutual intercourse: for God Heareth, Beholdeth.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: As to those of you who put away their wives by saying, "Be thou to me as my mother's back" their mothers2 they are not; they only are their mothers who gave them birth! they certainly say a blameworthy thing and an untruth:

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: But truly, God is Forgiving, Indulgent.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And those who thus put away their wives, and afterwards would recall their words, must free a captive before they can come together again. To this are ye warned to conform: and God is aware of what ye do.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And he who findeth not a captive to set free, shall fast two months in succession before they two come together. And he who shall not be able to do so, shall feed sixty poor men. This, that he may believe in God and His Apostle. These are the statutes of God: and for the unbelievers is an afflictive chastisement!

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Truly they who oppose God and His Apostle shall be brought low, as those who were before them were brought low. And now have we sent down demonstrative signs: and, for the Infidels is a shameful chastisement.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: On the day when God shall raise them all to life, and shall tell them of their doings. God hath taken count of them, though they have forgotten them! and God is witness over all things.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Dost thou not see that God knoweth all that is in the Heavens and all that is in the Earth? Three persons speak not privately together, but He is their fourth; nor five, but He is their sixth; nor fewer nor more, but wherever they be He is with them. Then on the day of resurrection He will tell them of their deeds: for God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Hast thou not marked those who have been forbidden secret talk, and return to what they have been forbidden, and talk privately together with wickedness, and hate, and disobedience towards the Apostle? And when they come to thee, they greet thee not as God greeteth thee:3 and they say among themselves, "Why doth not God punish us for what we say?" Hell shall be their meed:4 they shall be burned at its fire: and a wretched passage thither!

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: O Believers! when ye hold private converse together, let it not be with wickedness, and hate, and disobedience towards the Apostle; but let your private talk be with justice and the fear of God: aye, fear ye God unto whom ye shall be gathered!

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Only of Satan is this clandestine talk, that he may bring the faithful to grief: but, unless by God's permission, not aught shall he harm them! in God then let the faithful trust.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: O ye who believe! when it is said to you, "Make room in your assemblies," then make ye room. God will make room for you in Paradise! And when it is said to you, "Rise up," then rise ye up. God will uplift those of you who believe, and those to whom "the Knowledge" is given, to lofty grades! and God is cognisant of your actions.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: O ye who believe! when ye go to confer in private with the Apostle, give alms before such conference. Better will this be for you, and more pure. But if ye have not the means, then truly God is Lenient, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Do ye hesitate to give alms previously to your private conference? Then if ye do it not (and God will excuse it in you), at least observe prayer, and pay the stated impost, and obey God and His Apostle: for God is cognisant of your actions.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Hast thou not remarked those who make friends of that people with whom God is angered? They are neither of your party nor of theirs; and they swear to a lie,5 knowing it to be such.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: God hath got ready for them a severe torment: for, evil is that they do.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: They make a cloak of their faith, and turn others aside from the way of God: wherefore a shameful torment awaiteth them.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Not at all shall their wealth or their children avail them aught against God. Companions shall they be of the fire: they shall abide therein for ever.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: On the day when God shall raise them all, they will swear to Him as they now swear to you, deeming that it will avail them. Are they not-yes they-the liars?

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Satan hath gotten mastery over them, and made them forget the remembrance of God. These are Satan's party. What! shall not verily the party of Satan be for ever lost.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Verily, they who oppose God and His Apostle shall be among the most vile. God hath written this decree: "I will surely prevail, and my Apostles also." Truly God is Strong, Mighty.

records.label: Surah 58 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Thou shalt not find that any of those who believe in God, and in the last day, love him who opposeth God and His Apostle, even though they be their fathers, or their sons, or their brethren, or their nearest kin. On the hearts of these hath God graven the Faith, and with His own Spirit hath He strengthened them; and He will bring them into gardens, beneath whose shades the rivers flow, to remain therein eternally. God is well pleased in them, and they in Him. These are God's party! Shall not, of a truth, a party of God be for ever blessed?

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ALL that is in the Heavens and all that is on the Earth praiseth God! He, the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: He it is who caused the unbelievers among the people of the Book to quit their homes and join those who had EMIGRATED previously.1 Ye did not think that they would quit them; and they on their part thought that their fortresses would protect them against God: But God came upon them whence they looked not for Him, and cast such fear into their hearts that by their own hands as well as by the hands of the victorious believers they demolished their houses! Profit by this example ye who are men of insight!

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And were it not that God had decreed their exile, surely in this world would he have chastised them: but in the world to come the chastisement of the fire awaiteth them.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: This because they set them against God and his apostle; and whoso setteth him against God. . . . ! God truly is vehement in punishing.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Your cutting down some of their palm trees and sparing others was by God's permission, and to put the wicked to shame.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: After the spoils of these Jews which God hath assigned to his apostle, ye pressed not with horse or camel.2 But God giveth his apostles power over what he will. God is Almighty.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: The spoil taken from the people of the towns and assigned by God to his apostle, belongeth to God, and to the apostle, and to his kindred, and to the orphan, and to the poor, and to the wayfarer, that none of it may circulate among such of you only as are rich: What the apostle hath given you, take: What he hath refused you, refuse: And fear ye God, for God is severe in punishing.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: To the poor refugees (Mohadjerin) also doth a part belong, who have been driven from their homes and their substance, and who seek favour from God and his goodwill, and aid God and his apostle. These are the men of genuine virtue.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: They of Medina who had been in possession of their abodes and embraced the faith before them, cherish those who take refuge with them; and they find not in their breasts any desire for what hath fallen to their share: they prefer them before themselves, though poverty be their own lot. And with such as are preserved from their own covetousness shall it be well.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And they who have come after them into the faith say, "O our Lord! forgive us and our brethren who have preceded us in the faith, and put not into our hearts ill-will against those who believe. O our Lord! thou verily art Kind, Merciful."

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Hast thou not observed the disaffected saying to their unbelieving brethren3 among the people of the Book, "If ye be driven forth, we will go forth with you; and in what concerneth you, never will we obey any one; and if ye be attacked we will certainly come to your help." But God is witness that they are liars.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: No! if they were driven forth, they would not share their banishment; if they were attacked they would not help them, or if they help them they will surely turn their backs: then would they remain unhelped.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Assuredly the fear of you is more intense in their hearts than the fear of God! This because they are a people devoid of discernment.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: They (the Jews) will not fight against you in a body except in fenced towns or from behind walls. Mighty is their valour among themselves! thou thinkest them united-but their hearts are divided. This for that they are a people who understand not.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: They act like those who lately preceded them,4 who also tasted the result of their doings; and a grievous chastisement awaiteth them-

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Like Satan when he saith to a man, "Be an infidel:" and when he hath become an infidel, he saith, "I share not thy guilt:5 verily, I fear God the Lord of the Worlds."

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Of both, therefore, shall the end be that they dwell for ever in the fire: This is the recompense of the evil doers.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: O ye who believe! fear God. And let every soul look well to what it sendeth on before for the morrow. And fear ye God: Verily, God is cognisant of what ye do.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And be ye not like those who forget God, and whom He hath therefore caused to forget their proper selves. Such men are the evil doers.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: The inmates of the Fire and the inmates of Paradise are not to be held equal. The inmates of Paradise only shall be the blissful.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Had we sent down this Koran on some mountain, thou wouldst certainly have seen it humbling itself6 and cleaving asunder for the fear of God. Such are the parables we propose to men in order that they may reflect.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: He is God beside whom there is no god. He knoweth things visible and invisible: He is the Compassionate, the Merciful.

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: He is God beside whom there is no god: He is the King, the Holy, the Peaceful, the Faithful, the Guardian, the Mighty, the Strong, the Most High! Far be the Glory of God from that which they unite with Him!

records.label: Surah 59 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: He is God, the Producer, the Maker, the Fashioner! To Him are ascribed excellent titles. Whatever is in the Heavens and in the Earth praiseth Him. He is the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O YE who believe! take not my foe2 and your foe for friends, shewing them kindness, although they believe not that truth which hath come to you: they drive forth the Apostles and yourselves because ye believe in God your Lord! If ye go forth to fight on my way, and from a desire to please me, and shew them kindness in private, I well know what ye conceal, and what ye discover! Whoso doth this hath already gone astray from the even way.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: If they meet with you they will prove your foes: hand and tongue will they put forth for your hurt, and will desire that you become infidels again.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Neither your kindred nor your children shall at all avail you on the day of the resurrection. A severance between you will it make! and your actions doth God behold.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: A good example had ye in Abraham,3 and in those who followed him, when they said to their people, "Verily, we are clear of you, and of what ye worship beside God: we renounce you: and between us and hath hatred and enmity sprung up for ever, until ye believe in God alone." Yet imitate not the language of Abraham to his Father, "I will pray for thy forgiveness, but not aught shall I obtain for thee from God."4 O our Lord! in thee do we trust! to thee do we turn! to thee we shall come back at the last.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: O our Lord! expose us not for trial to the unbelievers, and forgive us: for thou art the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: A good example had ye in them, for all who hope in God and in the last day. But let who will turn back, God truly is the Rich, the Praiseworthy!

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: God will, perhaps, establish good will between yourselves and those of them whom ye take to be your enemies:5 God is Powerful: and God is Gracious, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: God doth not forbid you to deal with kindness and fairness toward those who have not made war upon you on account of your religion, or driven you forth from your homes: for God loveth those who act with fairness.>Only doth God forbid you to make friends of those who, on account of your religion, have warred against you, and have driven you forth from your homes, and have aided those who drove you forth: and whoever maketh friends of them are wrong- doers.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: O Believers!6 when believing women come over to you as refugees (Mohadjers), then make TRIAL of them. God best knoweth their faith; but if ye have also ascertained their faith, let them not go back to the infidels; they are not lawful for them, nor are the unbelievers lawful for these women. But give them back what they have spent for their dowers. No crime shall it be in you to marry them, provided ye give them their dowers. Do not retain any right in the infidel women, but demand back what you have spent for their dowers, and let the unbelievers demand back what they have spent for their wives.7 This is the ordinance of God which He ordaineth among you: and God is Knowing, Wise.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And if any of your wives escape from you to the Infidels from whom ye afterwards take any spoil, then give to those whose wives shall have fled away, the like of what they shall have spent for their dowers; and fear God in whom ye believe.

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: O Prophet! when believing women come to thee, and pledge themselves that they will not associate aught with God, and that they will not steal or commit adultery, nor kill their children, nor bring scandalous charges,8 nor disobey thee in what is right, then plight thou thy faith to them, and ask pardon for them of God: for God is Indulgent, Merciful!

records.label: Surah 60 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: O Believers! enter not into amity with those against whom God is angered; they despair of the life to come, even as the Infidels despair of the inmates of the tombs.

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ALL that is in the Heavens and all that is on the Earth praiseth God. He is the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Believers! why profess ye that which ye practise not?1

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Most hateful is it to God that ye say that which ye do not.

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Verily God loveth those who, as though they were a solid wall, do battle for his cause in serried lines!

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And bear in mind when Moses said to his people, "Why grieve ye me, O my people, when ye know that I am God's apostle unto you?" And when they went astray, God led their hearts astray; for God guideth not a perverse people:

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And remember when Jesus the son of Mary said, "O children of Israel! of a truth I am God's apostle to you to confirm the law which was given before me, and to announce an apostle that shall come after me whose name shall be Ahmad!"2 But when he (Ahmad) presented himself with clear proofs of his mission, they said, "This is manifest sorcery!"

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But who more impious than he who when called to Islam deviseth a falsehood concerning God? God guideth not the wicked!

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Fain would they put out the light of God with their mouths! but though the Infidels hate it, God will perfect his light.

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: He it is who hath sent his apostle with guidance and the religion of truth, that, though they hate it who join other gods with God, He may make it victorious over every other religion.

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: O ye who believe! shall I shew you a merchandise that shall deliver you from the sore torment?

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Believe in God and his apostle, and do valiantly in the cause of God with your wealth and with your persons! This, did ye but know it, will be best for you.

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Your sins will He forgive you, and He will bring you into gardens beneath whose shades the rivers flow-into charming abodes in the gardens of Eden: This shall be the great bliss.-

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And other things which ye desire will he bestow, Help from God and speedy conquest!3 Bear thou these tidings to the faithful.

records.label: Surah 61 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: O ye who believe! be helpers (ansars) of God; as said Jesus the son of Mary to his apostles, "Who will come to the help of God?" "We," said the apostles, "will be helpers of God." And a part of the children of Israel believed, and a part believed not. But to those who believed gave we the upperhand over their foes, and soon did they prove victorious.

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ALL that is in the Heavens, and all that is on the Earth, uttereth the Praise of God, the King! the Holy! the Mighty! the Wise!

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: It is He who hath sent to the pagan folk (Arabs) an Apostle from among themselves, to rehearse His signs to them, and to purify them, and to impart to them a knowledge of "the Book" and wisdom; for aforetime were they in manifest error.

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And others among them have not yet overtaken those who preceded them in the faith. But He is the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: This is the goodness of God: He bestoweth it on whom He will: God is of immense goodness!

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: They on whom the burden of the law was laid, and would not bear it, are like an ass beneath a load of books. A sorry likeness this, for the people who give the lie to the signs of God! God guideth not the people who do this wrong!

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: SAY: O ye Jews, if ye profess that ye rather than other men are the friends of God, then wish for death if ye are men of truth.

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But never on account of their previous handywork will they wish for it, and God knoweth the wrong doers.

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: SAY: Verily the death from which ye flee will surely meet you. Then shall ye be brought back to Him who knoweth alike the things done in secret and openly: and He will tell you of your actions.

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: O ye who believe! When ye are summoned to prayer on the day of THE ASSEMBLY,1 haste to the commemoration of God, and quit your traffic. This, if ye knew it, will be best for you.

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And when the Prayer is ended, then disperse yourselves abroad and go in quest of the bounties of God; and, that it may be well with you, oft remember God.

records.label: Surah 62 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: But when they get a sight of merchandise or sport, they disperse after it, and leave thee standing alone.2 SAY: God hath in reserve what is better than sport or wares. And God is the best provider!

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHEN the Hypocrites come to thee, they say, "We bear witness that thou art the Sent One of God." God knoweth that thou art His Sent One: but God beareth witness that the HYPOCRITES do surely lie.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Their faith2 have they used as a cloak, and they turn aside others from the way of God! Evil are all their doings.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: This, for that they believed, then became unbelievers!Therefore hath a seal been set upon their hearts, and they understand not.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: When thou seest them, their persons make thee marvel; and if they speak, thou listenest with pleasure to their discourse. Like timbers are they leaning against a wall!3 They think that every shout is against them. They are enemies-Beware of them then-God do battle with them! How false are they!

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And when it is said to them, "Come, the Apostle of God will ask pardon for you," they turn their heads aside, and thou seest them withdraw in their pride.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Alike shall it be to them whether thou ask forgiveness for them, or ask it not. By no means will God forgive them: God hath no guidance for a perverse people.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: These are they who say to you of Medina, "Spend not aught upon those who are with the Apostle of God, and they will be forced to quit him." Yet the treasures of the Heavens and of the Earth are God's! But the Hypocrites have no understanding.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: They say: "If we return to the city, the mightier will assuredly drive out the weaker from it." But might is with God, and with the Apostle, and with the Faithful! Yet the Hypocrites understand not.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: O ye who believe! let not your wealth and your children delude you into forgetfulness of God. Whoever shall act thus, shall surely suffer loss.

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And expend in the cause of God out of that with which we have supplied you, ere death surprise each one of you, and he say, "O Lord! wilt thou not respite me to a term not far distant, that I may give alms, and become one of the just?"

records.label: Surah 63 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And by no means will God respite a soul when its hour hath come! And God is fully cognisant of what ye do.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: ALL that is in the Heavens, and all that is in the Earth, praiseth God: His the Kingdom and His the Glory! And He hath power over all things!

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: It is He who hath created you all; yet some of you are infidel and others believers: but God beholdeth all your actions.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: He hath created the Heavens and the Earth in Truth; and He hath fashioned you and given you goodly forms; and to Him must ye all return.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: He knoweth all that passeth in the Heavens and in the Earth; and He knoweth what ye hide and what ye bring to light; and God knoweth the very secrets of men's breasts.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Hath not the story reached you of those who disbelieved of yore, and therefore tasted the evil consequences of their doings? And a sore punishment doth await them.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: This, for that when their apostles came to them with the clear tokens, they said, "What! shall men be our guides?" And they believed not and turned their backs. But God can dispense with them; for God is the Rich, the Praiseworthy!

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: The infidels pretend that they shall not be raised from the dead. SAY: Yea, by my Lord, ye shall surely be raised; then shall ye surely be told of your deeds! And easy is this for God.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Believe then in God and his apostle and in the light which we have sent down; for God is fully aware of all ye do.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: The day when He shall gather you together for the day of mutual gathering, will be the day of MUTUAL DECEIT,2 and whoso shall have believed in God and done what is right, for him will He cancel his deeds of evil; and He will bring him into the gardens beneath whose shades the rivers flow, to abide therein for evermore. This will be the great bliss!

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: But the unbelieving-those who gave the lie to our signs-shall be the inmates of the fire, wherein they shall remain for ever. And a wretched passage thither!

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: No mischance chanceth but by God's permission; and whoso believeth in God, that man's heart will he guide: and God knoweth all things.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Obey God then and obey the apostle: but if ye turn away, our apostle is not to blame, for he is only charged with plain preaching.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: God! there is no God but He! On God, then, let the faithful trust.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: O ye who believe! Verily, in your wives and your children ye have an enemy: wherefore beware of them. But if ye pass it3 over and pardon, and are lenient, then God too is Lenient, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Your wealth and your children are only a source of trial! but God! with Him is the great recompense.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Fear God, then, with all your might, and hear and obey: and give alms for your own weal; for such as are saved from their own greed, shall prosper.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: If ye lend God a generous loan, He will double it to you and will forgive you, for God is Grateful, Long-suffering.

records.label: Surah 64 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: He knoweth alike the Hidden and the Manifest: the Mighty, the Wise!

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O PROPHET! when ye divorce women, divorce them at their special times. And reckon those times exactly, and fear God your Lord. Put them not forth from their houses, nor allow them to depart, unless they have committed a proven adultery. This is the precept of God; and whoso transgresseth the precept of God, assuredly imperilleth his own self. Thou knowest not whether, after this, God may not cause something new to occur which may bring you together again.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And when they have reached their set time, then either keep them with kindness, or in kindness part from them. And take upright witnesses from among you, and bear witness as unto God. This is a caution for him who believeth in God and in the latter day. And whoso feareth God, to him will He grant a prosperous issue, and will provide for him whence he reckoned not upon it.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And for him who putteth his trust in Him will God be all-sufficient. God truly will attain his purpose. For everything hath God assigned a period.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: As to such of your wives as have no hope of the recurrence of their times, if ye have doubts in regard to them, then reckon three months, and let the same be the term of those who have not yet had them. And as to those who are with child, their period shall be until they are delivered of their burden. God will make His command easy to him who feareth Him.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: This is God's command which He hath sent down to you: Whoso feareth God, his evil deeds will He cancel and will increase his reward.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Lodge the divorced wherever ye lodge, according to your means; and distress them not by putting them to straits. And if they are pregnant, then be at charges for the them till they are delivered of their burden; and if they suckle your children, then pay them their hire and consult among yourselves, and act generously: And if herin ye meet with obstacles, then let another female suckle for him.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Let him who hath abundance of his abundance; let him, too, whose store is scanty, give of what God hath vouchsafed to him. God imposeth burdens only according to the means which He hath given. God will cause ease to succeed difficulties.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: How many cities have turned aside from the command of their Lord and of his apostles! Therefore did we reckon with them in a severe reckoning, and chastised them with a stern chastisement;

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And they tasted the harmfulness of their own conduct: and the end of their conduct was ruin.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: A vehement chastisement hath God prepared for them! Fear God, then, O ye men of understanding!2

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Believers! Now hath God sent down to you a warning! a prophet, who reciteth to you the clear signs of God, that he may bring those who believe, and do the things that are right, out of the darkness into the light. And-whoso believeth in God, and doeth the things that are right, God will cause them to enter the gardens beneath which the rivers flow, to remain therein for aye! A goodly provision now hath God made for him.

records.label: Surah 65 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: It is God who hath created seven heavens and as many earths.3 The Divine command cometh down through them all, that ye may know that God hath power over all things, and that God in his knowledge embraceth all things!

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHY,1 O Prophet! dost thou hold that to be FORBIDDEN which God hath made lawful to thee, from a desire to please thy wives, since God is Lenient, Merciful?

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: God hath allowed you release from your oaths; and God is your master: and He is the Knowing, Wise.

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: When the prophet told a recent occurrence as a secret to one of his wives, and when she divulged it and God informed him of this, he acquainted her with part and withheld part.2 And when he had told her of it, she said, "Who told thee this?" He said, "The Knowing, the Sage hath told it me.

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: "If ye both be turned to God in penitence, for now have your hearts gone astray . . . .3 but if ye conspire against the Prophet, then know that God is his Protector, and Gabriel, and every just man among the faithful; and the angels are his helpers besides.

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: "Haply if he put you both away, his Lord will give him in exchange other wives better than you, Muslims, believers, devout, penitent, obedient, observant of fasting, both known of men and virgins."

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: O Believers! save yourselves and your families from the fire whose fuel is men and stones, over which are set angels fierce and mighty: they disobey not God in what He hath commanded them, but execute His behests.

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: O ye Infidels! make no excuses for yourselves this day; ye shall surely be recompensed according to your works.

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: O Believers! turn to God with the turning of true penitence; haply your Lord will cancel your evil deeds, and will bring you into the gardens 'neath which the rivers flow, on the day when God will not shame the Prophet, nor those who have shared his faith: their light shall run before them, and on their right hands! they shall say, "Lord perfect our light, and pardon us: for thou hast power over all things."

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: O Prophet! make war on the infidels and hypocrites, and deal rigorously with them. Hell shall be their abode! and wretched the passage to it!

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: God setteth forth as an example to unbelievers the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot; they were under two of our righteous servants, both of whom they deceived: but their husbands availed them nought against God: and it shall be said "Enter ye into the fire with those who enter."

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: God also holdeth forth to those who believe the example of the wife of Pharaoh,4 when she said, "Lord, build me an house with thee in Paradise, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his doings; and deliver me from the wicked:"

records.label: Surah 66 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And Mary, the daughter of Imran, who kept her maidenhood, and into whose womb5 we breathed of our spirit, and who believed in the words of her Lord and His Scriptures, and was one of the devout.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BLESSED be He is whose hand is the KINGDOM! and over all things is He potent:

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Who hath created death and life to prove which of you will be most righteous in deed; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Who hath created seven Heavens one above another: No defect canst thou see in the creation of the God of Mercy: Repeat the gaze: seest thou a single flaw?

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Then twice more repeat the gaze: thy gaze shall return to thee dulled and weary.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Moreover we have decked the lowest heaven with lights, and have placed them there to be hurled at the Satans, for whom we have prepared the torment of the flaming fire.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And for those who believe not in their Lord is the torment of Hell; and horrid the journey thither!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: When they shall be thrown into it, they shall hear it braying:1 and it shall boil-

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Almost shall it burst for fury. So oft as a crowd shall be thrown into it, its keepers shall ask them, "Came not the warner to you?"

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: They shall say, Yes! there came to us one charged with warnings; but we treated him as a liar, and said, "Nothing hath God sent down: ye are in nothing but a vast delusion."

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And they shall say, "Had we but hearkened or understood, we had not been among the dwellers in the flames;"

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And their sin shall they acknowledge: but, "Avaunt, ye dwellers in the flame."

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: But pardon and a great reward for those who fear their Lord in secret!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Be your converse hidden or open, He truly knoweth the inmost recess of your breasts!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: What! shall He not know who hath created? for He is the Subtil,2 the Cognizant.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: It is He who hath made the earth level for you: traverse then its broad sides, and eat of what He hath provided.-Unto Him shall be the resurrection.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: What! are ye sure that He who is in Heaven will not cleave the Earth beneath you? And lo, it shall quake.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Or are ye sure that He who is in Heaven will not send against you a stone- charged whirlwind? Then shall ye know what my warning meant!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And verily, those who flourish before you treated their prophets as liars: and how grievous my wrath!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Behold they not the birds over their heads, outstretching and drawing in their wings? None, save the God of Mercy, upholdeth them: for he regardeth all things.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Who is he that can be as an army to you, to succour you, except the God of Mercy? Truly, the infidels are in the merest delusion.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Or who is he that will furnish you supplies, if He withhold His supplies? Yet do they persist in pride and in fleeing from Him!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Is he who goeth along grovelling on his face, better guided than he who goeth upright on a straight path?

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: SAY: It is He who hath brought you forth, and gifted you with hearing and sight and heart: yet how few are grateful!

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: SAY: It is He who hath sown you in the earth, and to Him shall ye be gathered.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And they say, "When shall this threat be put in force, if ye speak the truth?"

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: SAY: Nay truly, this knowledge is with God alone: and I am only an open warner.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But when they shall see it nigh, sad shall wax the countenances of the infidels: and it shall be said, "This is what ye have been calling for."

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: SAY: What think ye? Whether God destroy me or not, and those who follow me, or whether he have mercy on us, yet who will protect the infidels from a woeful torment?

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: SAY: He is the God of Mercy: in Him do we believe, and in Him put we our trust; and ye shall know hereafter who is in a manifest error.

records.label: Surah 67 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: SAY: What think ye? If at early morn your waters shall have sunk away, who then will give you clear running water?

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: Mecca.-52 Verses

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Nun.1 By the PEN2 and by what they write,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Thou, O Prophet; by the grace of thy Lord art not possessed!3

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And truly a boundless recompense doth await thee,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: For thou art of a noble nature.4

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: But thou shalt see and they shall see Which of you is the demented.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Now thy Lord! well knoweth He the man who erreth from his path, and well doth he know those who have yielded to Guidance;

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Give not place, therefore, to those who treat thee as a liar:

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: They desire thee to deal smoothly with them: then would they be smooth as oil with thee:

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: But yield not to the man of oaths, a despicable person,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Defamer, going about with slander,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Hinderer of the good, transgressor, criminal,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Harsh-beside this, impure by birth,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Though a man of riches and blessed with sons.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Who when our wondrous verses are recited to him saith-"Fables of the ancients."

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: We will brand him on the nostrils.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Verily, we have proved them (the Meccans) as we proved the owners of the garden, when they swore that at morn they would cut its fruits;

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: But added no reserve.5

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Wherefore an encircling desolation from thy Lord swept round it while they slumbered,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And in the morning it was like a garden whose fruits had all been cut.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Then at dawn they called to each other,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: "Go out early to your field, if ye would cut your dates."

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: So on they went whispering to each other,

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: "No poor man shall set foot this day within your garden;"

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And they went out at daybreak with this settled purpose.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: But when they beheld it, they said, "Truly we have been in fault:

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Yes! we are forbidden our fruits."

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: The most rightminded of them said, "Did I not say to you, Will ye not give praise to God?"

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: They said, "Glory to our Lord! Truly we have done amiss."

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And they fell to blaming one another:

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: They said, "Oh woe to us! we have indeed transgressed!

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Haply our Lord will give us in exchange a better garden than this: verily we crave it of our Lord."

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Such hath been our chastisement-but heavier shall be the chastisement of the next world. Ah! did they but know it.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Verily, for the God-fearing are gardens of delight in the presence of their Lord.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Shall we then deal with those who have surrendered themselves to God, as with those who offend him?

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: What hath befallen you that ye thus judge?

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Have ye a Scripture wherein ye can search out

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: That ye shall have the things ye choose?

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Or have ye received oaths which shall bind Us even until the day of the resurrection, that ye shall have what yourselves judge right?

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Ask them which of them will guarantee this?

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Or is it that they have joined gods with God? let them produce those associate-gods of theirs, if they speak truth.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: On the day when men's legs shall be bared,6 and they shall be called upon to bow in adoration, they shall not be able:

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: Their looks shall be downcast: shame shall cover them: because, while yet in safety, they were invited to bow in worship, but would not obey.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Leave me alone therefore with him who chargeth this revelation with imposture. We will lead them by degrees to their ruin; by ways which they know not;

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Yet will I bear long with them; for my plan is sure.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Askest thou any recompense from them? But they are burdened with debt.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Are the secret things within their ken? Do they copy them from the Book of God?

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Patiently then await the judgment of thy Lord, and be not like him who was in the fish,7 when in deep distress he cried to God.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: Had not favour from his Lord reached him, cast forth would he have been on the naked shore, overwhelmed with shame:

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: But his Lord chose him and made him of the just.

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Almost would the infidels strike thee down with their very looks when they hear the warning of the Koran. And they say, "He is certainly possessed."

records.label: Surah 68 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: Yet is it nothing less than a warning for all creatures.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: The INEVITABLE!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And who shall make thee comprehend what the Inevitable is?

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Themoud and Ad treated the day of Terrors1 as a lie.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: So as to Themoud,2 they were destroyed by crashing thunder bolts;

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And as to Ad, they were destroyed by a roaring and furious blast.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: It did the bidding of God3 against them seven nights and eight days together, during which thou mightest have seen the people laid low, as though they had been the trunks of hollow palms;

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And couldst thou have seen one of them surviving?

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Pharaoh also, and those who flourished before him, and the overthrown cities, committed sin,-

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And disobeyed the Sent one of their Lord; therefore did he chastise them with an accumulated chastisement.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: When the Flood rose high, we bare you in the Ark,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: That we might make that event a warning to you, and that the retaining ear might retain it.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: But when one blast shall be blown on the trumpet,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And the earth and the mountains shall be upheaved, and shall both be crushed into dust at a single crushing,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: On that day the woe that must come suddenly shall suddenly come,4

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And the heaven shall cleave asunder, for on that day it shall be fragile;

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And the angels shall be on its sides, and over them on that day eight shall bear up the throne of thy Lord.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: On that day ye shall be brought before Him: none of your hidden deeds shall remain hidden:

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And he who shall have his book given to him in his right hand, will say to his friends, "Take ye it; read ye my book;

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: I ever thought that to this my reckoning I should come."

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And his shall be a life that shall please him well,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: In a lofty garden,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Whose clusters shall be near at hand:

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: "Eat ye and drink with healthy relish, as the meed of what ye sent on beforehand in the days which are past."

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: But he who shall have his book given into his left hand, will say, "O that my book had never been given me!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And that I had never known my reckoning!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: O that death had made an end of me!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: My wealth hath not profited me!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: My power hath perished from me!"

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: "Lay ye hold on him and chain him,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Then at the Hell-fire burn him,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits thrust him;

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: For he believed not in God, the Great,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And was not careful to feed the poor;

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: No friend therefore shall he have here this day,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Nor food, but corrupt sores,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Which none shall eat but the sinners."

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: It needs not that I swear by what ye see,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And by that which ye see not,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: That this verily is the word of an apostle worthy of all honour!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And that it is not the word of a poet-how little do ye believe!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Neither is it the word of a soothsayer (Kahin)-how little do ye receive warning!

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: It is a missive from the Lord of the worlds.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: But if Muhammad had fabricated concerning us any sayings,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: We had surely seized him by the right hand,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And had cut through the vein of his neck.5

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: Nor would We have withheld any one of you from him.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: But, verily, It (the Koran) is a warning for the God-fearing;

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: And we well know that there are of you who treat it as a falsehood.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: But it shall be the despair of infidels,

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: For it is the very truth of sure knowledge.

records.label: Surah 69 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: Praise, then, the name of thy Lord, the Great.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: A SUITOR sued1 for punishment to light suddenly

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: On the infidels: none can hinder

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: God from inflicting it, the master of those ASCENTS,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: By which the angels and the spirit ascend to him in a day, whose length is fifty thousand years.2

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Be thou patient therefore with becoming patience;

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: They forsooth regard that day as distant,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But we see it nigh:

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: The day when the heavens shall become as molten brass,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And the mountains shall become like flocks of wool:

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And friend shall not question of friend,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Though they look at one another. Fain would the wicked redeem himself from punishment on that day at the price of his children,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Of his spouse and his brother,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And of his kindred who shewed affection for him,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And of all who are on the earth that then it might deliver him.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: But no. For the fire,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Dragging by the scalp,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Shall claim him who turned his back and went away,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And amassed and hoarded.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Man truly is by creation hasty;

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: When evil befalleth him, impatient;

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: But when good falleth to his lot, tenacious.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Not so the prayerful,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Who are ever constant at their prayers;

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And of whose substance there is a due and stated portion

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: For him who asketh, and for him who is ashamed3 to beg;

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And who own the judgment-day a truth,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And who thrill with dread at the chastisement of their Lord-

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: For there is none safe from the chastisement of their Lord-

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And who control their desires,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: (Save with their wives or the slaves whom their right hands have won, for there they shall be blameless;

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: But whoever indulge their desires beyond this are transgressors);

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And who are true to their trusts and their engagements,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And who witness uprightly,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And who keep strictly the hours of prayer:

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: These shall dwell, laden with honours, amid gardens.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: But what hath come to the unbelievers that they run at full stretch around thee,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: On the right hand and on the left, in bands?

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Is it that every man of them would fain enter that garden of delights?

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Not at all. We have created them, they know of what.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: It needs not that I swear by the Lord of the East and of the West4 that we have power.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: To replace them with better than themselves: neither are we to be hindered.

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: Wherefore let them flounder on and disport them, till they come face to face with their threatened day,

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: The day on which they shall flock up out of their graves in haste like men who rally to a standard:-

records.label: Surah 70 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Their eyes downcast; disgrace shall cover them. Such their threatened day.

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: We sent NOAH to his people, and said to him, "Warn thou thy people ere there come on them an afflictive punishment."

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: He said, "O my people! I come to you a plain-spoken warner:

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Serve God and fear Him, and obey me:

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Your sins will He forgive you, and respite you till the fixed Time; for when God's fixed Time hath come, it shall not be put back. Would that ye knew this!"

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: He said, "Lord I have cried to my people night and day; and my cry doth but make them flee from me the more.

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: So oft as I cry to them, that thou mayest forgive them, they thrust their fingers into their ears, and wrap themselves in their garments, and persist in their error, and are disdainfully disdainful.

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Then I cried aloud to them:

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Then again spake I with plainness, and in private did I secretly address them:

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And I said, Beg forgiveness of your Lord, for He is ready to forgive.

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: He will send down the very Heaven upon you in plenteous rains;

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 12
