records.text: And will increase you in wealth and children; and will give you gardens, and will give you watercourses:-

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: What hath come to you that ye hope not for goodness from the hand of God?

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: For He it is who hath formed you by successive steps.1

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: See ye not how God hath created the seven heavens one over the other?

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And He hath placed therein the moon as a light, and hath placed there the sun as a torch;

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And God hath caused you to spring forth from the earth like a plant;

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Hereafter will He turn you back into it again, and will bring you forth anew-

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And God hath spread the earth for you like a carpet,

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: That ye may walk therein along spacious paths."'

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Said Noah, "O my Lord! they rebel against me, and they follow those whose riches and children do but aggravate their ruin."

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And they plotted a great plot;

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And they said, "Forsake not your Gods; forsake not Wadd nor Sowah,

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Nor Yaghuth and Yahuk and Nesr;"

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And they caused many to err;2-and thou, too, O Muhammad! shalt be the means of increasing only error in the wicked-

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Because of their sins they were drowned, and made to go into the Fire;

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And they found that they had no helper save God.

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And Noah said, "Lord, leave not one single family of Infidels on the Earth:

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: For if thou leave them they will beguile thy servants and will beget only sinners, infidels.

records.label: Surah 71 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: O my Lord, forgive me, and my parents, and every one who, being a believer, shall enter my house, and believers men and women: and add to the wicked nought but perdition."

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: SAY: It hath been revealed to me that a company of

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: DJINN1 listened, and said,-"Verily, we have heard a marvellous discourse (Koran);

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: It guideth to the truth; wherefore we believed in it, and we will not henceforth join any being with our Lord;

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And He,-may the majesty of our Lord be exalted!-hath taken no spouse neither hath he any offspring.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But the foolish among us hath spoken of God that which is unjust:

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And we verily thought that no one amongst men or Djinn would have uttered a lie against God.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: There are indeed people among men, who have sought for refuge unto people among Djinn: but they only increased their folly:

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And they thought, as ye think, that God would not raise any from the dead.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And the Heavens did we essay, but found them filled with a mighty garrison, and with flaming darts;

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And we sat on some of the seats to listen, but whoever listeneth findeth an ambush ready for him of flaming darts.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And truly we know not whether evil be meant for them that are on earth, or whether their Lord meaneth guidance for them.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And there are among us good, and others among us of another kind;-we are of various sorts:

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And verily we thought that no one could weaken God on earth, neither could we escape from him by flight:

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Wherefore as soon as we had heard 'the guidance' we believed in it; and whoever believeth in his Lord, need not fear either loss or wrong.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: There are some among us who have resigned themselves to God (the Muslims); and there are others of us who have gone astray. And whoso resigneth himself to God pursueth the way of truth;

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But they who go astray from it shall be fuel for Hell."

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Moreover, if they (the Meccans) keep straight on in that way, we will surely give them to drink of abundant waters,

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: That we may prove them thereby: but whoso withdraweth from the remembrance of his Lord, him will He send into a severe torment.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: It is unto God that the temples are set apart: call not then on any other therein with God.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: When the servant of God stood up to call upon Him, the djinn almost jostled him by their crowds.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: SAY: I call only upon my Lord, and I join no other being with Him.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: SAY: No control have I over what may hurt or benefit you.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: SAY: Verily none can protect me against God;

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Neither shall I find any refuge beside Him.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: My sole work is preaching from God, and His message: and for such as shall rebel against God and his apostle is the fire of Hell! they shall remain therein alway,-for ever!

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Until they see their threatened vengeance they will be perverse! but then shall they know which side was the weakest in a protector and the fewest in number.

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: SAY: I know not whether that with which ye are threatened be nigh, or whether my Lord hath assigned it to a distant day: He knoweth the secret, nor doth He divulge his secret to any,

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Except to that Apostle who pleaseth Him; and before him and behind him He maketh a guard to march:

records.label: Surah 72 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: That He may know if his Apostles have verily delivered the messages of their Lord: and He embraceth in his knowledge all their ways, and taketh count of all that concerneth them.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O THOU ENFOLDED in thy mantle,

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Stand up all night, except a small portion of it, for prayer:

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Half; or curtail the half a little,-

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Or add to it: And with measured tone intone the Koran,2

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: For we shall devolve on thee weighty words.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Verily, at the oncoming of night are devout impressions strongest, and words are most collected;3

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But in the day time thou hast continual employ-

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And commemorate the name of thy Lord, and devote thyself to Him with entire devotion.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Lord of the East and of the West! No God is there but He! Take Him for thy protector,

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And endure what they say with patience, and depart from them with a decorous departure.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And let Me alone with the gainsayers, rich in the pleasures of this life; and bear thou with them yet a little while:

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: For with Us are strong fetters, and a flaming fire,

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And food that choketh, and a sore torment.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: The day cometh when the earth and the mountains shall be shaken; and the mountains shall become a loose sand heap.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Verily, we have sent you an Apostle to witness against you, even as we sent an Apostle to Pharaoh:

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But Pharaoh rebelled against the Apostle, and we therefore laid hold on him with a severe chastisement.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And how, if ye believe not, will you screen yourselves from the day that shall turn children greyheaded?

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: The very heaven shall be reft asunder by it: this threat shall be carried into effect.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Lo! this is a warning. Let him then who will, take the way to his Lord.

records.label: Surah 73 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Of a truth,4 thy Lord knoweth that thou prayest almost two-thirds, or half, or a third of the night, as do a part of thy followers. But God measureth the night and the day: He knoweth that ye cannot count its hours aright, and therefore, turneth to you mercifully. Recite then so much of the Koran as may be easy to you. He knoweth that there will be some among you sick, while others travel through the earth in quest of the bounties of God; and others do battle in his cause. Recite therefore so much of it as may be easy. And observe the Prayers and pay the legal Alms,5 and lend God a liberal loan: for whatever good works ye send on before for your own behoof, ye shall find with God. This will be best and richest in the recompense. And seek the forgiveness of God: verily, God is forgiving, Merciful.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: O THOU, ENWRAPPED in thy mantle!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Arise and warn!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Thy Lord-magnify Him!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Thy raiment-purify it!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: The abomination-flee it!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And bestow not favours that thou mayest receive again with increase;

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And for thy Lord wait thou patiently.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: For when there shall be a trump on the trumpet,2

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: That shall be a distressful day,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: A day, to the Infidels, devoid of ease.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Leave me alone to deal with him3 whom I have created,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And on whom I have bestowed vast riches,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And sons dwelling before him,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And for whom I have smoothed all things smoothly down;-

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Yet desireth he that I should add more!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But no! because to our signs he is a foe

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: I will lay grievous woes upon him.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: For he plotted and he planned!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: May he be cursed! How he planned!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Again, may he be cursed! How he planned!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Then looked he around him,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Then frowned and scowled,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Then turned his back and swelled with disdain,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And said, “This is merely magic that will be wrought;

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: It is merely the word of a mortal.”

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: We will surely cast him into Hell-fire.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And who shall teach thee what Hell-fire is?

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: It leaveth nought, it spareth nought,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Blackening the skin.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Over it are nineteen angels.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: None but angels have we made guardians of the fire:4 nor have we made this to be their number but to perplex the unbelievers, and that they who possess the Scriptures may be certain of the truth of the Koran, and that they who believe may increase their faith;

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And that they to whom the Scriptures have been given, and the believers, may not doubt;

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And that the infirm of heart and the unbelievers may say, What meaneth God by this parable?

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Thus God misleadeth whom He will, and whom He will doth He guide aright: and none knoweth the armies of thy Lord but Himself: and this is no other than a warning to mankind.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: Nay, by the Moon!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: By the Night when it retreateth!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: By the Morn when it brighteneth!

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Hell is one of the most grievous woes,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Fraught with warning to man,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: To him among you who desireth to press forward, or to remain behind.5

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: For its own works lieth every soul in pledge. But they of God’s right hand

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: In their gardens shall ask of the wicked;-

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: “What hath cast you into Hell-fire?”6

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: They will say, “We were not of those who prayed,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And we were not of those who fed the poor,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: And we plunged into vain disputes with vain disputers,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: And we rejected as a lie, the day of reckoning,

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: Till the certainty7 came upon us”-

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: And intercession of the interceders shall not avail them.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: Then what hath come to them that they turn aside from the Warning

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 52
records.text: As if they were affrighted asses fleeing from a lion?

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 53
records.text: And every one of them would fain have open pages given to him out of Heaven.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 54
records.text: It shall not be. They fear not the life to come.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 55
records.text: It shall not be. For this Koran is warning enough. And whoso will, it warneth him.

records.label: Surah 74 · edition paragraph 56
records.text: But not unless God please, shall they be warned. Meet is He to be feared. Meet is forgiveness in Him.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: It needeth not that I swear by the day of the RESURRECTION,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Or that I swear by the self-accusing soul.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Thinketh man that we shall not re-unite his bones?

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Aye! his very finger tips are we able evenly to replace.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But man chooseth to deny what is before him:

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: He asketh, "When this day of Resurrection?"

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But when the eye shall be dazzled,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And when the moon shall be darkened,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And the sun and the moon shall be together,1

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: On that day man shall cry, "Where is there a place to flee to?"

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: But in vain-there is no refuge-

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: With thy Lord on that day shall be the sole asylum.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: On that day shall man be told of all that he hath done first and last;

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Yea, a man shall be the eye witness against himself:

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And even if he put forth his plea. . . .2

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: (Move not thy tongue in haste to follow and master this revelation:3

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: For we will see to the collecting and the recital of it;

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: But when we have recited it, then follow thou the recital,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And, verily, afterwards it shall be ours to make it clear to thee.)

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Aye, but ye love the transitory,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And ye neglect the life to come.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: On that day shall faces beam with light,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Outlooking towards their Lord;

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And faces on that day shall be dismal,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: As if they thought that some great calamity would befal them.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Aye, when the soul shall come up into the throat,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And there shall be a cry, "Who hath a charm that can restore him?"

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And the man feeleth that the time of his departure is come,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And when one leg shall be laid over the other,4

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: To thy Lord on that day shall he be driven on;

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: For he believed not, and he did not pray,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: But he called the truth a lie and turned his back,

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Then, walking with haughty men, rejoined his people.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: That Hour is nearer to thee and nearer,5

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: It is ever nearer to thee and nearer still.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Thinketh man that he shall be left supreme?

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Was he not a mere embryo?6

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: Then he became thick blood of which God formed him and fashioned him;

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: And made him twain, male and female.

records.label: Surah 75 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Is not He powerful enough to quicken the dead?

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Doth not a long time pass over MAN, during which he is a thing unremembered?1

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: We have created man from the union of the sexes that we might prove him; and hearing, seeing, have we made him:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: In a right way have we guided him, be he thankful or ungrateful.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: For the Infidels we have got ready chains and collars and flaming fire.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But a wine cup tempered at the camphor fountain2 the just shall quaff:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Fount whence the servants of God shall drink, and guide by channels from place to place;

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: They who fulfilled their vows, and feared the day whose woes will spread far and wide;

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Who though longing for it themselves, bestowed their food on the poor and the orphan and the captive:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: "We feed you for the sake of God: we seek from you neither recompense nor thanks:3

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: A stern and calamitous day dread we from our Lord."

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: From the evil therefore of that day hath God delivered them and cast on them brightness of face and joy:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And hath rewarded their constancy, with Paradise and silken robes:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Reclining therein on bridal couches, nought shall they know of sun or piercing cold:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Its shades shall be close over them, and low shall its fruits hang down:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And vessels of silver and goblets like flagons shall be borne round among them:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Flagons of silver whose measure themselves shall mete.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And there shall they be given to drink of the cup tempered with zendjebil (ginger)

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: From the fount therein whose name is Selsebil (the softly flowing).

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Aye-blooming youths go round among them. When thou lookest at them thou wouldest deem them scattered pearls;

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And when thou seest this, thou wilt see delights and a vast kingdom:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Their clothing green silk robes and rich brocade: with silver bracelets shall they be adorned; and drink of a pure beverage shall their Lord give them.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: This shall be your recompense. Your efforts shall meet with thanks.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: We ourselves have sent down to thee the Koran as a missive from on high.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Await then with patience the judgments of thy Lord, and obey not the wicked among them and the unbelieving:

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: And make mention of the name of thy Lord at morn, at even,

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And at night. Adore him, and praise him the livelong night.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: But these men love the fleeting present, and leave behind them the heavy day of doom.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Ourselves have we created them, and strengthened their joints; and when we please, with others like unto themselves will we replace them.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: This truly is a warning: And whoso willeth, taketh the way to his Lord;

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: But will it ye shall not, unless God will it, for God is Knowing, Wise.

records.label: Surah 76 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: He causeth whom He will to enter into his mercy. But for the evil doers, He hath made ready an afflictive chastisement.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: By the train of THE SENT ones,1

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And the swift in their swiftness;

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: By the scatterers who scatter,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And the distinguishers who distinguish;

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And by those that give forth the word

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: To excuse or warn;

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Verily that which ye are promised is imminent.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: When the stars, therefore, shall be blotted out,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And when the heaven shall be cleft,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And when the mountains shall be scattered in dust,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And when the Apostles shall have a time assigned them;

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Until what day shall that time be deferred?

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: To the day of severing!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And who shall teach thee what the day of severing is?

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Have we not destroyed them of old?

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: We will next cause those of later times to follow them.2

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Thus deal we with the evil doers.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Have we not created you of a sorry germ,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Which we laid up in a secure place,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Till the term decreed for birth?

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Such is our power! and, how powerful are We!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Have we not made the earth to hold

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: The living and the dead?

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And placed on it the tall firm mountains, and given you to drink of sweet water.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Begone to that Hell which ye called a lie:-

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: Begone to the shadows that lie in triple masses;

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: "But not against the flame shall they shade or help you:"-

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: The sparks which it casteth out are like towers-

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: Like tawny camels.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: On that day they shall not speak,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Nor shall it be permitted them to allege excuses.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: This is the day of severing, when we will assemble you and your ancestors.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: If now ye have any craft try your craft on me.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: But the god-fearing shall be placed amid shades and fountains,

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: And fruits, whatsoever they shall desire:

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: "Eat and drink, with health,3 as the meed of your toils."

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Thus recompense we the good.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: "Eat ye and enjoy yourselves a little while. Verily, ye are doers of evil."

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 48
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture!

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 49
records.text: For when it is said to them, bend the knee, they bend it not.

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 50
records.text: Woe on that day to those who charged with imposture

records.label: Surah 77 · edition paragraph 51
records.text: In what other revelation after this will they believe?

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Of what ask they of one another?

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Of the great NEWS.1

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: The theme of their disputes.

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Nay! they shall certainly knows its truth!

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Again. Nay! they shall certainly know it.

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Have we not made the Earth a couch?

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And the mountains its tent-stakes?

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: We have created you of two sexes,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And ordained your sleep for rest,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And ordained the night as a mantle,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And ordained the day for gaining livelihood,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And built above you seven solid2 heavens,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And placed therein a burning lamp;

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And we send down water in abundance from the rain-clouds,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: That we may bring forth by it corn and herbs,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And gardens thick with trees.

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Lo! the day of Severance is fixed;

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: The day when there shall be a blast on the trumpet, and ye shall come in crowds,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And the heaven shall be opened and be full of portals,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And the mountains shall be set in motion, and melt into thin vapour.

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Hell truly shall be a place of snares,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: The home of transgressors,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: To abide therein ages;

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: No coolness shall they taste therein nor any drink,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Save boiling water and running sores;

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Meet recompense!

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: For they looked not forward to their account;

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And they gave the lie to our signs, charging them with falsehood;

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: But we noted and wrote down all:

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: "Taste this then: and we will give you increase of nought but torment."

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: But, for the God-fearing is a blissful abode,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: Enclosed gardens and vineyards;

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And damsels with swelling breasts, their peers in age,

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: And a full cup:

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: There shall they hear no vain discourse nor any falsehood:

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: A recompense from thy Lord-sufficing gift!-

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Lord of the heavens and of the earth, and of all that between3 them lieth-the God of Mercy! But not a word shall they obtain from Him.

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: On the day whereon the Spirit4 and the Angels shall be ranged in order, they shall not speak: save he whom the God of Mercy shall permit, and who shall say that which is right.

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: This is the sure day. Whoso then will, let him take the path of return to his Lord.

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: Verily, we warn you of a chastisement close at hand:

records.label: Surah 78 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: The day on which a man shall see the deeds which his hands have sent before him; and when the unbeliever shall say, "Oh! would I were dust!"

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: By those angels who DRAG FORTH souls with violence,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And by those who with joyous release release them;

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: By those who swim swimmingly along;

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: By those who are foremost with foremost speed;2

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: By those who conduct the affairs of the universe!

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: One day, the disturbing trumpet-blast shall disturb it,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Which the second blast shall follow:

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Men's hearts on that day shall quake:-

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Their looks be downcast.

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: The infidels will say, "Shall we indeed be restored as at first?

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: What! when we have become rotten bones?"

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: "This then," say they, "will be a return to loss."

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Verily, it will be but a single blast,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And lo! they are on the surface of the earth.

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Hath the story of Moses reached thee?

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: When his Lord called to him in Towa's holy vale:

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Go to Pharaoh, for he hath burst all bounds:

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And say, "Wouldest thou become just?

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Then I will guide thee to thy Lord that thou mayest fear him."

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And he showed him a great miracle,-

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: But he treated him as an impostor, and rebelled;

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Then turned he his back all hastily,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And gathered an assembly and proclaimed,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And said, "I am your Lord supreme."

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: So God visited on him the punishment of this life and of the other.

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Verily, herein is a lesson for him who hath the fear of God.

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Are ye the harder to create, or the heaven which he hath built?

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: He reared its height and fashioned it,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And gave darkness to its night, and brought out its light,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And afterwards stretched forth the earth,-

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: He brought forth from it its waters and its pastures;

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And set the mountains firm

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: For you and your cattle to enjoy.

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: But when the grand overthrow shall come,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: The day when a man shall reflect on the pains that he hath taken,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And Hell shall be in full view of all who are looking on;

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: Then, as for him who hath transgressed

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: And hath chosen this present life,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Verily, Hell-that shall be his dwelling-place:

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: But as to him who shall have feared the majesty of his Lord, and shall have refrained his soul from lust,

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Verily, Paradise-that shall be his dwelling-place.

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: They will ask thee of "the Hour," when will be its fixed time?

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 44
records.text: But what knowledge hast thou of it?

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 45
records.text: Its period is known only to thy Lord;

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 46
records.text: And thou art only charged with the warning of those who fear it.

records.label: Surah 79 · edition paragraph 47
records.text: On the day when they shall see it, it shall seem to them as though they had not tarried in the tomb, longer than its evening or its morn.

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HE FROWNED, and he turned his back,1

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Because the blind man came to him!

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: But what assured thee that he would not be cleansed by the Faith,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Or be warned, and the warning profit him?

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: As to him who is wealthy-

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: To him thou wast all attention:

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Yet is it not thy concern if he be not cleansed:2

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: But as to him who cometh to thee in earnest,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And full of fears-

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Him dost thou neglect.

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Nay! but it (the Koran) is a warning;

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: (And whoso is willing beareth it in mind)

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Written on honoured pages,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Exalted, purified,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: By the hands of Scribes, honoured, righteous.

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Cursed be man! What hath made him unbelieving?

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Of what thing did God create him?

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Out of moist germs.3

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: He created him and fashioned him,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Then made him an easy passage from the womb,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Then causeth him to die and burieth him;

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Then, when he pleaseth, will raise him again to life.

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Aye! but man hath not yet fulfilled the bidding of his Lord.

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Let man look at his food:

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: It was We who rained down the copious rains,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Then cleft the earth with clefts,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: And caused the upgrowth of the grain,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: And grapes and healing herbs,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: And the olive and the palm,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And enclosed gardens thick with trees,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And fruits and herbage,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: For the service of yourselves and of your cattle.

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: But when the stunning trumpet-blast shall arrive,4

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: On that day shall a man fly from his brother,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: And his mother and his father,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: And his wife and his children;

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 38
records.text: For every man of them on that day his own concerns shall be enough.

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 39
records.text: There shall be faces on that day radiant,

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 40
records.text: Laughing and joyous:

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 41
records.text: And faces on that day with dust upon them:

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 42
records.text: Blackness shall cover them!

records.label: Surah 80 · edition paragraph 43
records.text: These are the Infidels, the Impure.

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHEN the sun shall be FOLDED UP,1

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And when the stars shall fall,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And when the mountains shall be set in motion,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And when the she-camels shall be abandoned,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And when the wild beasts shall be gathered together,2

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And when the seas shall boil,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And when souls shall be paired with their bodies,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And when the female child that had been buried alive shall be asked

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: For what crime she was put to death,3

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And when the leaves of the Book shall be unrolled,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And when the Heaven shall be stripped away,4

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And when Hell shall be made to blaze,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And when Paradise shall be brought near,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Every soul shall know what it hath produced.

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: It needs not that I swear by the stars5 of retrograde motions

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Which move swiftly and hide themselves away,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And by the night when it cometh darkening on,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And by the dawn when it brighteneth,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: That this is the word of an illustrious Messenger,6

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Endued with power, having influence with the Lord of the Throne,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Obeyed there by Angels, faithful to his trust,

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: And your compatriot is not one possessed by djinn;

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: For he saw him in the clear horizon:7

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Nor doth he grapple with heaven's secrets,8

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Nor doth he teach the doctrine of a cursed9 Satan.

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Whither then are ye going?

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Verily, this is no other than a warning to all creatures;

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: To him among you who willeth to walk in a straight path:

records.label: Surah 81 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: But will it ye shall not, unless as God willeth it,10 the Lord of the worlds.

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHEN the Heaven shall CLEAVE asunder,

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And when the stars shall disperse,

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And when the seas1 shall be commingled,

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And when the graves shall be turned upside down,

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Each soul shall recognise its earliest and its latest actions.

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: O man! what hath misled thee against thy generous Lord,

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Who hath created thee and moulded thee and shaped thee aright?

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: In the form which pleased Him hath He fashioned thee.

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Even so; but ye treat the Judgment as a lie.

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Yet truly there are guardians over you-

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Illustrious recorders-

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Cognisant of your actions.

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Surely amid delights shall the righteous dwell,

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: But verily the impure in Hell-fire:

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: They shall be burned at it on the day of doom,

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And they shall not be able to hide themselves from it.

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Who shall teach thee what the day of doom is?

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Once more. Who shall teach thee what the day of doom is?

records.label: Surah 82 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: It is a day when one soul shall be powerless for another soul: all sovereignty on that day shall be with God.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Woe to those who STINT the measure:

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Who when they take by measure from others, exact the full;

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: But when they mete to them or weigh to them, minish-

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: What! have they no thought that they shall be raised again

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: For the great day?

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: The day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Yes! the register of the wicked is in Sidjin.1

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And who shall make thee understand what Sidjin is?

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: It is a book distinctly written.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Woe, on that day, to those who treated our signs as lies,

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Who treated the day of judgment as a lie!

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: None treat it as a lie, save the transgressor, the criminal,

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Who, when our signs are rehearsed to him, saith, "Tales of the Ancients!"

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Yes; but their own works have got the mastery over their hearts.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Yes; they shall be shut out as by a veil from their Lord on that day;

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Then shall they be burned in Hell-fire:

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Then shall it be said to them, "This is what ye deemed a lie."

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Even so. But the register of the righteous is in Illiyoun.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And who shall make thee understand what Illiyoun is?

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: A book distinctly written;

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: The angels who draw nigh unto God attest it.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Surely, among delights shall the righteous dwell!

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: Seated on bridal couches they will gaze around;

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Thou shalt mark in their faces the brightness of delight;

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Choice sealed wine shall be given them to quaff,

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: The seal of musk. For this let those pant who pant for bliss-

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Mingled therewith shall be the waters of Tasnim-2

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Fount whereof they who draw nigh to God shall drink.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: The sinners indeed laugh the faithful to scorn:

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And when they pass by them they wink at one another,-

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 32
records.text: And when they return to their own people, they return jesting,

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 33
records.text: And when they see them they say, "These are the erring ones."

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 34
records.text: And yet they have no mission to be their guardians.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 35
records.text: Therefore, on that day the faithful shall laugh the infidels to scorn,

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 36
records.text: As reclining on bridal couches they behold them.

records.label: Surah 83 · edition paragraph 37
records.text: Shall not the infidels be recompensed according to their works?

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHEN the Heaven shall have SPLIT ASUNDER

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And duteously obeyed its Lord;1

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And when Earth shall have been stretched out as a plain,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And shall have cast forth what was in her and become empty,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And duteously obeyed its Lord;

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Then verily, O man, who desirest to reach thy Lord, shalt thou meet him.

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And he into whose right hand his Book shall be given,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Shall be reckoned with in an easy reckoning,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And shall turn, rejoicing, to his kindred.

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: But he whose Book shall be given him behind his back2

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Shall invoke destruction:

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: But in the fire shall he burn,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: For that he lived joyously among his kindred,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Without a thought that he should return to God.

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Yea, but his Lord beheld him.

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: It needs not therefore that I swear by the sunset redness,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: And by the night and its gatherings,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And by the moon when at her full,

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: That from state to state shall ye be surely carried onward.3

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: What then hath come to them that they believe not?

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And that when the Koran is recited to them they adore not?

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Yea, the unbelievers treat it as a lie.

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: But God knoweth their secret hatreds:

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: Let their only tidings4 be those of painful punishment;

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Save to those who believe and do the things that be right.

records.label: Surah 84 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: An unfailing recompense shall be theirs.

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BY the star-bespangled Heaven!1

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: By the promised Day!

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: By the witness and the witnessed!2

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Cursed the masters of the trench3

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Of the fuel-fed fire,

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: When they sat around it

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Witnesses of what they inflicted on the believers!

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Nor did they torment them but for their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy:4

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: His the kingdom of the Heavens and of the Earth; and God is the witness of everything.

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Verily, those who vexed the believers, men and women, and repented not, doth the torment of Hell, and the torment of the burning, await.

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: But for those who shall have believed and done the things that be right, are the Gardens beneath whose shades the rivers flow. This the immense bliss!

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Verily, right terrible will be thy Lord's vengeance!

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: He it is who produceth all things, and causeth them to return;

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And is He the Indulgent, the Loving;

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Possessor of the Glorious throne;

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Worker of that he willeth.

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Hath not the story reached thee of the hosts

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Of Pharaoh and Themoud?

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Nay! the infields are all for denial:

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: But God surroundeth them from behind.

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Yet it is a glorious Koran,

records.label: Surah 85 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Written on the preserved Table.

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BY the heaven, and by the NIGHT-COMER!

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: But who shall teach thee what the night-comer is?

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: 'Tis the star of piercing radiance.

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Over every soul is set a guardian.

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Let man then reflect out of what he was created.

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: He was created of the poured-forth germs,

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Which issue from the loins and breastbones:

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Well able then is God to restore him to life,-

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: On the day when all secrets shall be searched out,

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And he shall have no other might or helper.

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: I swear by the heaven which accomplisheth its cycle,

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And by the earth which openeth her bosom,

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: That this Koran is a discriminating discourse,

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And that it is not frivolous.

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: They plot a plot against thee,

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And I will plot a plot against them.

records.label: Surah 86 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Deal calmly therefore with the infidels; leave them awhile alone.

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: PRAISE the name of thy Lord THE MOST HIGH,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Who hath created and balanced all things,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Who hath fixed their destinies and guideth them,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Who bringeth forth the pasture,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And reduceth it to dusky stubble.

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: We will teach thee to recite the Koran, nor aught shalt thou forget,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Save what God pleaseth; for he knoweth alike things manifest and hidden;

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And we will make easy to thee our easy ways.

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Warn, therefore, for the warning is profitable:

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: He that feareth God will receive the warning,-

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And the most reprobate only will turn aside from it,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Who shall be exposed to the terrible fire,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: In which he shall not die, and shall not live.

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Happy he who is purified by Islam,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And who remembereth the name of his Lord and prayeth.

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But ye prefer this present life,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Though the life to come is better and more enduring.

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: This truly is in the Books of old,

records.label: Surah 87 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: The Books of Abraham1 and Moses.

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Hath the tidings of the day that shall OVERSHADOW, reached thee?

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Downcast on that day shall be the countenances of some,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Travailing and worn,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Burnt at the scorching fire,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Made to drink from a fountain fiercely boiling.

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: No food shall they have but the fruit of Darih,1

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Which shall not fatten, nor appease their hunger.

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Joyous too, on that day, the countenances of others,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Well pleased with their labours past,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: In a lofty garden:

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: No vain discourse shalt thou hear therein:

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Therein shall be a gushing fountain,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Therein shall be raised couches,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: And goblets ready placed,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: And cushions laid in order,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: And carpets spread forth.

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: Can they not look up to the clouds, how they are created;

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: And to the heaven how it is upraised;

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And to the mountains how they are rooted;

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And to the earth how it is outspread?

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: Warn thou then; for thou art a warner only:

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Thou hast no authority over them:

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: But whoever shall turn back and disbelieve,

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: God shall punish him with the greater punishment.

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: Verily to Us shall they return;

records.label: Surah 88 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: Then shall it be Our's to reckon with them.

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: By the DAYBREAK and ten nights.1

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: By that which is double and that which is single,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: By the night when it pursues its course!

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Is there not in this an oath becoming a man of sense?

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Hast thou not seen how thy Lord dealt with Ad,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: At Irem adorned with pillars,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Whose like have not been reared in these lands!

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And with Themoud who hewed out the rocks in the valley;

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And with Pharaoh the impaler;

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Who all committed excesses in the lands,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And multiplied wickedness therein.

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Wherefore thy Lord let loose on them the scourge of chastisement,2

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: For thy Lord standeth on a watch tower.

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: As to man, when his Lord trieth him and honoureth him and is bounteous to him,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: Then saith he, "My Lord honoureth me:"

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: But when he proveth him and limiteth his gifts to him,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: He saith, "My Lord despiseth me."

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Aye. But ye honour not the orphan,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Nor urge ye one another to feed the poor,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: And ye devour heritages, devouring greedily,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And ye love riches with exceeding love.

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 23
records.text: Aye. But when the earth shall be crushed with crushing, crushing,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 24
records.text: And thy Lord shall come and the angels rank on rank,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 25
records.text: And Hell on that day shall be moved up,3-Man shall on that day remember himself. But how shall remembrance help him?

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 26
records.text: He shall say, Oh! would that I had prepared for this my life! On that day none shall punish as God punisheth,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 27
records.text: And none shall bind with such bonds as He.

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 28
records.text: Oh, thou soul which art at rest,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 29
records.text: Return to thy Lord, pleased, and pleasing him:

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 30
records.text: Enter thou among my servants,

records.label: Surah 89 · edition paragraph 31
records.text: And enter thou my Paradise.

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: I NEED not to swear by this SOIL,

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: This soil on which thou dost dwell,

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Or by sire and offspring!1

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Surely in trouble have we created man.

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: What! thinketh he that no one hath power over him?

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: "I have wasted," saith he, "enormous riches!"

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: What! thinketh he that no one regardeth him?

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: What! have we not made him eyes,

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And tongue, and lips,

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And guided him to the two highways?2

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Yet he attempted not the steep.

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: And who shall teach thee what the steep is?

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: It is to ransom the captive,3

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Or to feed in the day of famine,

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: The orphan who is near of kin, or the poor that lieth in the dust;

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Beside this, to be of those who believe, and enjoin stedfastness on each other, and enjoin compassion on each other.

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: These shall be the people of the right hand:

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: While they who disbelieve our signs,

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: Shall be the people of the left.

records.label: Surah 90 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: Around them the fire shall close.

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BY the SUN and his noonday brightness!

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: By the Moon when she followeth him!

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: By the Day when it revealeth his glory!

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: By the Night when it enshroudeth him!

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: By the Heaven and Him who built it!

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: By the Earth and Him who spread it forth!

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: By a Soul and Him who balanced it,

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And breathed into it its wickedness and its piety,

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: Blessed now is he who hath kept it pure,

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And undone is he who hath corrupted it!

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: Themoud1 in his impiety rejected the message of the Lord,

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: When the greatest wretch among them rushed up:-

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: Said the Apostle of God to them,-"The Camel of God! let her drink."

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: But they treated him as an impostor and hamstrung her.

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: So their Lord destroyed them for their crime, and visited all alike:

records.label: Surah 91 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Nor feared he the issue.

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BY the NIGHT when she spreads her veil;

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: By the Day when it brightly shineth;

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: By Him who made male and female;

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: At different ends truly do ye aim!1

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But as to him who giveth alms and feareth God,

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And yieldeth assent to the Good;

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: To him will we make easy the path to happiness.

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: But as to him who is covetous and bent on riches,

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And calleth the Good a lie,

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: To him will we make easy the path to misery:

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And what shall his wealth avail him when he goeth down?

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Truly man’s guidance is with Us

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: And Our’s, the Future and the Past.

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: I warn you therefore of the flaming fire;

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: None shall be cast to it but the most wretched,-

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Who hath called the truth a lie and turned his back.

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: But the God-fearing shall escape it,-

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Who giveth away his substance that he may become pure;2

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 20
records.text: And who offereth not favours to any one for the sake of recompense,

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 21
records.text: But only as seeking the face of his Lord the Most High.

records.label: Surah 92 · edition paragraph 22
records.text: And surely in the end he shall be well content.

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: BY the noon-day BRIGHTNESS,

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And by the night when it darkeneth!

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Thy Lord hath not forsaken thee, neither hath he been displeased.

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And surely the Future shall be better for thee than the Past,

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And in the end shall thy Lord be bounteous to thee and thou be satisfied.

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Did he not find thee an orphan2 and gave thee a home?

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And found thee erring and guided thee,3

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And found thee needy and enriched thee.

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: As to the orphan therefore wrong him not;

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: And as to him that asketh of thee, chide him not away;

records.label: Surah 93 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And as for the favours of thy Lord tell them abroad.

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HAVE we not OPENED thine heart for thee?

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And taken off from thee thy burden,
