records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Which galled thy back?

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And have we not raised thy name for thee?

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Then verily along with trouble cometh ease.

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Verily along with trouble cometh ease.

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But when thou art set at liberty, then prosecute thy toil.

records.label: Surah 94 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And seek thy Lord with fervour.

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: I SWEAR by the FIG and by the olive,

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: By Mount Sinai,

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And by this inviolate soil!1

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: That of goodliest fabric we created man,

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Then brought him down to be the lowest of the low;-

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Save who believe and do the things that are right, for theirs shall be a reward that faileth not.

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Then, who after this shall make thee treat the Judgment as a lie?

records.label: Surah 95 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: What! is not God the most just of judges?

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful2

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: RECITE3 thou, in the name of thy Lord who created;-

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Created man from CLOTS OF BLOOD:-

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Recite thou! For thy Lord is the most Beneficent,

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Who hath taught the use of the pen;-

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Hath taught Man that which he knoweth not.

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Nay, verily,4 Man is insolent,

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Because he seeth himself possessed of riches.

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Verily, to thy Lord is the return of all.

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: What thinkest thou of him that holdeth back

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: A servant5 of God when he prayeth?

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: What thinkest thou?6 Hath he followed the true Guidance, or enjoined Piety?

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: What thinkest thou? Hath he treated the truth as a lie and turned his back?

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 14
records.text: What! doth he not know how that God seeth?

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 15
records.text: Nay, verily, if he desist not, We shall seize him by the forelock,

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 16
records.text: The lying sinful forelock!

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 17
records.text: Then let him summon his associates;7

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 18
records.text: We too will summon the guards of Hell:

records.label: Surah 96 · edition paragraph 19
records.text: Nay! obey him not; but adore, and draw nigh to God.8

records.label: Surah 97 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 97 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: VERILY, we have caused It1 to descend on the night of POWER.

records.label: Surah 97 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And who shall teach thee what the night of power is?

records.label: Surah 97 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: The night of power excelleth a thousand months:

records.label: Surah 97 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Therein descend the angels and the spirit by permission of their Lord for every matter;2

records.label: Surah 97 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And all is peace till the breaking of the morn.

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: THE unbelievers among the people of the Book, and the Polytheists, did not waver, until the CLEAR EVIDENCE had come to them;

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: A messenger from God, reciting to them the pure pages wherein are true Scriptures!

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Neither were they to whom the Scriptures were given divided into sects, till after this clear evidence had reached them!

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Yet was not aught enjoined on them but to worship God with sincere religion, sound in faith; and to observe prayer and pay the stated alms. For this is true religion.

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But the unbelievers among the people of the Book, and among the Polytheists, shall go into the fire of Gehenna to abide therein for aye. Of all creatures are they the worst!

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: But they who believe and do the things that are right-these of all creatures are the best!

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Their recompense with their Lord shall be gardens of Eden, 'neath which the rivers flow, in which they shall abide for evermore.

records.label: Surah 98 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: God is well pleased in them and they in Him! This, for him who feareth his Lord.

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHEN the Earth with her quaking shall quake

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And the Earth shall cast forth her burdens,

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And man shall say, What aileth her?

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: On that day shall she tell out her tidings,

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Because thy Lord shall have inspired her.

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: On that day shall men come forward in throngs to behold their works,

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And whosoever shall have wrought an atom's weight of good shall behold it,

records.label: Surah 99 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And whosoever shall have wrought an atom's weight of evil shall behold it.

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: Mecca.-11 Verses

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: By the snorting CHARGERS!

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And those that dash off sparks of fire!

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And those that scour to the attack at morn!

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And stir therein the dust aloft;

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And cleave therein their midway through a host!

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Truly, Man is to his Lord ungrateful.

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: And of this he is himself a witness;

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: And truly, he is vehement in the love of this world's good.

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 11
records.text: Ah! knoweth he not, that when that which is in the graves shall be laid bare,

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 12
records.text: And that which is in men's breasts shall be brought forth,

records.label: Surah 100 · edition paragraph 13
records.text: Verily their Lord shall on that day be informed concerning them?

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: THE BLOW! what is the Blow?

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Who shall teach thee what the Blow is?

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: The Day when men shall be like scattered moths,

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And the mountains shall be like flocks of carded wool,

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Then as to him whose balances are heavy-his shall be a life that shall please him well:

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: And as to him whose balances are light-his dwelling-place1 shall be the pit.

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: And who shall teach thee what the pit (El-Hawiya) is?

records.label: Surah 101 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: A raging fire!

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: THE DESIRE of increasing riches occupieth you,

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Till ye come to the grave.

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Nay! but in the end ye shall know

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Nay! once more,in the end ye shall know your folly.

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Nay! would that ye knew it with knowledge of certainty!

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Surely ye shall see hell-fire.

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Then shall ye surely see it with the eye of certainty;

records.label: Surah 102 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: Then shall ye on that day be taken to task concerning pleasures.

records.label: Surah 103 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 103 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: I SWEAR by the declining day!

records.label: Surah 103 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Verily, man's lot is cast amid destruction,1

records.label: Surah 103 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Save those who believe and do the things which be right, and enjoin truth and enjoin stedfastness on each other.

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: Woe to every BACKBITER, Defamer!

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Who amasseth wealth and storeth it against the future!

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: He thinketh surely that his wealth shall be with him for ever.

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Nay! for verily he shall be flung into the Crushing Fire;

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And who shall teach thee what the Crushing Fire is?

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: It is God's kindled fire,

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: Which shall mount above the hearts of the damned;

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 9
records.text: It shall verily rise over them like a vault,

records.label: Surah 104 · edition paragraph 10
records.text: On outstretched columns.

records.label: Surah 105 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 105 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: HAST thou not seen1 how thy Lord dealt with the army of the ELEPHANT?

records.label: Surah 105 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Did he not cause their stratagem to miscarry?

records.label: Surah 105 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And he sent against them birds in flocks (ababils),

records.label: Surah 105 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Claystones did they hurl down upon them,

records.label: Surah 105 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And he made them like stubble eaten down!

records.label: Surah 106 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 106 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: For the union of the KOREISCH:-

records.label: Surah 106 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Their union in equipping caravans winter and summer.

records.label: Surah 106 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And let them worship the Lord of this house, who hath provided them with food against hunger,

records.label: Surah 106 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And secured them against alarm.1

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHAT thinkest thou of him who treateth our RELIGION as a lie?

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: He it is who trusteth away the orphan,

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And stirreth not others up to feed the poor.

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Woe to those who pray,

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: But in their prayer are careless;

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Who make a shew of devotion,

records.label: Surah 107 · edition paragraph 8
records.text: But refuse help to the needy.

records.label: Surah 108 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 108 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: TRULY we have given thee an ABUNDANCE;

records.label: Surah 108 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Pray therefore to the Lord, and slay the victims.

records.label: Surah 108 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Verily whoso hateth thee shall be childless.1

records.label: Surah 109 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 109 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: SAY: O ye UNBELIEVERS!

records.label: Surah 109 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: I worship not that which ye worship,

records.label: Surah 109 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And ye do not worship that which I worship;

records.label: Surah 109 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: I shall never worship that which ye worship,

records.label: Surah 109 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Neither will ye worship that which I worship.

records.label: Surah 109 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: To you be your religion; to me my religion.1

records.label: Surah 110 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 110 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: WHEN the HELP of God and the victory arrive,

records.label: Surah 110 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: And thou seest men entering the religion of God by troops;

records.label: Surah 110 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Then utter the praise of thy Lord, implore His pardon; for He loveth to turn in mercy.

records.label: Surah 111 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 111 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: LET the hands of ABU LAHAB1 perish,and let himself perish!

records.label: Surah 111 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: His wealth and his gains shall avail him not.

records.label: Surah 111 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: Burned shall he be at the fiery flame,2

records.label: Surah 111 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And his wife laden with fire wood,-

records.label: Surah 111 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: On her neck a rope of palm fibre.

records.label: Surah 112 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 112 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: SAY: He is God alone:

records.label: Surah 112 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: God the eternal!

records.label: Surah 112 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: He begetteth not, and He is not begotten;

records.label: Surah 112 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And there is none like unto Him.

records.label: Surah 113 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 113 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: SAY: I betake me for refuge to the Lord of the DAY BREAK

records.label: Surah 113 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: Against the mischiefs of his creation;

records.label: Surah 113 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: And against the mischief of the night when it overtaketh me;

records.label: Surah 113 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: And against the mischief of weird women;1

records.label: Surah 113 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: And against the mischief of the envier when he envieth.

records.label: Surah 114 · edition paragraph 1
records.text: In the Name of God, the Compassionate, the Merciful

records.label: Surah 114 · edition paragraph 2
records.text: SAY: I betake me for refuge to the Lord of MEN,

records.label: Surah 114 · edition paragraph 3
records.text: The King of men,

records.label: Surah 114 · edition paragraph 4
records.text: The God of men,

records.label: Surah 114 · edition paragraph 5
records.text: Against the mischief of the stealthily withdrawing whisperer,1

records.label: Surah 114 · edition paragraph 6
records.text: Who whispereth in man's breast-

records.label: Surah 114 · edition paragraph 7
records.text: Against djinn and men.
